30780.name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL_IS_SWITCHED_OFF_FOR_EVERYONE
30780.meaning: Customer email is switched off for everyone (`HELM_CUSTOMER_EMAIL_ENABLED` is not `true`, `src/lib/email/outbound-gate.ts`) or no mail transport is configured, so Invite players cannot email anyone

catalogRow.theySee: The sheet keeps the team code and the invite link and replaces the email field with one quiet line: "Email invites are off for now. Share the team code or link above." No field, no button

30781.name: THE_ROSTER_IS_OVER_ITS_LIMIT
30781.meaning: The roster is over its limit (F-05; NCAA Division I Bylaw 17.2: 9 in golf, or the coach's own number)

catalogRow.theySee: The head's line reads "10 count toward the roster limit of 9: 1 over." with an amber "1 over" badge, and under it: "The roster is 1 player over its limit of 9. Mark a player inactive, or mark one who doesn’t count (a designated student-athlete, or a medical exemption), before the roster is due." Only active players count; a player marked as not counting is left out and says "Not counted" in their row

30782.name: THE_ROSTER_LIMIT_CANT_BE_CHANGED_YET
30782.meaning: The roster limit can't be changed yet (its store, held migration 20261115250000, isn't applied)

catalogRow.theySee: The limit's sheet states the limit in force ("The limit is 9, from your division." or "No limit is set.") + "Changing it arrives with the next update." with Close and no Save; the row items to mark a player are not offered

30801.name: COACH_ONLY_ROSTER
30801.meaning: The coach's roster (the list with its figures, the coach's notes, the join requests, Invite, Export and the player panel) is a coach's: the page hands it over for a coach with the flag on, the route checks the session again before any read, and a player is handed their own read-only roster (30804), never this one, its loader, the notes or the join requests.

30802.name: NOTES_PRIVATE_TO_THE_COACH
30802.meaning: The loader reads the members of the coach's active team (active and inactive only) and only the notes this coach wrote (coach_id), so another coach's note about the same player is never loaded.

30803.name: REFUSED_CHANGE_SHOWN_AND_UNDONE
30803.meaning: When the server refuses a removal, an approval, a decline or a note (not on your team, already processed, a saved round in progress, not authorized), its sentence is shown in the error toast and the screen goes back: the player stays and the dialog stays open, the request returns to its place, and the text stays in the field.

30804.name: PLAYER_ROSTER_IS_READ_ONLY
30804.meaning: A player on this address gets their own team's roster as plain text: name, class year and handicap of the active members. No card or row is a link or a button (none takes focus), and nothing on the screen leads to a teammate's profile, stats or notes, or invites, exports, approves, removes or messages anyone.

30805.name: PLAYER_ROSTER_READS_NO_COACH_DATA
30805.meaning: The player's loader reads the team's name and season and the active members' name, graduation year and handicap, scoped by the player's own team (RLS). It never reads the join code, the join requests, a coach's notes, a teammate's email, phone, rounds, scores, focus areas or goals, and it sends the browser nothing outside that projection.

30806.name: PLAYER_ON_A_ROSTER_ADDRESS_GOES_TO_THE_LIST
30806.meaning: With Clubhouse on, a player who opens /roster/[id] (an old link) goes to the roster, since a teammate has no page; a coach goes to that player's Stats.

30901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
30901.meaning: A change that lands names itself in a toast (added, declined, note saved, removed) with one success haptic; a removal also closes the dialog and the player's panel or profile.

30980.name: ROSTER_LIMIT_SAVED
30980.meaning: The roster limit's sheet saves the limit on or off and its number (1 to 40): 'Roster limit set to 8' with the success haptic, and the head's count follows at once. The server writes one row a team through RLS (a coach of the team) and answers 'unavailable' before the migration is applied.

30981.name: ROSTER_EXEMPTION_SAVED
30981.meaning: Marking a player as not counting (or counting again) shows at once in the count and the row, and lands with 'Ava Chen doesn’t count toward the roster limit'. The server writes one row a player with the reason through RLS (a coach of the team, the player on the team), deletes it to count them again, and answers 'unavailable' before the migration is applied.

31101.name: REMOVE_FROM_TEAM
31101.meaning: Remove from team (row menu; on the phone, the profile's ⋯ sheet)

catalogRow.theySee: "Remove player?" + "Remove Theo Marchetti from Varsity? They can rejoin later with the team code." + "Their account and stats are not deleted…" Keep Theo / Remove player (the safe choice names the player)

31102.name: MARK_INACTIVE_MARK_ACTIVE
31102.meaning: Mark inactive / Mark active (coach only: row menu; on the phone, the profile's ⋯ sheet)

catalogRow.theySee: "Mark player inactive?" + "Move Theo Marchetti to Inactive on Varsity?" + "They stay on the team with their account and stats, but leave team rankings and averages. Until you mark them active again, the app shows them no team." Cancel / Mark inactive. For an inactive player: "Mark player active?" + "Move Theo Marchetti back to the active roster of Varsity?" Not destructive: the confirm is the primary, no red and no warning haptic (D-42, D-70)

31201.name: NOTE_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
31201.meaning: A note that fails to save stays in the field, and the toast says so; leaving the field again or the toast's Retry saves it.

31202.name: LAYOUT_REMEMBERED
31202.meaning: The cards or list choice is stored on the device (ch-roster-view) and applied when Roster opens; a device that refuses storage still switches for the visit. Search, filter and sort are not kept.

31203.name: SAVED_NOTE_READS_BACK
31203.meaning: A saved note is written into the roster the screen holds, so closing a player and opening them again, on desktop or the phone, shows the new text; an emptied note reads back empty.

31301.name: REQUEST_DECISIONS_OPTIMISTIC
31301.meaning: Approve and Decline take the request off the list at once and put it back in its place if the server refuses or throws, and while one decision is in flight every other Approve and Decline waits; Remove is not optimistic, it waits with the dialog open and the button reading Removing.

31401.name: APPROVE_ALL_RETRIES_ONLY_FAILURES
31401.meaning: Approve all goes one request at a time; those that landed leave the list, and the toast's Retry re-runs only the ones that failed, never approving anyone twice.

31402.name: TRY_AGAIN_REFRESHES_THE_PAGE
31402.meaning: Try again on the roster, season stats, join requests or join code notice asks the server for the whole page again (router.refresh), not one section alone.

31403.name: TOAST_RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
31403.meaning: The Retry on a failed-change toast completes the change on screen as well as on the server: a retried removal removes the player and closes the dialog, a retried approval or decline keeps the request off the list, and a retried note save marks the note saved.

31601.name: OPENING_OR_SWITCHING_A_PLAYER
31601.meaning: Opening or switching a player (desktop: from a Needs a look chip)

catalogRow.theySee: The panel slides in 16px and fades (260ms); switching players cross-fades
catalogRow.how: `RosterPeek`, `chTween('base')`; on the phone the profile is pushed instead (the shell's CH-1610)

31602.name: HOVERING_OR_PRESSING_A_FACE_CARD_OR
31602.meaning: Hovering or pressing a face card or row

catalogRow.theySee: On desktop a face is a raised tile that lifts 8px on hover with a stronger gold ring and takes the green tint on press (110ms), with no scale; a list row presses the same way from its name; the selected face keeps a green tint, a 2px green ring and a stronger gold frame. On the phone a player row, an action in the ⋯ sheet and the profile's All link take the row press tint over the press beat, and the join requests card (the screen's one feature card) darkens under a shade over the press beat; nothing scales

31603.name: SWITCHING_BETWEEN_TEAM_VIEW_AND_LIST_VIEW
31603.meaning: Switching between Team view and List view

catalogRow.theySee: The other layout settles in with a 6px rise (260ms) while the old one fades out (180ms), hidden from assistive tech. The kept layout coming back as the page opens never animates. Instant with reduced motion

31604.name: PHONE_CHOOSING_AVG_SG_OR_NAME
31604.meaning: Phone: choosing Avg, SG or Name

catalogRow.theySee: Each moved row slides to its new place on the smooth spring, and each row's trailing figure is the new sort's figure at once, plain tabular text with a true minus: no digits roll and nothing counts up (owner rule, as on Qualifiers). A refresh never moves the rows. Instant with reduced motion or Animations off

31701.name: OPENING_A_PLAYER_CHANGING_A_FILTER_LAYOUT
31701.meaning: Opening a player; changing a filter, layout or sort

catalogRow.theySee: A selection tick
The OS success pattern (D-70)

31703.name: THE_CODE_OR_LINK_IS_COPIED
31703.meaning: The code or link is copied

catalogRow.theySee: The OS success pattern

31704.name: REMOVE_PLAYER_WARNS
31704.meaning: Pressing Remove player in the confirm fires the warning haptic (D-70), then the success pattern when the removal lands or the error pattern when it fails; Cancel is silent.

31801.name: THE_DESKTOP_LIST_VIEW_IS_A_TABLE
31801.meaning: The desktop list view is a table (phone rows: CH-3806): every value, including the player's open button, sits in a cell under a column header

31802.name: A_FACE_CARD_READS_ITS_STATUS_AS
31802.meaning: A face card reads its status as a word; the green dot is decoration

31803.name: ESC_CLOSES_THE_PLAYER_PANEL_EXCEPT_WHILE
31803.meaning: Esc closes the player panel, except while typing a note (desktop; on the phone, Back and the edge swipe pop the profile, CH-1906)

31804.name: THE_NOTE_COUNTER_IS_ANNOUNCED_POLITELY_A
31804.meaning: The note counter is announced politely; a locked note says why it's locked

31805.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_STATE
31805.meaning: No axe violations in any preview state, both layouts, 1280px and 390px

31806.name: PHONE_A_PLAYER_ROW_IS_ONE_BUTTON
31806.meaning: Phone: a player row is one button that reads name, class, note, average and handicap; the form spark is decoration

31807.name: THE_PLAYERS_ROSTER_A_TEAMMATE_IS_TEXT
31807.meaning: The player's roster is read-only: a teammate is text, not a control. The desktop cards and table rows and the phone rows are not links or buttons, so none takes focus or a press, and nothing on the screen opens a profile, stats or notes or does anything to a teammate. Search, layout and sort only change what is listed

31808.name: THE_PLAYERS_ROSTER_NAMES_THE_COACHES
31808.meaning: The player's roster names the coaches (wave 7, decision D): a "Coaches" group above the players: name and role ("Head coach" first, else their title, else "Coach"), plain text like every row. Desktop: a Coach and Role table; phone: a list under its heading, then "Players". Left out when the staff read failed (logged `playerCoaches`) or none is on record

31809.name: AVAILABILITY_IS_SAID_IN_WORDS_NEVER_A
31809.meaning: Availability is said in words, never a colour: "Injured" or "Away" (the word only, no note) in the list's line under the name, a face's note slot and the phone row, in plain ink (red is under par, amber a slide, green a gain). A face's name and a phone row's name append "injured" or "away"; the Availability control is a radio group named for the player; the head counts "· 1 injured · 1 away" among the active

31880.name: EMAIL_THEM_IS_ONE_LABELLED_FIELD_EACH
31880.meaning: Email them is one labelled field ("Or email them"). Each address is a chip with its own `Remove eli@school.edu` button, an unreadable one adds ", can’t be read as an email address" and one that did not send ", didn’t send"; Backspace in the empty field removes the last chip; the count and the result are read politely, and an unreadable address is announced as an alert

31901.name: PHONE_LIST_AND_PROFILE
31901.meaning: At 820px and below Roster is the phone screen: a top bar with the back link to More and Invite players, the join requests banner, the sorted list, and each player as a pushed profile that is a history entry, so the edge swipe and Back return to the list.

32001.name: NOTE_SAVES_ON_LEAVING_THE_FIELD
32001.meaning: The coach's note saves when the field loses focus, only if its trimmed text changed, and an emptied note saves as no note.

32101.name: LOADER_NEVER_THROWS
32101.meaning: loadRoster reads the team, the members and the join requests in one parallel round, then rounds, focus areas, goals and this coach's notes in a second (it needs the member ids); every failed read is logged through chLogServer and flagged, never thrown, and a failed read is never shown as empty.

32301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
32301.meaning: A failed change is reported through chReport with surface roster and its action name (roster.removePlayer, roster.approveRequest, roster.declineRequest, roster.approveAll, roster.coachNote), a crash with its section surface (roster.requests, roster.list, roster.peek), and a failed server read through chLogServer('roster', ...); each intent leaves a chTrail breadcrumb.

32401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
32401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/roster.test.tsx names, in a test title, every Roster catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 that is not marked preview, and each hand contract above.

40101.name: TEAM_STATS_READY
40101.meaning: Team stats opens for a coach on the last 10 rounds per player: the header (team, active players), five figure cards, the strokes gained trend, the ranked dot plot of who gains and loses, the four leg cards with the player grid, team putting and season bests, all in the server's first render; on the phone, the phone view with the same data.

40102.name: WINDOW_FROM_THE_ADDRESS
40102.meaning: ?window=season or ?window=qualifiers opens that window and anything else opens Last 10; changing the switch writes the window back to /golf/dashboard/stats (Last 10 is the bare address) without moving the scroll.

40201.name: STATS_IS_LOADING
40201.meaning: Team stats are loading (a player's profile is CH-5403)

catalogRow.theySee: The page's header, five figure cards and chart frames as skeletons, each line and card sized like the loaded Team stats so nothing below moves when it lands

40301.name: CHANGING_THE_WINDOW
40301.meaning: Changing the window (Last 10, Season, Qualifiers) or the round filter

catalogRow.theySee: The page dims slightly and is marked busy until the new rounds land; the scroll position stays

40401.name: NO_18_HOLE_ROUNDS_IN_THE_WINDOW
40401.meaning: No 18-hole rounds in the window (including Season when the team has only 9-hole rounds: D-71's first-run page is for no round of either length)

catalogRow.theySee: The page's empty state, since the whole body is empty (states audit, 2026-10-08): the medallion, "No 18-hole rounds in this window yet" + "Team stats fill in as players post countable rounds." + Show the season as its one primary action; under the framed head on desktop, full width on the phone
The page's empty state, as CH-4301: "No qualifier rounds this season yet" + "Qualifier rounds appear here once they are posted as qualifying." + Show the season

40403.name: NO_STROKES_GAINED_IN_THE_WINDOW
40403.meaning: No strokes gained in the window

catalogRow.theySee: "No strokes gained in this window." + "Strokes gained appears for rounds posted with shots."

40404.name: NO_SCORES_IN_THE_WINDOW
40404.meaning: No scores in the window (Scoring lens)

catalogRow.theySee: "No scores in this window."

40405.name: NO_PLAYER_HAS_A_ROUND_IN_THE
40405.meaning: No player has a round in the window

catalogRow.theySee: "No player rounds in this window." in the grid's place
"No putts logged in this window." + "Putting fills in from rounds posted with putt distances."
"No season bests yet." + "Low round, most birdies and the rest appear once rounds are posted."

40408.name: A_PLAYER_HAS_TOO_FEW_ROUNDS_FOR
40408.meaning: A player has too few rounds for strokes gained

catalogRow.theySee: "Early read" in Total, dashes in the leg cells; never 0.0

40409.name: A_COACH_OR_PLAYER_WITH_NO_TEAM
40409.meaning: A coach or player with no team

catalogRow.theySee: The page empty state (v2 medallion): "You aren’t on a team yet" + what fills in once they are

40410.name: NO_COUNTABLE_ROUND_ALL_SEASON
40410.meaning: No countable round all season, of either length (D-71)

catalogRow.theySee: The page empty state: "No stats yet" + "Team and player stats fill in as players post rounds this season." + View roster, or Invite players (Roster's invite sheet) with nobody active on the roster; other windows keep CH-4301. With no round in any window the phone drops its window switch (nothing to switch); older rounds keep it
catalogRow.how: `StatsTeamFirstRun` (desktop and phone: the phone's hand-rolled block is gone, GAP-S-22)

40411.name: THE_WINDOW_HAS_NO_ROUND_POSTED_WITH
40411.meaning: The window has no round posted with shots, so the team has no strokes gained

catalogRow.theySee: The "Team SG per round" headline reads "—" with "Needs rounds with shots" and what it is measured against ("vs Tour"), never a zero
catalogRow.how: The strokes gained trend's headline (`StatsTeamIslands`, `data-ch-code` on `.ch-sgt__hero`); loader `figures[0].state = 'empty'`

40412.name: THE_LAST_10_WINDOW_HAS_NO_EARLIER
40412.meaning: The last-10 window has no earlier rounds to set strokes gained against (none, or fewer than three with shots)

catalogRow.theySee: The headline keeps its value and says "No earlier rounds" (or "Too few earlier rounds with shots") where the change chip would be. The season and qualifier windows have no previous window by design and say nothing

40413.name: THE_ROUND_FILTER_LEAVES_NO_ROUND
40413.meaning: The round filter leaves no round (a type, course, range or pick that matches nothing)

catalogRow.theySee: "No rounds match these filters." + "Try a wider time, fewer round types, or clear the filters to see every round again." + Clear filters, as the page's empty state (the whole body under the filter row: the filter glyph's medallion, Clear filters the one primary action). The Filter button, the chips and the count line ("0 rounds: qualifying rounds, at Pine Hollow, this season") stay, so the filter can be changed or cleared. Never the first-run page (CH-4310) or CH-4301 / CH-4302, which are for no filter

40414.name: THE_FILTER_LEAVES_FEWER_THAN_THREE_WHOLE
40414.meaning: The filter leaves fewer than three whole rounds (a 9-hole round counts as half: four 9-hole rounds are two, six are three)

catalogRow.theySee: A note above the figures: "Early read. One round matches these filters, so the averages and trends will move a lot. Strokes gained shows once a player has three rounds with shots." With more rounds than that it says how many match and how they count ("4 rounds match these filters, 2 counting 9-hole rounds as half, so the averages..."). The figures still draw. Three whole rounds, or no filter, say nothing

40415.name: THE_SHEETS_ROUND_LIST_HAS_NOTHING_TO
40415.meaning: The sheet's round list (Only these, Exclude these) has nothing to offer

catalogRow.theySee: "No rounds to pick from." + "Nothing matches the round type, course and time above. Widen them, then pick." Or, when the range starts before the season, "Rounds before Aug 1 load once the range is applied. Apply it, then open Filter again to pick among them."

40416.name: THE_SHEETS_ROUND_LIST_IS_CUT_AT
40416.meaning: The sheet's round list is cut at 200 rounds

catalogRow.theySee: "Showing the newest 200 of 250 rounds. Narrow the time or the course to reach the rest." under the list

40417.name: A_FILTER_IS_ON_AND_SEASON_BESTS
40417.meaning: A filter is on and Season bests is showing

catalogRow.theySee: The card's subtitle reads "Countable rounds since August · the filter does not apply here": the bests are the whole season's and do not follow the filter. Without a filter it reads "Countable rounds since August"

40418.name: THE_FILTER_LETS_9_HOLE_ROUNDS_IN
40418.meaning: The filter lets 9-hole rounds in (Holes: 9 holes or Both)

catalogRow.theySee: A note under the count line: "Per-round figures are per 18 holes: a 9-hole round counts as half a round." The chip reads "9 holes" or "18 and 9 holes" and the count line names the lengths ("3 rounds: 9-hole rounds, last 10"). Scoring, putts, birdies and strokes gained are per 18 holes (a 38 over nine holes is a 76); the rates pool the holes. At the default of 18 holes it says nothing

40419.name: NO_ROUND_OF_THE_DEFAULT_LENGTH_BUT
40419.meaning: No round of the default length (18 holes), but the team has 9-hole rounds in this window

catalogRow.theySee: Above CH-4301 (on Season too: a team with only 9-hole rounds this season is not a first run, D-71): "This team has 9-hole rounds in this window, which the 18-hole view leaves out. Choose 9 holes or Both in Filter to see them." Not shown when a filter is on (that is CH-4313), when there are rounds to show, or when Both would show nothing in this window (no 9-hole round of its time, such as a 9-hole practice round on Qualifiers, or one from before the season)

40501.name: EXPORT_CELLS_ARE_TEXT
40501.meaning: The CSV export writes a player's name that starts with =, +, - or @ (or a tab or a return) as text, with a leading apostrophe, so a spreadsheet never reads it as a formula; numbers are left as numbers.

40502.name: THE_FILTERS_DATE_RANGE_STARTS_AFTER_IT
40502.meaning: The filter's date range starts after it ends, and Done is tapped

catalogRow.theySee: "The start date is after the end date. Swap them, or clear one." under the dates, which are marked invalid; the start date takes focus and a warning plays; nothing is requested and the sheet stays open. Nothing is said while they are still typing

40601.name: THE_BROWSER_BLOCKS_THE_CSV_EXPORT
40601.meaning: The browser blocks the CSV export

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t export team stats" + "Your browser blocked the download. Try a desktop browser." Done: "Team stats exported"

40602.name: TEAM_ROUNDS_DONT_LOAD
40602.meaning: Team rounds (or the roster) don't load

catalogRow.theySee: The page's failure (CH-1211: the page empty in the danger tone, an alert, under the head, desktop and phone): "Team rounds didn’t load" + "Every figure would be incomplete, so none is shown. Try again; the error has been reported." with Try again first (offline, CH-1905). No figure is shown half-built, the header drops its count of active players (a roster that did not load is not "0 active"), and Export is hidden

40603.name: PER_ROUND_FIGURES_DONT_LOAD
40603.meaning: Per-round figures (greens, putts, scrambling) don't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Some team figures didn’t load" + "Scoring is correct; greens, putts and scrambling are missing." Try again; those cards read "—". With a second part failing, the page's notice (CH-1209) under the head carries the one Try again and this keeps only its title (covered)

"Team putting didn’t load" Try again, in the putting card's place. With a second part failing, the page's notice (CH-1209) under the head carries the one Try again and this keeps only its title (covered)

40605.name: THE_FIGURE_CARDS_CRASH_IN_THE_BROWSER
40605.meaning: The figure cards crash, in the browser or on the first (server) render

catalogRow.theySee: "Team figures couldn’t be shown" + "The rest of the page is fine…" Try again. With a second section crashing, the page's one notice (CH-1210) under the head names them and carries the one Try again, and each keeps only its title (the page's sections are one `SectionGroup`, desktop and phone)
catalogRow.how: `SectionBoundary stats.team.figures`, with a `Suspense` inside it so a server-render crash is retried in the browser instead of failing the page (the same for CH-4205 to CH-4208; preview `?state=crash`)

catalogRow.theySee: "The trend chart couldn’t be shown." …

40607.name: THE_LEG_TRENDS_OR_THE_PLAYER_GRID
40607.meaning: The leg trends or the player grid crash

catalogRow.theySee: "Strokes gained by leg couldn’t be shown." …
"Team putting couldn’t be shown." …
"Season bests couldn’t be shown." …
Greens and putting bands compare with the sample instead of "Tour averages 67%"; nothing claims a benchmark it doesn't have

40611.name: THE_TEAMS_OWN_DETAILS_DONT_LOAD
40611.meaning: The team's own details (name, men's or women's) don't load

catalogRow.theySee: The header reads "Your team"; greens and putting compare with the sample and the trend's dashed line is "the baseline", so no benchmark of the wrong tour is claimed

40612.name: THE_SEASONS_LONGEST_PUTT_DOESNT_LOAD
40612.meaning: The season's longest putt doesn't load (the one-row read of Season bests)

catalogRow.theySee: "The longest putt didn’t load" + "The other bests are right." Try again, under the bests that did load (covered under CH-1209 when another part fails too); "No season bests yet" is not said, and the line is not left out as if nobody had holed a long putt

40701.name: CHANGING_THE_WINDOW_WHILE_OFFLINE
40701.meaning: Changing the window (the switch, or Show the season) or the round filter while offline

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t open the season: you’re offline" + "Reconnect, then try again. The figures shown are still the last 10 rounds." A filter change says "Couldn’t apply the filter: you’re offline" + "Reconnect, then try again. The figures shown are still the rounds you had." Nothing is requested, the control stays where it was, and the OS error pattern plays

40702.name: A_WINDOW_CHANGE_TAKES_LONGER_THAN_5
40702.meaning: A window or filter change takes longer than 5 seconds

catalogRow.theySee: "Still loading the season…" + "This is taking longer than usual. The figures shown are still the last 10 rounds.", once (a filter change: "Still loading the filtered rounds…"); the page stays dimmed and busy (CH-4402) until the new window lands

40703.name: A_WINDOW_OR_FILTER_CHANGE_IS_IN
40703.meaning: A window or filter change is in flight (after a beat of 150 ms; one that lands at once never shows it)

catalogRow.theySee: A pill under the top bar names the figures still on screen: "Showing the last 10 rounds, loading the season" (a filter change: "Showing the rounds you had, applying the filter"). The switch has already moved to the new choice; the figures stay, dimmed (CH-4402), and this keeps them from being read as the new period. A quick change back to what is on screen (Season, Qualifiers, Season) ends with the last tap: no pill and no CH-4902 notice. Fixed, so it moves nothing

40801.name: COACH_ONLY_TEAM_STATS
40801.meaning: Team stats is a coach's page: a player on /golf/dashboard/stats gets their own profile and no team figure is read for them, and the old address /golf/dashboard/stats/team opens /golf/dashboard/stats.

40802.name: TEAM_IS_THE_COACHS_OWN
40802.meaning: The team is always the one resolveClubhouseTeam gives the signed-in coach, never one named in the address: the loader reads that team's row, its active roster (golf_team_members by team_id, status active) and only those players' rounds; a coach with no team gets the no-team state and nothing is read.

40901.name: EXPORT_LANDED
40901.meaning: Export downloads the player grid as a CSV named for the team and window (for example varsity-stats-season.csv), one row per player with a round in the window, and a toast says Team stats exported with the success haptic; with nothing to export there is no button.

41201.name: CHOICES_KEPT_ACROSS_WINDOWS
41201.meaning: Changing the window keeps the chosen leg and the focused player on the page while the new figures arrive.

41401.name: TRY_AGAIN_REFRESHES_THE_PAGE
41401.meaning: Try again on a failed-read notice (team rounds, round figures, putting) asks the server for the whole page again (router.refresh), so every read is retried, not one section's.

41601.name: FOCUSING_A_PLAYER_ON_THE_TREND
41601.meaning: Focusing a player on the trend

catalogRow.theySee: Pointing at or tabbing to a player's name or line brings their line forward in green, drawn over the others, while the others fade back (180ms); moving away returns to the chosen player, and a press chooses them (the note, the legend and the grid follow the choice). Instant with reduced motion

The card takes the green ring (180ms) and the grid, re-sorted by that leg, settles in with its column ringed: a 6px rise (260ms) while the old order fades out (180ms), hidden from assistive tech. Instant with reduced motion
Strokes gained and Scoring crossfade with a 6px rise (base in, quick out); the old plot is hidden from assistive tech while it fades. Instant with reduced motion
catalogRow.test: strokes-gained.test › sorted by the window’s mean

catalogRow.theySee: As on a player's profile (CH-5604): each changed figure crossfades to its new value (the gauges move with the data). No count-up. Instant with reduced motion
catalogRow.how: Not drawn since the figure tape replaced `FigureCards` (removed 2026-10-21): the tape's values change in place. Reserved

41701.name: CHOOSING_A_LEG_FOCUSING_A_PLAYER_CHANGING
41701.meaning: Choosing a leg, focusing a player, changing the window or lens

catalogRow.theySee: A selection tick
The OS success pattern / the OS error pattern (D-70)

41703.name: SORTING_THE_PHONES_PLAYERS_BY_AVG_OR
41703.meaning: Sorting the phone's players by Avg or SG, or picking a strokes gained leg (a row of the leg list: Off the tee, Approach, Around green, Putting or Team total)

catalogRow.theySee: A selection tick; the current sort or leg is silent. A leg sets the team figure to it at once (no digits roll) and ranks the players by it on SG (the sort moves to SG with no second tick)
catalogRow.how: `StatsTeamPhone` `Segmented`; the leg rows are Base UI `Tabs` (vertical)
catalogRow.test: stats-team.test › phone players sort; leg row picks the leg

41704.name: CHOOSING_A_ROUND_TYPE_A_LENGTH_A
41704.meaning: Choosing a round type, a length (18 holes, 9 holes, Both), a course or a round in the filter sheet, choosing a window or a pick mode there, or removing a chip / Clear

catalogRow.theySee: A selection tick. Done is a primary button and taps lightly; a range error plays the warning pattern (CH-4101)

41801.name: THE_TREND_CHART_IS_AN_IMAGE_WITH
41801.meaning: The trend chart is an image with a written summary ("Strokes gained by week. The team has gained about 1.0 a round…"); the player list beside it is the chart's values as buttons

41802.name: THE_STROKES_GAINED_GRID_IS_A_TABLE
41802.meaning: The strokes gained grid is a table with a header for every value

41803.name: LOSS_AMBER_ON_A_TINTED_GRID_CELL
41803.meaning: Loss amber on a tinted grid cell is darkened to hold 4.5:1

41804.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_STATE
41804.meaning: No axe violations in any preview state, 1280px and 390px

41805.name: THE_PHONES_SCORING_LINE_IS_AN_IMAGE
41805.meaning: The phone's scoring line is an image with a written reading ("Team scoring average by round day, from 74.8 to 73.4. Down 1.4 strokes…"); a finger on it reads a round day (pointer only, the reading carries it for assistive technology); each player row is one link read as name, rounds, average and strokes gained ("Early read" under three rounds)

41806.name: THE_ROUND_FILTER_THE_FILTER_BUTTON_SAYS
41806.meaning: The round filter: the Filter button says it opens a dialog and how many filters are on; each chip is a button named "Remove filter: Tournament"; Clear is "Clear filters"; the count line is a polite status region; the sheet is a labelled dialog whose groups (Round type, Holes, Time, Course, Pick rounds) are labelled, round type, holes and pick mode are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`), courses and rounds are checkboxes in labelled lists, and the dates are labelled inputs whose error is their description

41901.name: PHONE_VIEW
41901.meaning: At 820px and below Team stats is the phone view (window switch, four figures, scoring line, strokes gained by leg, players sorted by Avg or SG, team putting), never a shrunken desktop; the server renders desktop and the phone view takes over at hydration.

42001.name: KEYBOARD_PATH
42001.meaning: The window switch moves and chooses with the arrow keys, a leg card takes Enter, the ranked dot plot reads a player with the arrow keys and opens them with Enter, and a grid row is a link that marks its player on the trend when it takes focus.

42101.name: ONE_PASS_LOADER
42101.meaning: loadTeamStats reads the team and its roster together, starts the D1 benchmarks before the rounds come back, then reads the round figures and the putts together, once each (id chunks in parallel); every failed read is logged and flagged, never thrown.

42301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
42301.meaning: A failed read is logged through chLogServer('stats', team|members|rounds|roundCache|putts|tourBenchmarks); a section crash is reported through chReport with its surface (stats.team.figures, trend, legs, putting, bests) at high severity, a blocked export at low severity as stats.team.export; a window change and a focused player leave a chTrail breadcrumb.

42401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
42401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/stats-team.test.tsx names, in a test title, every Stats team catalog code it forces (the rows whose Test column names it) and each hand contract above.

50101.name: PROFILE_READY
50101.meaning: A profile opens on Overview for the window in the address: who (name, status, class, hometown), four hero figures, the four sections (Overview, Game detail, Rounds, Development) and the comparison table; a coach also gets Message, Add focus area, a way back to Team stats and the previous/next pager; on the phone, the phone profile.

50102.name: TAB_AND_WINDOW_FROM_THE_ADDRESS
50102.meaning: ?tab=overview, game, rounds or dev opens that tab and anything else opens Overview (Roster's All N uses tab=rounds); ?window=season or ?window=qualifiers opens that window and anything else opens Last 10.

50103.name: COACH_PAGES_THROUGH_THE_TEAM
50103.meaning: A coach pages through the active team ordered by scoring average with Previous player and Next player (N of M), wrapping from the last player to the first, and each link keeps the window.

50104.name: MESSAGE_OPENS_THE_PLAYERS_THREAD
50104.meaning: A coach's Message on a profile (the desktop button, the phone header icon) opens Messages on the direct thread with that player (?player=<golf_players.id>); a player's own profile has no Message.

50201.name: A_PLAYERS_STATS_ARE_LOADING_THEIR_OWN
50201.meaning: A player's stats are loading: their own, or a coach's `?player=`

catalogRow.theySee: The profile's shape in place: hero with avatar, name and four figures, the tabs and the window switch, then a chart frame (the team page keeps CH-4401)
catalogRow.how: `StatsProfileSkeleton` via `StatsRouteSkeleton` in the route's loading.tsx (the shell's role and `?player=`)

50202.name: A_PLAYERS_ANSWER_TO_A_PROPOSED_FOCUS
50202.meaning: A player's answer to a proposed focus area is being sent

catalogRow.theySee: The pressed button reads "Accepting…" or "Declining…" and both are disabled until it lands

50203.name: A_GOAL_IS_BEING_STARTED_A_SUGGESTION
50203.meaning: A goal is being started, a suggestion answered, or a goal changed

catalogRow.theySee: The pressed button reads "Starting…", "Dismissing…", "Pausing…", "Resuming…" or "Abandoning…" and its neighbours are disabled until it lands

50204.name: SET_A_GOAL_THE_STARTING_POINT_FOR
50204.meaning: Set a goal: the starting point for the chosen stat is being looked up

catalogRow.theySee: Under the Target field: "Finding your starting point…"; the field's placeholder says the same. A new stat starts it again and clears a filled-in target

50301.name: A_FOCUS_AREA_IS_BEING_PROPOSED
50301.meaning: A focus area is being proposed

catalogRow.theySee: The button reads "Adding…" and can't be pressed again

50302.name: CHANGING_THE_WINDOW_OR_THE_PLAYER
50302.meaning: Changing the window, the round filter or the player (pager)

catalogRow.theySee: The page dims and is marked busy until the new rounds land; the scroll position stays

50401.name: NO_ROUNDS_WITH_SHOTS_IN_THE_WINDOW
50401.meaning: No rounds with shots in the window

catalogRow.theySee: "No shot-by-shot rounds in this window." + "Game detail fills in from rounds posted hole by hole with shots. Totals-only rounds still count toward scoring."
"No rounds in this window." + "Try This season to see every round posted since August."
"No focus areas yet." + (coach) "Add one from a weak leg in Game detail." / (player) "Your coach adds focus areas; they show here."
"No goals set." + who sets them

50405.name: FEWER_THAN_THREE_ROUNDS_IN_THE_WINDOW
50405.meaning: Fewer than three whole rounds in the window (or under the round filter; a 9-hole round counts as half)

catalogRow.theySee: "Early read. Luca has 2 countable rounds in this window, so averages and trends will move a lot. Strokes gained shows once there are three." With 9-hole rounds in it says how the whole rounds come out: "4 countable rounds, 2 counting 9-hole rounds as half"

50406.name: THREE_OR_MORE_ROUNDS_IN_THE_WINDOW
50406.meaning: Three or more rounds in the window but fewer than three with shots (strokes gained needs three rounds posted with shots)

catalogRow.theySee: "Strokes gained needs three rounds posted with shots. Jonah has 1 of 5 rounds with shots in this window (with 9-hole rounds in: "4 of 6 rounds with shots (2 counting 9-hole rounds as half)"), so strokes gained shows a dash until there are three." (the phone says "You have" to a player). Fewer than three rounds keeps CH-5305
catalogRow.how: `StatsPlayer`, `StatsPlayerPhone`; keys on `win.effSgRounds`, the rounds with shots in whole rounds

50407.name: PHONE_NO_STROKES_GAINED_IN_THE_WINDOW
50407.meaning: No strokes gained in the window (no leg and no total)

catalogRow.theySee: Phone: the Strokes gained panel; desktop: chapter 1's "Where the strokes go" (OverviewZones). Either reads "No strokes gained in this window." + "Strokes gained by leg appears after three rounds with shots." instead of bars of dashes

50408.name: THE_LAST_10_WINDOW_HAS_NO_EARLIER
50408.meaning: The last-10 window has no earlier rounds to set strokes gained against (none, or fewer than three with shots)

catalogRow.theySee: Under the SG / round figure, where the change chip would be: "No earlier rounds" (or "Too few earlier rounds with shots"). The season and qualifier windows have no previous window by design and say nothing

50409.name: HOLES_WERE_SCORED_IN_THE_WINDOW_BUT
50409.meaning: Holes were scored in the window but none has been played three times

catalogRow.theySee: Toughest holes: "Need 3+ plays of a hole before it can be ranked. No hole has been played that often in this window yet."

50410.name: A_ROUND_TYPE_WITH_NO_ROUNDS_IN
50410.meaning: A round type with no rounds in the window (practice, qualifying, tournament)

catalogRow.theySee: By round type: the tile reads "—" and "No rounds", never an average of nothing

50411.name: THE_ROUNDS_TAB_HAS_NO_EARLIER_WINDOW
50411.meaning: The Rounds tab has no earlier window to compare with

catalogRow.theySee: "Comparing starts at 13 rounds: the newest 10 against at least 3 before them." (Last 10), "Needs 3 earlier 18-hole rounds: fewer than 13 match these filters." (a filtered Last 10), "Needs 3 earlier rounds before the newest 10 that match these filters, counting a 9-hole round as half." (Last 10 with 9 holes or Both), "The season has no earlier window to compare with." (Season), "Qualifier rounds have no earlier window to compare with." (Qualifiers)

50412.name: A_PER_ROUND_LINE_HAS_FEWER_THAN
50412.meaning: A per-round line has fewer than two rounds with the figure (score by round, fairways, greens, putts)

catalogRow.theySee: "A line needs two rounds with fairway holes; this window has 1." (the score line: "A line needs two rounds; this window has 1.")

50413.name: NO_TEE_SHOTS_OR_APPROACHES_WITH_A
50413.meaning: No tee shots or approaches with a finish are logged in the window

catalogRow.theySee: Where shots finish: "No tee shots with a finish are logged in this window." / "No approach shots with a finish are logged in this window."

50414.name: APPROACH_PROXIMITY_AGAINST_THE_TOUR_A_RANGE
50414.meaning: Approach proximity against the Tour: a range under 10 shots, or no approaches with a finish distance

catalogRow.theySee: The range is left ungraded and named: "175+ yards: 7 shots, under 10"; with none: "No approach shots with a finish distance are logged in this window."

50415.name: A_MORE_DETAIL_PANEL_WITH_NO_DATA
50415.meaning: A More detail panel with no data behind it (outcomes by par, hole-out, toughest holes, fairways by tee type, tee miss by club, strokes to hole out, misses by distance, sand saves, up and downs, up and down by miss direction, finish after the chip, putting by distance, break tables, practice target, the Tour table)

catalogRow.theySee: One plain line in the panel, in its own words ("No par 4 or par 5 tee shots are logged in this window."; "No distance and break has 8 putts yet, so there is no reliable practice target."); a figure with none is a dash

50416.name: A_STANDING_TABLE_ROW_IS_UNDER_ITS
50416.meaning: A standing-table row is under its sample floor

catalogRow.theySee: Under the row's label, while it has no value: "Needs 10 approaches from the range.", "Needs 10 putts in the band.", "Needs 3 tournament or qualifier rounds and 3 practice rounds.", "Needs 5 rounds scored hole by hole."
catalogRow.how: `OverviewZones` (`.ch-zfloor`; the standing table `FieldTable` it replaced was removed 2026-10-21)

50417.name: THE_WINDOW_HAS_MORE_18_HOLE_ROUNDS
50417.meaning: The window has more 18-hole rounds than the shot-level reads take (100)

catalogRow.theySee: Under the Game detail tabs: "This window has more rounds than the shot-level figures read, so they cover the newest 100."

50418.name: THE_ROUND_FILTER_LEAVES_NONE_OF_THIS
50418.meaning: The round filter leaves none of this player's rounds

catalogRow.theySee: "No rounds match these filters." + "Try a wider time, fewer round types, or clear the filters to see every round again." + Clear filters, in place of the Overview, Game detail and Rounds content (on the phone, above Development). Development stays: focus areas and goals do not depend on rounds. No "early read" of nothing (CH-5305 and CH-5308 are not shown). The Filter button, the chips and the count line stay

50419.name: THE_SHEETS_ROUND_LIST_HAS_NOTHING_TO
50419.meaning: The sheet's round list (Only these, Exclude these) has nothing to offer

catalogRow.theySee: "No rounds to pick from." + "Nothing matches the round type, course and time above. Widen them, then pick." Or, when the range starts before the season, "Rounds before Aug 1 load once the range is applied. Apply it, then open Filter again to pick among them."

50420.name: THE_SHEETS_ROUND_LIST_IS_CUT_AT
50420.meaning: The sheet's round list is cut at 200 rounds

catalogRow.theySee: "Showing the newest 200 of 250 rounds. Narrow the time or the course to reach the rest." under the list

50421.name: THE_FILTER_LETS_9_HOLE_ROUNDS_IN
50421.meaning: The filter lets 9-hole rounds in (Holes: 9 holes or Both)

catalogRow.theySee: A note under the count line: "Per-round figures are per 18 holes: a 9-hole round counts as half a round." The chip reads "9 holes" or "18 and 9 holes". Scoring, putts, birdies, strokes gained and the trend are per 18 holes (a 9-hole score is doubled, and the lines say so); the rates pool the holes; personal bests list 18-hole and 9-hole rounds apart; Game detail says how the rounds count. At the default of 18 holes it says nothing

50422.name: NO_ROUND_OF_THE_DEFAULT_LENGTH_BUT
50422.meaning: No round of the default length (18 holes), but this player has 9-hole rounds in this window

catalogRow.theySee: Above the figures: "Jonah has 9-hole rounds in this window, which the 18-hole view leaves out. Choose 9 holes or Both in Filter to see them." (a player sees "You have"). Not shown when a filter is on (that is CH-5320), when there are rounds to show, or when Both would show nothing in this window

50423.name: SET_A_GOAL_NO_STARTING_POINT_TO
50423.meaning: Set a goal: no starting point to base a target on (the stat has no standing yet, or the look-up failed)

catalogRow.theySee: Under the Target field: "No starting point yet. Set a target to aim for." or "Couldn’t look up your starting point. You can still set a target." The field is empty for the player to fill in

50501.name: A_FOCUS_AREA_WITH_A_NAME_UNDER
50501.meaning: A focus area with a name under three characters

catalogRow.theySee: "Give it a short name, at least three characters." under the field, which takes focus; a warning haptic; nothing is sent

50502.name: THE_FILTERS_DATE_RANGE_STARTS_AFTER_IT
50502.meaning: The filter's date range starts after it ends, and Done is tapped

catalogRow.theySee: "The start date is after the end date. Swap them, or clear one." under the dates, which are marked invalid; the start date takes focus and a warning plays; nothing is requested and the sheet stays open

50503.name: SET_A_GOAL_THE_TARGET_IS_EMPTY
50503.meaning: Set a goal: the target is empty or not a number

catalogRow.theySee: Under the field, in the error ink: "Enter a target number to aim for."; nothing is sent and the field takes focus. The fill-in note comes back once it is a number

"Couldn’t add the focus area for Jonah" + "Your text is still here. Try again in a moment." Retry; the sheet stays open with the text. Done: "Focus area proposed to Jonah. It starts when Jonah accepts."

"Rounds didn’t load." + "Posted rounds are safe. Every figure that reads them would be incomplete, so they’re hidden." Try again. The hero reads "—" for scoring average, strokes gained and the season's rounds, the Rounds tab and the phone's header carry no count, no early-read note shows, and the Overview, Game detail and Rounds tabs draw no figure and no empty state (Development still shows)
Game detail reads "Shot-level detail didn’t load." + "Scores and rounds above are correct…" Try again, never zeros

50604.name: FOCUS_AREAS_OR_GOALS_DONT_LOAD
50604.meaning: Focus areas or goals don't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Some development items didn’t load." Try again, above what did load
"The overview couldn’t be shown." + "The rest of the page is fine…" Try again; the tabs still work
"Game detail couldn’t be shown." …
"The rounds table couldn’t be shown." …
"Development couldn’t be shown." …

50609.name: D1_BENCHMARKS_DONT_LOAD
50609.meaning: Tour benchmarks don't load, or the team's own row (its men's or women's tour) doesn't

catalogRow.theySee: With no benchmark at all the profile leaves the Tour column out and each figure's context reads the sample ("10 rounds") instead of "vs. Tour"; when only some benchmarks exist the rest of the column reads "—". An unknown tour reads no benchmark, so a women's team is never graded against the men's

50610.name: SHARING_A_PLAYERS_STATS_FROM_THE_PHONE
50610.meaning: Sharing a player's stats from the phone fails (the browser blocks the clipboard)

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t share the link" + "Your browser blocked it. Try again, or copy the address from the browser." Error haptic. Closing the share sheet is not a failure. Done: "Link copied"

50611.name: PROFILE_READ_FAILURE_RAISES_ROUTE_ERROR
50611.meaning: When the player row or the roster membership read fails, the loader logs it and throws, so the route error view (with Try again) shows; a profile is never reported as That player isn't on your team unless a read that worked found nobody.

50612.name: A_PLAYERS_ACCEPT_OF_A_PROPOSED_FOCUS
50612.meaning: A player's Accept of a proposed focus area fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t accept Lag putting" + Retry; it stays waiting. Done: "Started · Lag putting" and the page reads again

50613.name: A_PLAYERS_DECLINE_OF_A_PROPOSED_FOCUS
50613.meaning: A player's Decline of a proposed focus area fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t decline Lag putting" + Retry; it stays waiting. Done: "Declined · Lag putting"

50614.name: THE_HOLE_READ_FAILS
50614.meaning: The hole read fails (the window's scored holes)

catalogRow.theySee: Scoring › More detail › Toughest holes reads "Toughest holes didn’t load." + "The rest of Game detail is correct. Try again; the error has been reported." The table's Opening hole row is a dash, never "no holes"
Approach › Proximity against the Tour reads "Proximity against the Tour didn’t load." + Try again; the table's three proximity rows are dashes. The rest of Game detail stays
Putting › Make rate by distance: "Putts past 20 feet didn’t load." + Try again; the curve stops at 20 feet, where the shot stats end

Off the tee and Approach › Where shots finish: "Where shots finish didn’t load." + Try again. (Production's own action answers a failed read with an empty response, so that failure reads as CH-5315, not this)
"Some round figures didn’t load." + Try again above the overview figures

50619.name: SHARING_A_PERSONAL_BEST_CARD_FAILS
50619.meaning: Sharing a personal-best card fails (the share sheet or the download is blocked)

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t share the card" + "Try again, or save the image from the preview." Error haptic. Closing the share sheet is not a failure; a share closes the sheet with the success haptic

50620.name: STARTING_A_GOAL_FAILS
50620.meaning: Starting a goal fails (Set a goal)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t start the goal" + the server's sentence when it is readable ("The target must be better than where the player is now, or the goal is met on day one."), else "What you entered is still here. Try again in a moment." + Retry; the sheet stays open with the stat, length and target. Done: "Goal started" ("Goal started. That is more than five active goals, so consider finishing one." past five), the sheet closes and the page reads again
"Couldn’t start Strokes gained: approach" + Retry; it stays suggested. Done: "Goal started · Strokes gained: approach" and the page reads again
"Couldn’t dismiss Greens in regulation" + Retry; it stays suggested. Done: "Suggestion dismissed"

50623.name: A_COACH_PAUSES_RESUMES_OR_ABANDONS_A
50623.meaning: A coach pauses, resumes or abandons a goal and it fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t pause Putting" (resume, abandon) + "Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment." or the server's sentence + Retry. Done: "Paused · Putting", "Resumed · Putting", "Abandoned · Putting", and the page reads again

50624.name: THE_PLAYERS_SUGGESTED_GOALS_DONT_LOAD
50624.meaning: The player's suggested goals don't load (the read of `golf_goal_suggestions` failed)

catalogRow.theySee: In the Goals section, above the goals: "Suggested goals didn’t load." + "Your goals are fine. Try again in a moment." + Try again. Not drawn as "no suggestions"

50625.name: COACHHELMS_READS_DONT_LOAD_FOR_GAME_DETAIL
50625.meaning: CoachHelm's reads don't load for Game detail (the gate, the visible reads, the player's dismissals or the newest rounds)

catalogRow.theySee: An inline notice under the section chips: "CoachHelm’s reads didn’t load" + "The sections don’t say how many there are." + Try again, which re-runs the page's read (F-0061). No section draws a count line (never "0 reads"); the rest of Game detail stays

50701.name: CHANGING_THE_WINDOW_WHILE_OFFLINE
50701.meaning: Changing the window (the switch, on desktop or the phone) or the round filter while offline

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t open the season: you’re offline" + "Reconnect, then try again. The figures shown are still the last 10 rounds." A filter change says "Couldn’t apply the filter: you’re offline" + "Reconnect, then try again. The figures shown are still the rounds you had." Nothing is requested, the control stays where it was, and the OS error pattern plays

50702.name: A_WINDOW_CHANGE_TAKES_LONGER_THAN_5
50702.meaning: A window or filter change takes longer than 5 seconds

catalogRow.theySee: "Still loading the season…" + "This is taking longer than usual. The figures shown are still the last 10 rounds.", once (a filter change: "Still loading the filtered rounds…"); the page stays dimmed and busy (CH-5402) until the new window lands

50703.name: A_WINDOW_OR_FILTER_CHANGE_IS_IN
50703.meaning: A window or filter change is in flight (after a beat of 150 ms; one that lands at once never shows it)

catalogRow.theySee: A pill under the top bar names the figures still on screen: "Showing the last 10 rounds, loading the season" (a filter change: "Showing the rounds you had, applying the filter"). The switch has already moved to the new choice; the figures stay, dimmed (CH-5402), and this keeps them from being read as the new period. A quick change back to what is on screen (Season, Qualifiers, Season) ends with the last tap: no pill and no CH-5902 notice. Fixed, so it moves nothing

50801.name: A_COACH_OPENS_A_PLAYER_WHO_ISNT
50801.meaning: A coach opens a player who isn't on their team

catalogRow.theySee: The page empty state (v2 medallion): "That player isn’t on your team" + "They may have been removed, or the link is from another team." + Back to team stats. Also for a link whose id is not an id, and for a pending or removed member; a read that fails raises the route error view instead (Try again), never this

50802.name: A_PLAYER_WHO_ISNT_ON_AN_ACTIVE
50802.meaning: A player who isn't on an active roster

catalogRow.theySee: The page empty state (v2 medallion): "Your stats aren’t available" + "You aren’t on an active team roster right now." Reached only when the team resolved but the roster has no row for the player when the profile is read; a player with no active team at all sees CH-4309, "You aren’t on a team yet"

50803.name: PLAYER_SEES_ONLY_OWN_STATS
50803.meaning: A player always gets their own profile: ?player= is never read, the loader is asked for the caller's own id as a player view (only their rounds, D1 comparisons, no team average, no pager), and the page has no Message, no Add focus area and no way to the team.

50804.name: COACH_OPENS_ROSTERED_PLAYERS_ONLY
50804.meaning: A coach's ?player= is read against the coach's own team from the session: a player who is active or inactive on it opens; another team's player, a pending or removed member, and an id that is not shaped like an id all open That player isn't on your team, and the last makes no read.

50805.name: SERVER_REFUSAL_IS_NOT_ZEROS
50805.meaning: Shot-level detail is read through getDetailedStats for the profile's own player id, which answers empty to a caller who is neither the player nor their coach; empty detail for a window that has rounds shows as Shot-level detail didn't load, never as zeros.

50806.name: ONLY_A_COACH_PROPOSES_FOCUS_AREAS
50806.meaning: The Add focus area buttons and sheet exist only for a coach viewing a profile (the route hands a coach id only to a coach); a player's profile never offers them.

50901.name: FOCUS_AREA_PROPOSED
50901.meaning: A proposal that lands sends a focus area for this player from this coach with status proposed, names itself in a toast (Focus area proposed to the player; it starts when they accept) with the success haptic, closes the sheet and empties its fields.

51101.name: A_COACH_PRESSES_ABANDON_ON_A_GOAL
51101.meaning: A coach presses Abandon on a goal

catalogRow.theySee: "Abandon this goal?" + "Putting stops tracking progress and stays in the list marked Abandoned." + Keep it / Abandon goal ("Abandoning…"). Keep it changes nothing

51201.name: FOCUS_TEXT_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
51201.meaning: A focus area that fails to save keeps the sheet open with the area and the text the coach typed, and the toast says so.

51202.name: TAB_KEPT_ACROSS_WINDOWS_AND_PLAYERS
51202.meaning: The chosen tab stays when the window changes or the coach pages to another player.

60101.name: CALENDAR_READY
60101.meaning: Calendar opens on the week that holds today, for a coach and for a player: the month, the count of team events this week and the team's zone, the week grid, and beside it the day's panel (today's events, what needs attention, where the data comes from); a coach also gets New event. 60102.name: ADDRESS_HOLDS_VIEW_DAY_AND_EVENT

A value that is not real (an unknown view, an impossible date such as 2026-02-30) falls back to the week and to today, an event that is no longer in the loaded range says so (CH-6305), and changing the view or the day rewrites the address.

60103.name: SEEDS_FROM_OTHER_PAGES
60103.meaning: ?new=1 opens New event once for a coach and drops itself from the address; &with=<player> makes it a meeting with only that player invited (a player the Calendar does not list invites nobody, never the team); &type= picks the new event's type from those a coach can create and ignores anything else.

60104.name: TIMES_ARE_THE_TEAMS_ZONE
60104.meaning: The loader reads every event that overlaps its window (it starts before the window ends and ends on or after its start), not only those that start in it, so a trip that began before the window fills the window's first days. Every time is resolved on the server in the team's timezone (Eastern time until the team sets one, and the page says so): a timed event is filed under its local day and hour; one that runs past midnight is on every day it covers, as production's calendar places it (its start to midnight, whole days, midnight to its end; one that ends at midnight exactly holds nothing of the next day), each day naming its part (From 7:00 AM, All day, Until 4:30 PM) and the panel the run's start and end; editing, Duplicate and a series edit from any of its days send the run's first day, start, last day and end, and in the week it is one bar in the all-day lane that drags by whole days with its times kept (P-4 4.5); an all-day event keeps its stored dates, one entry for each day of a span. The team's trips are read beside the events (golf_travel_itineraries, by team, never a test trip): a trip planned in Team Hub with no calendar event is a read-only all-day Travel row on each day it covers, its detail giving its departure and return times, its place and View itinerary to Team Hub's Travel; a trip linked to an event shows once, as that event (prod audit 2026-11-15, N13P-24).

60180.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_DRAFTS_EACH_PLAYERS_WEEK

Practices and meetings count their length, a qualifier or tournament day counts 3 and the practice round the day before it counts as a practice day, travel and class count nothing, a player marked absent or a no-show counts nothing that day; the limits are the team's (association, season dates, week start) from Settings, Team or its own saved limits, read against cited NCAA bylaws. It is a draft for the coach's CARA form, and the page says so.

60181.name: SAYS_WHO_HAS_A_WARNING_AND_WHY

60644.name: THE_COACH_ISNT_STAFFED_ON_THE_TEAM
60644.meaning: The coach isn't staffed on the team (a permission refusal)

catalogRow.theySee: "Only coaches on this team can set up tournaments."

60645.name: SETTING_UP_THE_TOURNAMENT_FAILS_FOR_ANY

60646.name: THE_QUALIFIER_TO_LINK_ALREADY_COUNTS_TOWARD

60647.name: RESTORING_A_ROUND_THAT_ANOTHER_ROUND_HAS
60647.meaning: Restoring a round that another round has moved in front of

catalogRow.theySee: "R2 can’t come back where it was: R3 is now before it. Move R3 first, then restore R2."

60648.name: A_LINEUP_IS_SENT_BEFORE_4_33S
60648.meaning: A lineup is sent before 4.33's set_entries RPC is applied

60649.name: SAVING_A_ROUND_FROM_THE_CALENDAR_FAILS
60649.meaning: Saving a round from the calendar fails for any other reason

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t save R2. Nothing was changed."

60650.name: CANCELLING_RESTORING_OR_STOPPING_TRACKING_FAILS_FOR
60650.meaning: Cancelling, restoring or stopping tracking fails for any other reason

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t change Pinehurst Invitational. Nothing was changed."

60651.name: THE_TOURNAMENT_CHANGED_SINCE_IT_WAS_OPENED
60651.meaning: The tournament changed since it was opened (a version conflict)

catalogRow.theySee: "This tournament changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest." + Reload; unsaved values stay until then

60652.name: A_ROUNDS_DAY_OR_TIME_IS_SAVED
60652.meaning: A round's day or time is saved from round mode (P-5 4.3)

catalogRow.theySee: "R2 moved to Fri 6 Nov, 8:30 AM" ("Tee times moved with it." when the tee sheet shifted), or "R2 has no tee time now" when made all day. Other changes are the calendar's Saved (CH-6001)

60653.name: ROUND_MODE_FOR_A_TOURNAMENT_EVENT_WHOSE
60653.meaning: Round mode for a tournament event whose round ref didn't load (the calendar's events did)

catalogRow.theySee: A warning notice in place of the banner: "Couldn’t load the tournament for this round. You can still change its time." Only the day and times show, saved through the calendar's own save; blocks show stored titles with no pill

60654.name: A_ROUND_IS_CANCELLED_FROM_THE_CALENDAR
60654.meaning: A round is cancelled from the calendar (CH-6540 confirmed)

catalogRow.theySee: "R2 is cancelled" with Undo. The round strikes through at once; the write waits for the toast to go, so Undo sends nothing and no player hears of it

60655.name: THE_WHOLE_TOURNAMENT_IS_CANCELLED_FROM_THE
60655.meaning: The whole tournament is cancelled from the calendar (CH-6541 confirmed)

catalogRow.theySee: "Pinehurst Invitational is cancelled" with Undo; every round strikes through, written as CH-6042 is

60656.name: A_ROUND_OR_THE_TOURNAMENT_IS_RESTORED
60656.meaning: A round or the tournament is restored

catalogRow.theySee: "R2 is back on the calendar" (or the tournament's name). Written at once, no Undo: restoring is the safe direction

60657.name: A_TOURNAMENT_IS_SET_UP_FROM_THE
60657.meaning: A tournament is set up from the editor (P-5, `golf_tournaments_v1`)

catalogRow.theySee: "Pinehurst Invitational is set up in Tournaments" + Open (the desk). No Undo: players may already have seen it; delete or stop tracking from the desk

60658.name: OPENING_A_FILE_ATTACHED_TO_AN_EVENT
60658.meaning: Opening a file attached to an event fails (the signed link can't be made, or the file has no stored copy)

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t open Local rules" + the reason, or "The file may have been removed. Try again, or attach it again from Documents.", Try again; the tab it opened closes. A file opens through a short-lived signed link per tap (`getPreviewUrl`), never the stored public address (the documents bucket is private). Done: the file opens in a new tab, no toast

60680.name: SAVING_PRACTICE_HOUR_LIMITS_FAILS_PRACTICE_HOURS

Try again.”, Retry; the sheet stays open. Done: “Limits saved”, the sheet closes and the week is read again against them

60681.name: CHANGING_HOW_ONE_EVENT_COUNTS_FAILS_PRACTICE
60681.meaning: Changing how one event counts fails (Practice hours › What counted › Change, coach; F-03)

Try again.”, Retry; the sheet stays open. Done: “Practice round counts 3 hours” / “… doesn’t count” / “… counts as drafted”

60682.name: EXPORTING_THE_PRACTICE_HOURS_FAILS_THE_BROWSER
60682.meaning: Exporting the practice hours fails: the browser refused the file (F-03)

catalogRow.theySee: Error toast “Couldn’t export the practice hours” + “Your browser didn’t take the file. Try again, or export from a computer.” Done: “Practice hours exported · 5 players”; the file (a row a player a day and a row for the week, with the limits and warnings) downloads on a computer or opens the share sheet on a phone

60683.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_THE_WEEKS_EVENTS_DONT_LOAD
60683.meaning: Practice hours: the week's events don't load

“Attendance didn’t load” + “This week is drafted from invitations alone, so a player marked absent may still be counted. Try again.” The week still shows

60685.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_THE_ROSTER_DOESNT_LOAD_COACH
60685.meaning: Practice hours: the roster doesn't load (coach)

catalogRow.theySee: “The roster didn’t load” + “Hours are drafted for each player, so none are shown until it does.” Try again

60686.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_THE_TEAMS_HOURS_TABLES_ARENT
60686.meaning: Practice hours: the team's hours tables aren't in the database yet (migration 20261115232000 held)

catalogRow.theySee: Coach only, a note: “Your own limits and changes can’t be saved yet” + the limits the week is read against (the division from Settings, Team). Limits and Change are hidden; the week still drafts on the defaults

60687.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_THE_WEEKS_TABLE_OR_LIST
60687.meaning: Practice hours: the week's table or list crashes

catalogRow.theySee: “The week couldn’t be shown” in its place; the events and the rules below stay

60688.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_THE_TEAMS_SAVED_LIMITS_DONT
60688.meaning: Practice hours: the team's saved limits don't load (coach; the tables are there)
