Limits and changes can’t be saved yet, so nothing you saved is replaced.” Try again; Limits and Change are hidden, so a save never writes the defaults over the stored seasons and custom limits

60690.name: A_PRACTICES_PLAN_READ_FAILS
60690.meaning: A practice's plan read fails (`readEventPlans` answers an error that is not "table missing"; GAP-S-28)

catalogRow.theySee: In the event sheet, where the plan row goes: "The practice plan didn’t load" + "Nothing you saved is lost. Try again." + Try again. Never Build plan and never "No plan": before, a failed read looked like a practice with no plan. A missing plan table still just leaves the row out

60701.name: FILE_REMOVAL_REFUSES_OFFLINE
60701.meaning: Removing a file from an event, and Undo on that, send nothing while the browser is offline: the file stays where it was, the error haptic fires, and the toast says nothing was changed (the shell's CH-1903 wording).

60801.name: PLAYER_HAS_NO_PLANNING_TOOLS
60801.meaning: A player is never given a planning tool: no New event (button, N key or an editor from ?new=1), no Add busy time or Overlaps in More, no people filter, no responses, attendance, Edit event, Cancel event, Attach or Remove file, and no schedule-overlap marks. The same address for a coach has all of them. Hiding them is a courtesy; every write is checked again by its server action (60806).

60802.name: PLAYER_READS_ONLY_THEIR_OWN_CLASSES
60802.meaning: The loader gives a player only their own classes (another player's class, and one whose owner cannot be resolved, are dropped before they reach the browser) and only themselves as a person; a coach gets every rostered player's classes, each with its owner.

60803.name: PLAYER_GETS_ONLY_THEIR_OWN_REPLY
60803.meaning: A player's data carries, for each event, only their own place on the invite list and their own reply, never a teammate's id or answer, and the screen still finds what they owe from it. A coach's data carries every invitee and every reply.

60804.name: PLAYER_IS_NOT_OFFERED_THE_TEAM_LINK
60804.meaning: In Add to calendar app a player is offered only My schedule; the team link is a coach's, because createCalendarFeed refuses it to anyone else.

60805.name: ROUTE_STOPS_WITHOUT_A_SESSION_OR_TEAM
60805.meaning: With no session the route renders nothing (the page sends the visitor to login); a coach or player with no team gets the no-team page (CH-6307) and nothing is read; a coach is loaded as a coach with their own id and a player as that player with no coach id; a player whose team membership cannot be read throws to the route error view and is never told they have no team.

60806.name: SERVER_ACTIONS_ARE_THE_GATE
60806.meaning: Every write is checked again by its server action and by row-level security, whatever the screen shows: creating, editing and cancelling an event and adding or removing busy time are for a coach, attendance for a coach on the event's team, a team calendar link for a coach, a reply for an active member of the event's team, and attaching or detaching a file for the event's team coaches. Read in this pass, not run: no test here forces a refusal.

60807.name: REPLY_IS_FOR_INVITED_PLAYERS
60807.meaning: A player is offered the reply (Going, Maybe, Can't make it) only on an event that requires an RSVP, whose invite list they are on or that invites no one (the team's: any player may reply, as production allows, golf_event_attendance_insert_self; told "Open to the whole team"; from the rows, an invite list is the rows the coach's invitation wrote, notified_at, so a teammate's own reply keeps it open; and once migration 20261017102000 is applied the count function's coach_invited says the same, so a teammate's reply still keeps it open), that has not started and is not cancelled, locked when the server locks it (`lib/calendar/rsvp.ts`, as Fairway's drawer reads it): a timed event at its stored start, an all-day event 24 hours after its stored UTC midnight, every day of a run with the run, and any event past its reply deadline (`rsvp_deadline`, which Fairway's editor can set). Once it starts the panel says replies are closed; past the deadline it says the deadline the coach set has passed. An event without RSVP (requires_rsvp off or null, the default) shows no reply control, reply counts or badges, Needs attention row or Nudge; the coach panel lists it as Invited. The editor Require RSVP switch is off for a new event and is sent on create, edit and series edit (series only when changed).

60808.name: BUSY_TIME_IS_THE_COACHS_OWN
60808.meaning: Busy time is read only for a coach and only their own rows (coach_id is the signed-in coach), and is never read for a player.

60901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
60901.meaning: A change that goes through the shell's useAction and lands names itself in a toast with the success haptic: Published, Moved or Saved, Cancelled, link ready, Busy time added, Removed, Attached, the player's reply, and the attendance marks saved.

60980.name: LIMITS_SAVED
60980.meaning: Saving limits that pass the check says "Limits saved" with the success haptic, closes the sheet and reads the week again against them.

60981.name: CHANGE_TO_HOW_AN_EVENT_COUNTS_SAVED
60981.meaning: Saving how one event counts says so ("Practice round counts 3 hours", "Travel briefing doesn’t count", "… counts as drafted") with the success haptic, closes the sheet and reads the week again; As drafted removes the change.

60982.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_EXPORT_LANDED
60982.meaning: An export of the week that lands says so ("Practice hours exported · 5 players") with the success haptic: a download on a computer, the share sheet on a phone.

61001.name: EDITOR_WARNS_OF_CLASHES
61001.meaning: While a coach chooses who to invite and when, the editor names who is busy at that time ("Jonah is busy at this time.", and "Busy at this time" beside each name) against classes and other team events. It is a warning and never blocks Publish.

61002.name: OVERLAPS_ARE_FLAGGED_FOR_THE_COACH
61002.meaning: For a coach, a timed team event whose invitee has a class or another team event at the same time is marked: its block and its row are named with "schedule overlap", and its panel offers Review. A player is shown none of it.

catalogRow.theySee: "Cancel Travel briefing?" + "Everyone invited is notified. Replies and attendance are kept, and the event stays on the calendar marked cancelled." For a series, which events; This and following and All in series delete the events, and the question says so: "…These events are removed from the calendar, and their replies and attendance with them." Keep event / Cancel event
"Remove Recruiting call?" + "This block is removed from your calendar." (or every repeat)

"Make a new Team schedule link?" + "The current link stops working right away. Anyone who added it to a calendar app stops getting updates until they add the new link." Keep link / Make a new link. Warning haptic as it opens; focus starts on Keep link, so Enter never confirms. Asked in the link's own row, not a second dialog over the sheet

"Remove the Team schedule link?" + "The link stops working right away, so calendar apps that use it stop getting updates. You can create a new link any time." Keep link / Remove link (red). Same row, same haptic and focus

61105.name: DELETE_PERMANENTLY
61105.meaning: Delete permanently (a cancelled event's menu, coach)

catalogRow.theySee: "Delete Travel briefing permanently?" + "Every reply and attendance record for it is erased. This can’t be undone." Keep event / Delete permanently (red, the warning haptic, D-70)

61106.name: CANCEL_ROUND_FROM_THE_INSPECTORS_MENU_OR
61106.meaning: Cancel round, from the inspector's menu or round mode

catalogRow.theySee: "Cancel R2 of Pinehurst Invitational?" + "Players see it struck through on the calendar. Its lineup and tee times stay, so you can restore it." An optional reason (120). Cancel the whole tournament instead switches to CH-6541. Keep round / Cancel R2 (felt: warning)

61107.name: CANCEL_THE_WHOLE_TOURNAMENT_INSTEAD_FROM_CH
61107.meaning: Cancel the whole tournament instead, from CH-6540

catalogRow.theySee: "Cancel Pinehurst Invitational?" + "All 3 rounds are struck through for players. Nothing is deleted, so you can restore it." Keep tournament / Cancel tournament

61201.name: CLOSING_THE_EVENT_EDITOR_WITH_CHANGES
61201.meaning: Closing the event editor with changes

catalogRow.theySee: "Discard this event?" + "Nothing has been published yet. What you entered is lost." (editing: "Discard your changes?") Keep editing / Discard. Closing untouched just closes

61202.name: FORM_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
61202.meaning: A publish, save or busy-time add that fails leaves the editor or sheet open with every field as typed; nothing is cleared until the write lands.

61203.name: ATTENDANCE_MARKS_KEPT_ON_A_PARTIAL_SAVE
61203.meaning: Saving attendance saves each changed mark on its own: the marks that saved show as Saved, the ones that did not stay Unsaved, and the button offers to save what is left ("Save attendance · 1").

61301.name: REPLY_SHOWS_AT_ONCE
61301.meaning: A player's reply shows as chosen the moment they tap it and goes back to the last answer the server confirmed if the write is refused (CH-6010); the page reads again when it lands.

61302.name: FILE_REMOVAL_SHOWS_AT_ONCE_WITH_UNDO
61302.meaning: Removing a file from an event takes it off the list at once and offers Undo. A refusal brings the file back (CH-6008); Undo attaches it again and reads the list again; an Undo that is refused or throws is reported and told to attach the file again from Documents (CH-6009).

61401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
61401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything the button would have done follows: the editor or sheet closes, the panel clears, the page reads again, the new link shows in place of Create link, the new file shows, and a reply shows as chosen. This holds for publishing or saving an event, cancelling an event, creating a calendar-app link, removing busy time, adding busy time, attaching a file and a player's reply.

61402.name: TRY_AGAIN_REREADS
61402.meaning: Try again on a page notice (busy time, classes, timezone, replies) has the server read the page again; Try again inside a section (calendar-app links, an event's files, documents, attendance) reads only that section and leaves the rest of the page as it was.

61501.name: CHECKED_TIME_IS_THE_SERVERS
61501.meaning: "Checked 2:40 PM" in Sources is the hour, in the team's zone, at which the server read the data; it is not the browser's clock.

catalogRow.theySee: On hover it lifts on a soft shadow and comes to the front (180ms); selected, it takes a green ring (180ms). A press doesn't scale it: the ring is the answer (the shell's CH-1606)

61602.name: DRAGGING_THE_TIME_BAND_IN_FIND_A
61602.meaning: Dragging the time band in Find a time

catalogRow.theySee: The band follows in 15-minute steps; the overlapped lanes turn amber as it passes
A green line with the time moves down the grid

61604.name: SWITCHING_BETWEEN_DAY_WEEK_MONTH_AND_AGENDA
61604.meaning: Switching between Day, Week, Month and List (Day, Month and List on the phone)

catalogRow.theySee: The new view settles in with a 6px rise (260ms) while the old one fades out (180ms), hidden from assistive tech. Instant with reduced motion

61605.name: STEPPING_TO_ANOTHER_DAY_WEEK_OR_MONTH
61605.meaning: Stepping to another day, week or month (the arrows, the arrow keys, Today or a date)

catalogRow.theySee: The grid slides 12px the way it went (260ms in, 180ms out): a later period from the right, an earlier one from the left. Instant with reduced motion

61606.name: CHOOSING_ANOTHER_DAY_IN_THE_PHONES_WEEK
61606.meaning: Choosing another day in the phone's week strip

catalogRow.theySee: The chosen day's green plate glides along the strip to it (260ms, ease-out) while the day's ink turns, and the day's heading and agenda slide 12px the way the day went (260ms in, 180ms out, the leaving copy hidden from assistive tech). Instant with reduced motion and Animations off
catalogRow.test: calendar.test › CH-6606; WebKit 390 frame sampling (plate 150→201px over 260ms; reduced: one frame)

61607.name: TOURNAMENT_CHOSEN_TRACK_TURNED_ON_OR_OFF
61607.meaning: Tournament chosen (Track on), Track turned on or off, More details opened

catalogRow.theySee: The section's fields fade in (quick, after the 50 ms press delay); nothing moves in height; the More details chevron turns 180°. Nothing animates on first paint; reduced motion: instant

61701.name: OPENING_AN_EVENT_A_DAY_OR_A
61701.meaning: Opening a day from the week header or choosing a List row; changing view, week or players; each Find a time step (opening an event is a plain navigation tap and is silent, D-70)

catalogRow.theySee: A selection tick

61702.name: A_FORM_WITH_A_PROBLEM_OR_CLOSING
61702.meaning: A form with a problem, or closing the editor with changes

catalogRow.theySee: The OS warning pattern
The OS success pattern

61801.name: EACH_EVENT_IS_A_BUTTON_NAMED_WITH
61801.meaning: Each event is a button named with its title and time, and "schedule overlap" when it has one; each day header opens the day

catalogRow.how: the title it draws, then hidden words (`.ch-sr-only`), never an `aria-label` that disagrees with the face (SWP-03)

61802.name: THE_DETAIL_PANEL_IS_A_POLITE_LIVE
61802.meaning: The detail panel is a polite live region; form errors are tied to their field

61803.name: CHANGING_THE_PLAYER_FILTER_IS_ANNOUNCED
61803.meaning: Changing the player filter is announced ("Showing 2 players")

61804.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_VIEW
61804.meaning: No axe violations in any preview view and state, 1280px and 390px. One known exception, listed in the scan: the 7-day week at 390px squeezes overlapping events under 24px until the phone Calendar is designed

61805.name: A_COMPLETED_MOVE_IS_SAID_ONCE_NEVER
61805.meaning: A completed move is said once, never during a drag: "Practice moved to 4:00 PM, Wednesday 15 October. Undo with Command Z." (Control Z off a Mac; on touch "Undo is in the notice."); a resize "Practice now ends at 6:30 PM."; a clash appended; Undo "Move undone."

61806.name: MONTH_DRAG_IS_ANNOUNCED_PICKED_UP_FALL
61806.meaning: Month drag is announced: "Picked up Fall qualifier R2, Thursday 16 October. Arrow keys choose a day, Space drops, Escape cancels.", "Over Friday 17 October.", "Fall qualifier R2 moved to Friday 17 October at 8:42 AM.", or "Move cancelled. Fall qualifier R2 stays on Thursday 16 October."

61807.name: THE_TOURNAMENT_SECTION_IS_SHOWN_OR_HIDDEN
61807.meaning: The tournament section is shown or hidden (Tournament chosen, Track turned on or off): one polite line: "Tournament details shown. 3 rounds." or "Tournament details hidden."

61808.name: THE_ROUNDS_CHANGE_WITH_THE_DAYS_OR
61808.meaning: The rounds change with the days, or reorder after a day or tee change: one polite line: "3 rounds, Thursday 5 November to Saturday 7 November." or "Rounds reordered. Round 2 is now Friday 6 November at 8:30 AM."

61809.name: ESCAPE_WHILE_THE_TOURNAMENT_IS_BEING_CREATED
61809.meaning: Escape (or the close button) while the tournament is being created: the editor stays open and says "Still creating the tournament."

61810.name: A_ROUND_DROPPED_WHERE_IT_WOULD_START
61810.meaning: A round dropped (or moved with Alt and an arrow) where it would start before the round ahead of it, or after the one behind: it snaps back, felt as an error, nothing asked or written. One polite line: "R2 can’t move before R1. Move R1 first." (or "R2 can’t move after R3. Move R3 first.")

61880.name: PRACTICE_HOURS_DESKTOP_IS_A_TABLE_A
61880.meaning: Practice hours (desktop) is a table: a row header per player, a column a day, “Week” as “20.5 of 20”, Days off; a cell over a limit carries its warning in words, never colour alone, and the warnings row names each bylaw. On the phone each player is a list item with their days as a list

61881.name: THE_WEEKS_VERDICT_IS_ONE_POLITE_LINE
61881.meaning: The week's verdict is one polite line: “2 players with a warning”, “A warning this week” (a player) or “No warnings this week”

61901.name: PHONE_LAYOUT
61901.meaning: At 820px and below Calendar is the phone build, never a shrunken desktop: Day with a week strip, Month and List; an event opens in a sheet and New event is a sheet. State, writes and dialogs are the desktop's.

62001.name: KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS
62001.meaning: On the desktop N opens New event (coach), T goes to today, the left and right arrows step a day, week or month (not in the agenda), and Esc closes the open panel. None of them fires while typing in a field or with a dialog open.

62101.name: LOADER_READS_IN_THREE_ROUNDS
62101.meaning: The server loader reads each table once for the whole screen, in three rounds and never per event or per player: the team's zone, name and roster; then events, class schedules and (for a coach) their busy time together; then every event's replies, one read for each 200 events. A read that fails is flagged and logged, never thrown.

62301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
62301.meaning: A read that fails in the loader is logged through chLogServer("calendar", {read}) and named on the page; a write that fails is reported through chReport under the calendar surface with its action (calendar.saveEvent and the rest), after a chTrail breadcrumb for the intent; a section that cannot load reports under its own surface (calendar.subscribe, calendar.files, calendar.attendance).

62401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
62401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/calendar.test.tsx names in a test title every Calendar catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 that is not marked preview, and every hand contract on this page it proves by its Bridge ID; the calendar model checks are in logic.test.ts.

70101.name: MESSAGES_READY
70101.meaning: Messages is open: the conversation rail, and on desktop the newest thread beside it, opened without marking it read; on the phone the inbox.

70102.name: DEEP_LINK_OPENS_CONVERSATION
70102.meaning: A link with ?conversation=<id> opens that thread, and ?player=<golf_players.id> opens or starts the direct thread with that player; the address is then cleaned. A new link arriving while the page is open is taken too; a thread missing from the list is refetched once before it opens. A search hit opens its thread at the matched message, ringed for a moment; the end-anchor waits while it does.

70210.meaning: The Add sheet's list is loading

70211.name: THE_SEEN_BY_LIST_IS_LOADING
70211.meaning: The Seen by list is loading

catalogRow.theySee: Three skeleton rows, `aria-busy`; the title reads "Seen by" alone

70290.name: THE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_READ_HASNT_ANSWERED_WHILE_THE
70290.meaning: The announcements read hasn’t answered while the conversations have (GAP-S-11)

catalogRow.theySee: The conversations draw at once; Announcements waits in its own section with a one-row skeleton (`aria-busy`). After 4 seconds its label adds "· Still loading…" (a status); after 15 seconds it becomes "Announcements didn’t load" (CH-7206) with Try again

70301.name: REALTIME_UPDATES_ARRIVE
70301.meaning: New messages, edits, deletes and reactions arrive over realtime while the page is open, without a reload; the rail refreshes its last message and unread counts the same way.

catalogRow.theySee: "No conversations yet" + (coach) "Start one with a player, or create a team group."; the announcements section still draws under it on desktop, and the phone inbox draws the same compact line under its filter when announcements are listed or failed (GAP-S-01)

70402.name: A_RAIL_SEARCH_OR_THE_UNREAD_FILTER
70402.meaning: A rail search or a filter has nothing

catalogRow.theySee: Search: "No conversation names match" + Clear search (message hits may follow below); Groups: "No group conversations yet"; Unread: "Nothing unread" + "You’re caught up." + Show all

70403.name: NO_MESSAGE_MENTIONS_THE_SEARCH
70403.meaning: A conversation’s own search (Details › Search) finds no message

81402.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_SAVE

82101.meaning: The server loader reads everything the page shows before first paint, in parallel batches; a read that returns an error or throws becomes that section's failed flag and a chLogServer line, and never fails the page.

82301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
82301.meaning: Every client failure is reported through chReport with surface settings (form saves, by action name), settings.notifications, settings.routing or settings.coachhelm (switches and autosave), settings.profile, settings.invite or settings.session (cards) or settings.<section> (a crash, high severity); server reads log through chLogServer('settings', read, error, area); each intent leaves a chTrail breadcrumb.

82401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
82401.meaning: settings.test.tsx and settings-server.test.tsx name every catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 they force, and every hand contract they prove by its Bridge ID in a test title; the settings model checks are in logic.test.ts.

90101.name: LIST_READY
90101.meaning: The list opens with the count of active and concluded qualifiers, the All, Active and Concluded pills with their counts, search, the live qualifier (or, with none live, the active one that starts first) as the hero with its leaders, the other active ones as cards under Active and the concluded ones under Concluded; a coach also gets New qualifier.

90102.name: DETAIL_READY
90102.meaning: A qualifier opens with its status pill and name, five facts (dates, entrants, rounds submitted, course, spots), the leaderboard, and beside it the selections, the course per round and the scoring rules; a coach also gets round-by-round scores, Manage selections, Edit qualifier and Close or Reopen.

90103.name: FORM_READY
90103.meaning: Create opens with the whole active roster ticked, three rounds, a five-player squad and one coach's pick; Edit opens with the qualifier's own values, round courses and entrants.

90104.name: SELECTION_READY
90104.meaning: Manage selections opens with the qualifier's name and squad line, the three steps (Standings, Coach's picks, Squad confirmed) with the current one marked, the places on score now, the rest of the field, the coach's picks with their open slots, and the one primary action for the next step.

90105.name: ADDRESSES_RENDER_IN_PLACE
90105.meaning: Each address renders its own screen in place, never as a redirect (D-23): /qualifiers the list, /qualifiers/[id] the detail, /qualifiers/new and /qualifiers/[id]/edit the form, and /qualifiers/[id]/selection Manage selections. The one exception is /my-qualifiers, retired on 2026-11-11 (owner): it opens /qualifiers.

90106.name: MY_QUALIFIERS_ARE_THE_PLAYERS_OWN
90106.meaning: Players have one Qualifiers page: /qualifiers puts a player's own first with where they stand. My qualifiers is retired (owner, 2026-11-11): /my-qualifiers opens /qualifiers for a coach and a player, and is no screen of its own.

90107.name: SELECTION_ADDRESS_OUTSIDE_THE_CLUBHOUSE
90107.meaning: With the Clubhouse off, /qualifiers/[id]/selection sends a coach to the CoachHelm qualifying workspace and a player to the qualifier, and a signed-out visitor to login; with it on, the route gets the address.

90180.name: QUALIFIER_TIE_RULE_RANKS_THE_BOARD
90180.meaning: A qualifier's tie rule (launch readiness F-04) ranks its board, its list leaders, the selection workspace and its confirm, and Ask's board read in the one order (ranking.ts rankStandings): 'last_round' separates players level on to par and strokes by the lower last round, then the round before, and only players still level share a place or tie at the cut; 'coach' (a qualifier with no stored rule, and every qualifier before the held migration 20261115240000) separates nobody (Q-114). The standings caption states the rule in words, to the coach and to a player.

90181.name: QUALIFIER_FORM_CHOOSES_THE_TIE_RULE
90181.meaning: The qualifier form's Ties field (F-04): a new qualifier starts on 'Last round, then the one before' (owner, 15 Nov 2026), an existing one on its own rule, with 'You decide' as the other choice and a sentence saying what the rule does. Before the rule's store exists the field is locked on You decide and says choosing waits on the update; a read that fails locks it (CH-09281) and a save leaves the rule alone.

90182.name: QUALIFIER_COUNTS_BEST_ROUNDS
90182.meaning: A qualifier can count each player's best N rounds (launch readiness F-06, held migration 20261115240000 adds count_best): the form's 'Rounds that count' offers Every round or Best N of M; the board, the selection workspace and its confirm sum only the counted rounds (one helper, ranking.ts countedRoundIndexes: lower to par, then strokes, then the earlier round), a player is short only against the counted rounds, the dropped rounds stay on the player's card marked 'Dropped, not counted', and the standings caption states the rule ('Counts each player’s best 2 of 3 rounds: the worst round is dropped.').

90183.name: QUALIFIER_EXEMPT_PLAYERS
90183.meaning: Exempt players (F-06; owner, 16 Nov 2026: 'Exempt before, from coach picks'): before the qualifier starts the coach ticks entrants under Exempt players in the form and gives each a reason (coach-only, D-33). When selection closes each becomes one of the qualifier's coach's picks with 'Exempt: (the reason)', never past the picks there are; a pick for an exempt player needs no scored round (Q-115 waived for them only). Once the qualifier starts the exemptions are fixed and the form says to use a coach's pick. Needs held migration 20261116100000; before it the field is not offered.

90184.name: QUALIFIER_NEXT_ROUND_GROUPS
90184.meaning: Next round groups (F-06): while a qualifier is under way with a round still to play, the coach's detail shows 'Round N groups' drawn from the standings, leaders off last and players with no score off first, in threes or fours (a filter Segmented), as even as the field allows with the larger groups last. A view of the board; nothing is stored.
