90804.meaning: A signed-out visitor gets an empty page and someone with no team gets the no-team page (CH-09309) on every address, and neither reads a qualifier.

90805.name: TEAM_OWNERSHIP_IN_THE_LOADERS
90805.meaning: The list reads only the viewer's team and never a test qualifier, and the detail, form and Manage selections loaders answer a qualifier on another team, or none, with not found (CH-09310), so its data reaches no one outside the team.

90806.name: PLAYER_OPENS_OWN_ROUNDS_ONLY
90806.meaning: A player can open scorecards only for their own rounds (the row button on desktop, the rounds sheet on the phone), and the loader sends their browser only their own holes, never a teammate's.

90807.name: PICK_REASONING_IS_COACH_ONLY
90807.meaning: A coach's reason for a pick is read only for a coach and is never in a player's data or on a player's screen: a player sees who was picked, not why.

90808.name: COACH_CONTROLS_HIDDEN_FROM_PLAYERS
90808.meaning: A player is never shown a coach control: not New qualifier, Manage selections, Edit, Close, Reopen, the phone's Qualifier actions, round-by-round scores or the coach's Selections panel (hiding them is a courtesy; the gates are 90803 and 90810 to 90812).

90809.name: SELECTION_REFUSALS_IN_COACH_WORDS
90809.meaning: A refusal from the selection actions (not this team's coach, the squad moved on, picks not open, every pick taken, no reason, player not on the team, roster unchecked, nothing to confirm, qualifier missing) reaches the coach as a sentence saying what to do, and an unrecognised one falls back to the toast's own hint.

90810.name: SELECTION_ACTIONS_RECHECK_THE_COACH
90810.meaning: Start selecting, saving or removing a pick and confirming the squad each check on the server that the caller coaches the qualifier's own team (Unauthorized, Qualifier not found, Not a coach of this team) before the service runs, and a pick must also be a player on that team.

90811.name: SETUP_ACTIONS_RECHECK_THE_COACH
90811.meaning: The squad-size and entrants actions behind Edit check that the caller coaches the qualifier's team before any write, and refuse a signed-out caller and a malformed id.

90812.name: STATUS_ACTION_RECHECKS_THE_COACH
90812.meaning: Close and Reopen check on the server that the caller's organisation owns the qualifier's team, so a player or another organisation's coach is refused as Unauthorized before anything is updated.

90901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
90901.meaning: A write that lands (create, save, close, reopen, start selecting, save a pick, remove a pick, confirm the squad) says what landed in a toast and fires the success haptic.

90902.name: QUALIFIER_OPENS_AFTER_A_CREATE_SAVE_OR_CONFIRM
90902.meaning: A landed create opens the new qualifier and a landed save or confirm returns to the qualifier, while close, reopen, start selecting, save a pick and remove a pick leave the coach where they are.

90980.name: EXPORT_STANDINGS_LANDED
90980.meaning: An export of standings that lands says so in a toast ("Standings exported · 9 players") with the success haptic: a download on a computer, the share sheet on a phone.

90981.name: QUALIFIER_TIE_RULE_SAVED
90981.meaning: The tie rule saves with the qualifier (F-04): on create it is saved for the new qualifier, and a rule that doesn't save is said in the done toast ('Qualifier created, but its tie rule didn’t save. Open Edit to set it.'); on edit it is a step of the save only when it changed. The server writes one row a qualifier with its team through RLS (a coach of the team), refuses another team's qualifier, and answers 'unavailable' before the migration is applied.

90982.name: QUALIFIER_EXEMPTIONS_SAVED
90982.meaning: Exemptions save with the qualifier (F-06): on create after the players are entered, and a list that doesn't save is said in the done toast ('Qualifier created, but its exemptions didn’t save. Open Edit to set them.'); on edit a step after the players and the squad, only when the list changed. The server replaces the list through RLS (a coach; each player an entrant), only while the qualifier is upcoming and never past its coach's picks.

90983.name: EXEMPT_PLAYERS_PLACED_AT_CLOSE
90983.meaning: Closing selection places each exempt entrant as a coach's pick with 'Exempt: (the reason)' in the closer's name (F-06), never past the picks, leaving a pick already made; a failure is logged and the coach can still pick them (Q-115 is waived for an exempt player).

catalogRow.theySee: Coach: "Closed to new rounds. Players can't enter or submit rounds in it, including rounds already started, until you reopen it." Player: "This qualifier is closed." (D-31)

"Close this qualifier?" + "Players won't be able to enter or submit rounds in Pinehurst qualifier, including rounds already started, until you reopen it. It moves to Concluded." Keep it open / Close qualifier
"Start selecting?" + "Coach’s picks open. This step can’t be undone. The standings keep updating, and the places on score are set when you confirm the squad." Not yet / Start selecting
"Remove Ava Chen as a pick?" + "Their reason is removed with them. You can pick them again." Keep them / Remove
"Confirm the squad?" + who makes the trip + "Every entrant is told whether they made it, and the squad can’t be changed afterwards." Keep editing / Confirm squad

91201.name: CANCEL_OR_BACK_WITH_UNSAVED_CHANGES_IN
91201.meaning: Cancel or Back with unsaved changes in the form

catalogRow.theySee: "Discard your changes?" Keep editing / Discard

91202.name: FORM_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
91202.meaning: A create or save that fails keeps every field as typed, and a save that lands only in part keeps saying what saved and what did not until the next save (CH-09902).

91203.name: PICK_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
91203.meaning: A pick the server refuses keeps the dialog open with the chosen player and the reason, so nothing has to be typed again.

91204.name: OPEN_SCORECARDS_SURVIVE_A_REFRESH
91204.meaning: Scorecards a coach has open stay open when the standings are read again.

91301.name: WRITES_WAIT_FOR_THE_SERVER
91301.meaning: Nothing is optimistic: the status pill, the picks and the steps change only after the server says the write landed, and a refused write changes nothing on the page.

91401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
91401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything a landed write does follows: the status changes, the question closes, and the page opens the qualifier or reads again.

91402.name: TRY_AGAIN_REREADS_THE_PAGE
91402.meaning: Try again on a section that did not load has the server read the whole page again (router.refresh), except the course picker, which re-reads only its own list, and the edit form's round courses, which offer none so a re-read cannot drop the coach's changes.

91501.name: WRITES_RE_READ_THE_PAGE
91501.meaning: A landed close, reopen, save, start selecting, save a pick, remove a pick or confirm has the server read the page again so it shows the server's state (a create opens the new qualifier instead), and a write that fails re-reads nothing.

91601.name: PRESSING_A_CARD_THE_HERO_OR_A
91601.meaning: Pressing a card, the hero or a status pill

catalogRow.theySee: A deeper tint over the press beat (110ms), easing back over 180ms; nothing scales (the shell's CH-1606). A status pill darkens, a Ledger row takes the row press tint and the desktop hero's title deepens to forest. On the phone the live qualifier (the list's one green feature card) darkens under a shade, and a list row, a leaderboard row, a player in the form and a pick's player take the row press tint

The row turns selected (180ms), its chevron turns (260ms) and the scorecards drop 6px into place as they fade in (260ms), at their final values: no count-up, no stagger. Closing takes them away at once. The Live dot is static (D-33). On the phone a row opens the rounds sheet instead. Instant with reduced motion

91603.name: CHOOSING_A_ROUND_IN_A_PLAYERS_ROUNDS
91603.meaning: Choosing a round in a player's rounds sheet (phone)

catalogRow.theySee: The chosen round's chip takes the raised face, which fades in over 180ms as the old chip's fades out; a press tints a chip for the press beat. Instant with reduced motion

91701.name: A_STATUS_PILL_A_LEADERBOARD_ROW_A
91701.meaning: A status pill, a leaderboard row, a player checkbox, a course, a tee, or a player in the pick dialog

catalogRow.theySee: select
warning before the question or the loss

91703.name: START_SELECTING_CONFIRM_SQUAD_REMOVE_A_PICK
91703.meaning: Start selecting, Confirm squad, Remove a pick

catalogRow.theySee: warning before the question (D-70: they can't be undone, or lose a reason); success when it lands

91801.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_STATE
91801.meaning: No axe violations in any preview state, 1280px and 390px

91802.name: THE_LEADERBOARD_AND_ROUND_BY_ROUND_ARE
91802.meaning: The leaderboard and round-by-round are tables (rows, column headers, a row header per player); each row's scorecards open from a button with aria-expanded, and each scorecard is a table with a caption

91803.name: A_LIVE_UPDATE_TO_THE_STANDINGS_IS
91803.meaning: A live update to the standings is announced

catalogRow.how: "Standings updated. 14 rounds submitted." in a polite live region

91804.name: FIELD_PROBLEMS_ARE_ALERTS
91804.meaning: Each problem in the form or the pick dialog is an alert tied to its field by aria-describedby, the field is marked aria-invalid, and a field with no problem is not.

91901.name: PHONE_DETAIL
91901.meaning: At 820px and below a qualifier is one column: two facts (rounds in, spots), the leaderboard as cards that open a player's rounds in a sheet, the confirmed squad above it, and Edit, Close and Reopen in the bar's actions sheet, with Close also a key beside Manage selections once the qualifier is past its last day; round-by-round stays on desktop.

91902.name: PHONE_FORM
91902.meaning: On the phone the form's Cancel and Create (Save when editing) sit in the top bar and the tab bar steps aside; Create runs the same checks as the page's button, and Cancel asks before discarding changes.

91903.name: PHONE_SELECTION
91903.meaning: On the phone Manage selections has its own top bar (Selections, with a way back to the qualifier) and the one primary action in a foot at the bottom of the page.

91904.name: PHONE_LIST
91904.meaning: On the phone the list's top bar reads the title, Qualifiers, for a coach and a player alike; the list itself is the desktop list with phone CSS.

92001.name: FIRST_PROBLEM_TAKES_FOCUS
92001.meaning: When Create or Save finds problems nothing is sent and focus moves to the first problem in reading order (name, dates, rounds, the one-round confirmation, players, squad, picks), not the last.

92002.name: ENTER_SUBMITS_THE_FORM
92002.meaning: Enter in a field of the form submits it, and a form with a problem shows the problem instead of sending.

92003.name: SCORECARDS_OPEN_FROM_THE_KEYBOARD
92003.meaning: A leaderboard row's scorecards open from a button that takes Enter and Space and says whether it is expanded; the row itself is not a tab stop.

92101.name: ONE_PASS_LOADERS
92101.meaning: The list, the detail and the form are each read on the server in one pass, every table once, and arrive whole, so nothing is fetched after first paint except a live qualifier's re-read and the course picker's lookups.

92102.name: PICKER_SEARCH_IS_DEBOUNCED
92102.meaning: The course picker looks courses up when it opens and once, 250ms after typing stops, not on every key.

92301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
92301.meaning: A refused write is reported through chReport at low severity and a thrown one at the default, with surface qualifiers and the write's name (qualifiers.close, qualifiers.save, ...); a crash is reported high under its section (qualifiers.leaderboard, ...), a failed picker read under qualifiers.picker, and a failed server read is logged through chLogServer('qualifiers', {read}).

92302.name: HELD_SETUP_ACTIONS_REFUSE_OFF
92302.meaning: The squad-size and entrants actions refuse before any read unless the dashboard draws the caller as a coach (D-61). The Clubhouse-UI condition they also had is always met since Fairway's retirement (2026-11-14).

92303.name: SELECTION_REFUSAL_KEPT_FOR_THE_TRAIL
92303.meaning: The selection actions' own refusal text, cut at 200 characters, goes to a chTrail breadcrumb ('qualifiers selection refused') and not to the coach, so Sentry keeps what the server said.

92304.name: INTENTS_LEAVE_BREADCRUMBS
92304.meaning: Each intent leaves a chTrail breadcrumb before anything is sent: a filter, opening the scorecards, asking to close, asking to start selecting or to confirm, Create, Save, and the write itself by name (action `qualifiers.<name>`).

92401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
92401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/qualifiers.test.tsx names every catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 it forces and every hand contract it proves by its Bridge ID in a test title, and the server actions behind Manage selections, Close and Edit have their own test files.

100101.name: HUB_READY
100101.meaning: Team Hub opens on Home for a coach and for a player in the same frame: the role pill, the title, the team and season, and the tabs (Home, Announcements, Travel, Documents and Tasks, for a coach and a player; Announcements and Tasks carry a small count when a post waits to be acknowledged or a task is late). Under the title one line says what the team is waiting on (a coach: players, replies due, posts awaiting acknowledgement, days to the next trip, open tasks; a player: replies due, posts to acknowledge, days to their trip, open tasks), each figure opening the tab it counts; a figure that is zero, or whose read failed, is left out. Home is a set of widgets (twelve columns on desktop, one in rank order on a phone): the next trip as the one dark tile (days to go, the plan as a rail, who is traveling, a pager to the next trip, Edit trip for a coach; with no trip ahead, the week's next event); this week as seven days to step through, the chosen day's events with replies as a count for a coach and the reply choices for a player, and what follows later this week; for a coach, Waiting on (each player's replies owed, posts not acknowledged, open tasks with late ones in amber and rounds in 30 days, sortable, a name opening the items), the latest post with its acknowledged count and a disc for each player not yet acknowledged, and the tasks' done, left and overdue with the three soonest; for a player, their queue (replies, posts and tasks answered in place, an answered row staying put), the latest post with Got it, and the newest files. Updates sits on both. A coach also gets New announcement.

100102.name: TAB_LINK_OPENS_A_TAB
100102.meaning: ?tab=home|ann|travel|docs|tasks opens that tab; a value that is not a tab opens Home. A player's Tasks tab lists their own tasks; the coach's Tasks tab also opens with a board of the team's done, left and overdue.

100103.name: TASK_LINK_OPENS_THE_TASK
100103.meaning: ?task={id} (a task notification, carried through the old /tasks address, a next.config.mjs redirect) scrolls that task's row into view on the coach's Tasks tab or the player's Your tasks and lights it with a still wash until the row is used (first paint is still, MOTION-AND-VISUAL 3.5; the fade it once played is gone). A task that is not in the shown rows, or a value that is not an id, is ignored; completing the task or a later render never scrolls back to it.

catalogRow.theySee: "Uploading…" on the drop zone; it can't be pressed again

The sheet closes at once and the post is drawn first in the list, "Posting…" where its time goes, with no menu, until the page reads again (F-0045); a failure takes it back and reopens the sheet with the text kept (CH-10005)
"Saving…"
The sheet closes at once and the task is drawn first in the list, "Assigning…" where its due date goes, with no menu (F-0045); a failure takes it back and reopens the sheet as typed (CH-10007)

The header, the tab strip and the tab the address names (`?tab=` tasks, travel, docs or ann; Home's two columns otherwise, GAP-S-17) as grey blocks, in place (nothing for the first 150ms, then a fade); on the phone the opening on its double rule, the tabs on their hairline and two flush sections with rows on seams, in the loaded page's geometry and the signed-in role's opening and tab count from the shell (a coach's New announcement; five tabs or four), so either role's page lands with 0px shift at 390; read as "Loading Team Hub"
"Saving…" on the button of Edit announcement; it can't be pressed twice

100207.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_THE_TRAVELERS_CLASSES_ARE
100207.meaning: Plan a trip: the travelers' classes are being checked

catalogRow.theySee: "Checking their classes…" once the chosen travelers have settled (350ms; a run of taps on player chips is one question). Publish never waits for it, and an answer for travelers or days no longer on screen is not shown

100208.name: A_PLAYERS_EVENT_REPLY_IS_BEING_SENT
100208.meaning: A player's event reply is being sent

catalogRow.theySee: "Sending reply for Team dinner…" beside that event's selected reply. Its three choices remain disabled across tab changes until the answer; another event can save independently. Refusal restores the last confirmed reply and offers Retry

100209.name: A_PLAYERS_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_IS_BEING_SENT
100209.meaning: A player's acknowledgment is being sent

catalogRow.theySee: "Acknowledging Pairings and tee times for Thursday…" on that post. Got it is unavailable in Home and Announcements, and Home keeps the same featured post until the answer. Confirmation advances to the next unread post; refusal restores Got it and offers Retry

100210.name: A_PLAYERS_TASK_COMPLETION_OR_REOPENING_IS
100210.meaning: A player's task completion or reopening is being saved

catalogRow.theySee: "Saving…" next to that task, read as "Saving Sign travel waiver". Only its toggle remains disabled across tab changes; another task can save independently. Refusal restores the prior state and offers Retry for the same requested state

100401.name: NO_EVENTS_NEED_A_REPLY
100401.meaning: No events in the next 7 days

catalogRow.theySee: Home's week tile (Next 7 days, W21): "Nothing on the calendar in the next 7 days" + "Events you add show here, with who has replied." (coach, with Create event) or "Team events show here as your coaches add them." (player)
"Nothing new" + "Posts, trips, tasks and qualifier moves show here as they happen."
Player: "No tasks right now" (Tasks tab); Home's queue with nothing asked: "Nothing is asked of you". Coach: "No tasks assigned" + "Assign a task and see who has done it."
"No documents yet" + who fills it, flush at the panel's edge under the drop zone (no card)

100405.name: A_COACH_WITH_NOTHING_POSTED
100405.meaning: A coach with nothing posted (v2 first run, gh-states EMPTY.hub.coach)

catalogRow.theySee: "Nothing posted yet" + Plan a trip; New announcement stays the head's one primary action, not repeated in the empty (states audit b9, 2026-10-08). Only when every read answered and was empty, Updates included; a failed Updates read shows CH-10202 instead

100406.name: A_PLAYER_WITH_NOTHING_FROM_THEIR_COACHES
100406.meaning: A player with nothing from their coaches (EMPTY.hub.player)

catalogRow.theySee: "No team updates yet" + "Announcements, trips and documents from your coaches will show up here." Only when every read answered and was empty, Updates included; a failed Updates read shows CH-10202 instead
"No announcements yet", flush at the panel's edge under the composer line (no card)
"No trips planned" + who fills it, flush at the panel's edge under Plan a trip (no card)
"You aren’t on a team yet" + the role's next step + Open team settings (a coach's Team, a player's Golf profile)

100410.name: PAGE_EMPTY_ONLY_WHEN_EVERY_READ_IS_EMPTY
100410.meaning: The whole-page empty state (CH-10305 for a coach, CH-10306 for a player) shows only when every section read answered and every one was empty, Updates included: a failed read, Updates too, shows its own notice with Try again instead, and an update to read is shown, never hidden behind No team updates yet.

100411.name: A_TEAM_WITH_NOBODY_ON_THE_ROSTER
100411.meaning: A team with nobody on the roster

catalogRow.theySee: In the sheets, where players are chosen: "No players on the roster yet. Add them in Roster, then choose them here."
In New announcement, where files are attached: "No documents yet. Add files in the Documents tab, then attach them here." Nothing to attach; the post still goes

100413.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_NO_UPCOMING_EVENTS_IN
100413.meaning: Plan a trip: no upcoming events in the next four months

catalogRow.theySee: "No upcoming events in the next four months. Add the tournament in Calendar to choose its travelers here."

100414.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_THE_TRAVELERS_STEP_WITH
100414.meaning: Plan a trip: the Travelers step when its event has left the list while the sheet was open (a trip with no event skips the step)

catalogRow.theySee: "Travelers come from the trip’s calendar event. Without one, the whole team sees the trip. Go Back to choose an event."

100415.name: NEW_ANNOUNCEMENT_FILES_THAT_PLAYERS_CANT_OPEN
100415.meaning: New announcement: files that players can't open are left out of the attach list

catalogRow.theySee: Only files players can open (`is_public`) are offered. With some left out, under the list: "1 coach-only file isn't offered: players couldn't open it." ("6 coach-only files aren't offered: … them."). With every file coach-only: "Your file is coach-only, so none can be attached: players couldn't open it." and no attach button; the post still goes with none. A file chosen and then made coach-only while the sheet is open comes off its chip and is not sent. The Documents tab still lists every file to a coach

100416.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_NOBODY_CHOSEN_HAS_A
100416.meaning: Plan a trip: nobody chosen has a class during the trip

catalogRow.theySee: "No class meets during the trip for the travelers chosen." Only when the check ran in full: a check that could not is CH-10212

100490.name: A_LINK_TO_A_TASK_THAT_ISNT
100490.meaning: A link to a task (`?task=`) that isn't on the loaded list, when the list is complete and read without error (GAP-S-26)

catalogRow.theySee: The Tasks tab opens and says at its top: "That task was removed" + (player) "It’s no longer on your list." / (coach) "It’s no longer on the team’s list." Not shown when the coach's list is capped or failed to read, since a missing row there proves nothing; it clears when the person leaves the tab

100491.name: A_LINK_TO_A_TRIP_THAT_ISNT
100491.meaning: A link to a trip (`?trip=`) that isn't loaded (GAP-S-26)

catalogRow.theySee: The Travel tab opens and says at its top: "That trip isn’t here" + "It may have been removed, or it’s too far past to show in Team Hub." (trip reads are windowed, so an old trip is never called removed); it clears when the person leaves the tab

100501.name: POSTING_WITH_A_HEADLINE_UNDER_THREE_CHARACTERS
100501.meaning: Posting or saving an edit with a headline under three characters

catalogRow.theySee: "Give it a headline, at least three characters." Warning haptic; nothing is sent

100502.name: POSTING_TO_CHOSEN_PLAYERS_WITH_NONE_CHOSEN
100502.meaning: Posting to chosen players with none chosen

catalogRow.theySee: "Choose at least one player, or send it to the whole team."

100503.name: A_TRIP_WITH_A_NAME_UNDER_THREE
100503.meaning: A trip with a name under three characters

catalogRow.theySee: "Name the trip, at least three characters."
"Where is the team going?"

100505.name: A_TRIP_WITH_NO_DEPARTURE_DAY
100505.meaning: A trip with no departure day

catalogRow.theySee: "Pick the day the team leaves."
"The return can’t be before the departure."

100507.name: A_TASK_WITH_A_NAME_UNDER_THREE
100507.meaning: A task with a name under three characters

catalogRow.theySee: "Name the task, at least three characters."
"Choose at least one player."

100509.name: POSTING_OR_SAVING_AN_EDIT_WITH_NO
100509.meaning: Posting or saving an edit with no message (the server requires one)

catalogRow.theySee: "Add a message." Warning haptic; nothing is sent

100510.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_A_CHOSEN_TRAVELER_HAS
100510.meaning: Plan a trip: a chosen traveler has a class during the trip

catalogRow.theySee: A warning, not a stop: "**Eli has CHEM 102 lab** Mon 3:00–4:15 PM. They'd miss it to travel." One line per traveler, three at most, then "2 more travelers also have a class during the trip."; a traveler's other classes are counted ("and 1 more class", "They’d miss these to travel."). Shown on the Travelers step, for the event's own days, and on the Itinerary step, for the dates and times typed in Logistics. Only the chosen travelers' classes that overlap the trip are read
"Couldn't send your reply for Team dinner" + Retry; the reply goes back to what it was. Done: "You're going to Team dinner" (maybe: "Marked maybe for …"; can't: "Your coach knows you can't make …")
"Couldn’t acknowledge "Pairings and tee times for Thursday"" + Retry; Got it comes back
"Couldn't mark Sign travel waiver done" + Retry; the box unchecks. Done: "Sign travel waiver done"
"Couldn't open Travel waiver" + "The file may have been removed. Try again, or ask your coach to share it again." The blank tab closes
"Couldn’t post the announcement" + "Your text is still here. Try again in a moment." The sheet stays open with the text. Done: "Posted "Bus leaves at 6""
"Couldn't save Seahawk" + "What you entered is still here." Done: "Seahawk is on Travel"
"Couldn't assign Book physicals" + "What you entered is still here." Done: "Book physicals assigned to the team" (or "to 3 players")

"Couldn't upload Local rules.pdf" + "Check the file is under 25 MB and try again." Each file says so on its own, with Retry. A file of a type Fairway Documents doesn't take, or over 25 MB, is refused by name before sending ("setup.exe can’t be shared" / "Film.mov is too large"). Done: "Local rules.pdf shared with the team"; several dropped at once land with one toast that counts them ("3 files shared with the team")

100609.name: DELETING_A_POST_TASK_OR_FILE_FAILS
100609.meaning: Deleting a post, task, file or trip fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn't delete NCAA hours log" + Retry; it stays. Done: "Deleted NCAA hours log"

Home's week tile (Next 7 days): "The next 7 days didn’t load."; a player's queue: "Your events didn’t load." + Try again; never an empty week. With another read failed too, the page's one notice carries Try again (the shell's CH-1209: "Some of this page didn’t load" naming the parts) and each failed section keeps only its title under its heading (`covered`); this applies to CH-10201 to CH-10204, CH-10206 and CH-10207
"Updates didn’t load." + "Your notifications are safe; the bell may still have them. Try again."
"Your tasks didn’t load." (coach: "Tasks didn’t load.")
"Documents didn’t load." + "Your files are safe."
"RSVPs couldn't be shown." (or the section's name); the rest of the page stays
"Announcements didn’t load."
"Travel didn’t load." + "Trips are safe."

On the page, under the head: "The team list didn’t load" (players can’t be chosen for a post, a trip or a task; a post to the whole team still goes out) + Try again; with another failed read, "the team list" is named in the page notice (CH-1209) instead. In the announcement, trip and task sheets, where players are chosen: the same notice ("Players can’t be chosen until it does.") + Try again (reads the page again; the roster that arrives starts fully chosen), never an empty picker; a trip's travelers are unknown, not 0. "Whole team" loses its count and still posts; Assign stops with this line, never "For 0 of 0"

100618.name: SAVING_AN_EDIT_TO_AN_ANNOUNCEMENT_FAILS
100618.meaning: Saving an edit to an announcement fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t save the announcement" + "Your changes are still here. Try again in a moment." (the server's reason when it gave one, for example "Message is required.") The sheet stays open with the words; the card is unchanged. Done: "Saved "Bus leaves at 6""

In New announcement, where files are attached: "Documents didn’t load." + "Nothing was lost. Try again to attach files." + Try again (reads the page again; the files that arrive can be attached, and what was typed stays). The post still goes with none. Never "No documents yet"
"Couldn't reopen Sign travel waiver" + Retry; it stays done. Done: "Sign travel waiver is open again"

100621.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_UPCOMING_EVENTS_DIDNT_LOAD
100621.meaning: Plan a trip: upcoming events didn't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Upcoming events didn’t load. You can still plan the trip without one, or close and try again."

100622.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_WHO_IS_INVITED_TO
100622.meaning: Plan a trip: who is invited to the chosen event didn't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Who is invited to <event> didn't load, so travelers can't be chosen now. Publish keeps the event's invitees as they are."

100623.name: A_POST_GOES_OUT_BUT_ITS_FILES
100623.meaning: A post goes out but its files don't attach

catalogRow.theySee: "Posted "Waiver" without its files" + "The files didn’t attach, so players see the post with no files. They can still open them in Documents." An error toast (8s, read as an alert) with no Retry, since a Retry would post it again; the sheet has closed and the page read again. Error haptic, no success haptic, and no "Posted" toast beside it. Clean posts say Posted as before
catalogRow.how: `useAction('hub.postAnnouncement')` (`refine` hands the outcome over) + its own toast from `ComposeSheet` ← `createEnrichedAnnouncement` (`attachmentsError` beside the id, `success` stays true)

100624.name: PLAN_A_TRIP_THE_TRAVELERS_CLASSES_DIDNT
100624.meaning: Plan a trip: the travelers' classes didn't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn't check the travelers' classes, so one may clash. Publishing still works." + Try again (asks again, for the same travelers and days). When classes were found and some reads failed: "Some classes couldn’t be checked, so one more may clash." beside the warning. Never "No class meets…". A browser that is offline is this too, with nothing sent. The trip can always be published; the failure is reported at low severity

100625.name: SAVING_AN_EDIT_TO_A_TRIP_FAILS
100625.meaning: Saving an edit to a trip fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn't update Seahawk" + the server's reason, or "What you entered is still here." Retry; the sheet stays open with what was typed. Done: "Seahawk updated", the sheet closes and the page reads again

100701.name: WRITES_REFUSE_OFFLINE
100701.meaning: Every write on the page (a reply, Got it, checking off a task, opening a file, posting an announcement, saving a trip, assigning a task, uploading a file, deleting a post, task or file) is refused while the browser is offline: nothing is sent, the shell's toast names what did not happen (CH-1903), the error haptic fires and nothing moves on; opening a file opens no blank tab.

100801.name: CONTROLS_FOLLOW_THE_ROLE
100801.meaning: The role from the session decides the controls: a player is never drawn New announcement, Plan a trip, Assign, the drop zone or a delete menu, and a coach is never drawn a reply button, Got it or a task box.

100802.name: PLAYER_GETS_ONLY_WHAT_IS_THEIRS
100802.meaning: A player's data carries none of their teammates' read receipts (an announcement's acknowledged and recipient counts), replies, task completions, traveler lists or names, and no roster; those are in a coach's data only, where the same post reads 5 of 6.

100803.name: REPLY_ONLY_WHERE_IT_IS_OPEN
100803.meaning: A player is offered Going, Maybe and Can't only on an event they are invited to that still takes a reply: an event they have no place on the invite list of (the aggregate gives it no reply status, and a reply would add them to the list), one that has started (an all-day event, a day after its stored start), one that was cancelled and one past its RSVP deadline are left off the list, by the rules respondToEvent enforces; a rules read that fails leaves the rows in place for the server to decide.

100804.name: SERVER_ACTIONS_ARE_THE_GATE
100804.meaning: Every write is checked again by its server action, whatever the screen shows: createEnrichedAnnouncement, createGolfTravelItinerary, createTask, createGolfDocument, deleteAnnouncement and deleteTask refuse a caller who is not a coach of the team, and respondToEvent, acknowledgeAnnouncement and completeTask refuse a caller with no player profile or team membership; every document write (upload, create, edit, delete, version delete, restore) is coach-only since Q-74. Forced refusals so far: documents (src/app/golf/actions/__tests__/documents-coach-only.test.ts), travel (travel.test.ts: another team's coach), tasks (src/test/golf/actions/task-authz-failure-vs-refusal.test.ts), posting an announcement (src/test/golf/actions/announcement-attachments.test.ts). Not yet forced: deleteAnnouncement, respondToEvent, acknowledgeAnnouncement and completeTask.

100901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
100901.meaning: A change that lands names itself in a toast with the success haptic (Posted, Seahawk is on Travel, Book physicals assigned to the team, Local rules.pdf shared with the team, Deleted, You're going to Team dinner, Sign travel waiver done); Got it and opening a file land without a toast, since the button turning to Acknowledged and the file opening are the confirmation.

catalogRow.theySee: An alert that names it ("Delete “Short-game block moves to Green 2”?") + "Players stop seeing it, and its acknowledgements go with it. This can’t be undone." Cancel (focused) / Delete announcement; on the phone the iOS action sheet. Warning haptic (NP-05)
"Delete “Sign travel waiver”?" + "It leaves 7 players’ lists, done or not. This can’t be undone." (the assigned count); Cancel (focused) / Delete task (NP-05)
"Delete “NCAA hours log”?" + "Players can no longer open it. This can’t be undone." Cancel (focused) / Delete file (NP-05)

"Delete “Seahawk Intercollegiate”?" + "Players stop seeing the itinerary. Its expenses and budgets are deleted with it, and the calendar event stays. This can’t be undone." Cancel (focused) / Delete trip. Warning haptic (NP-05)

101201.name: FORM_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
101201.meaning: A post, trip or task that fails leaves its sheet open with every field as typed; nothing is cleared until the save lands, and a save that lands clears the form for the next one. Cancel keeps a half-written announcement for as long as the page stays open.

101301.name: CHANGES_SHOW_AT_ONCE
101301.meaning: A reply, Got it and a task check show at once and go back to the last answer the server confirmed if the write is refused or throws; posting, planning a trip, assigning, uploading and deleting are not optimistic: they wait for the write, and a refusal leaves everything as it was.

101401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
101401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything the button would have done follows: the reply, Got it or task tick shows, the file opens in a tab of its own, the sheet closes and clears, the page reads again, the deleted row leaves and its dialog closes, and the drop zone reads Uploading. This holds for all nine writes: a reply, Got it, a task check, opening a file, posting, planning a trip, assigning a task, uploading, and deleting a post, a task or a file.

101402.name: TRY_AGAIN_REREADS_THE_PAGE
101402.meaning: Try again on a failed-read notice has the server read the whole page again; none re-reads a section on its own.

101501.name: PAGE_READS_AGAIN_AFTER_A_CHANGE
101501.meaning: After a coach's post, trip, task, upload or delete lands, the page reads again from the server (router.refresh).

catalogRow.theySee: The underline slides to the new tab on the press (quick), as on a player's profile

The panel renders just behind the underline (`useDeferredValue`) and fades in with a 6px rise (base) while the old one fades out (quick), hidden from assistive tech. Instant with reduced motion; never on first paint

101701.name: A_TAB_AN_RSVP_REPLY_AN_AUDIENCE
101701.meaning: A tab, an RSVP reply, an audience or transport choice, a player chip, a file to attach or take off

catalogRow.theySee: select; the current choice is silent

101702.name: DELETE_A_FORM_SENT_WITH_A_MISTAKE
101702.meaning: Delete (before the question), a form sent with a mistake

catalogRow.theySee: warning

101801.name: THE_SECTIONS_ARE_REAL_TABS_AN_RSVP
101801.meaning: The sections are real tabs (selected state, each controls its panel); an RSVP is a radio group named for its event; a task's box names the task and says when it's done

101802.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_STATE
101802.meaning: No axe violations in any preview state, 1280px and 390px

101901.name: PHONE_LAYOUT
101901.meaning: At 820px and below Team Hub is the phone build, never a shrunken desktop: the page takes the phone frame, the title is read by a screen reader instead of drawn, and the same tabs, writes and sheets are there. State, writes and sheets are the desktop's.

102001.name: TABS_AND_REPLIES_WORK_FROM_THE_KEYBOARD
102001.meaning: The tabs are one stop in the tab order: left and right arrows (wrapping), Home and End move between them and select, and Tab goes on to the panel. The reply buttons are native buttons: Enter or Space presses them. Esc closes a sheet and focus goes back to the button that opened it.

102101.name: LOADER_READS_IN_ROUNDS
102101.meaning: The server loader reads the page for either role before first paint, in a few rounds of parallel reads and never one request per row: attendance, task completion and a player's reply rules are each read once for every event or task together (in chunks of 200); a read that fails is flagged on its own section and logged, never thrown, so a partial read still renders the rest.

102301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
102301.meaning: A read that fails in the loader is logged through chLogServer("hub", {read}) and named on the page; a write that fails is reported through chReport under the hub surface with its action (hub.reply and the rest), at low severity when the server refused it, after a chTrail breadcrumb for the intent (hub tab {tab}, action hub.{name}); a section that crashes reports under its own surface (hub.updates and the rest).

102401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
102401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/hub.test.tsx names in a test title every Team Hub catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 that is not marked preview, and every hand contract on this page it proves by its Bridge ID.

110101.name: LIBRARY_READY
110101.meaning: Rounds opens for a player on "Your rounds", read on the server before first paint: the round in progress (or the idle card, "No round in progress") beside the season card, then the search and grouping tools and every posted round by month or by course. The header reads "Since August 1 · N counted rounds". Only the player's own rounds are read (110803).

110102.name: REVIEW_READY
110102.meaning: A round's review at /golf/dashboard/rounds/[id] opens for the player who played it and for a coach of their team: the hero (day, date and type, the course, tee swatch, yards, rating and slope, then the score and its to par), the figures (Front 9, Back 9 on an 18-hole round, Putts, Fairways, Greens), the scorecard as two captioned nines, the hole card with the shots of the picked hole, the scoring distribution, and the round recap and the player's notes when there are any. It opens on the first hole over par, else the first hole. Back goes to Rounds for a player and, for a coach, to that player's rounds on Stats with the player's name (D-53); a coach's kicker names the player and the notes are labelled with the player's first name ("Jonah's notes" in the preview).

110103.name: SETUP_READY
110103.meaning: A new round's setup (at /golf/dashboard/rounds/new, over the new-round engine; also the dev preview) opens on the green band with its steps (Course, Scorecard, Track), the course card ("Choose a course", Browse courses), an open qualifier when there is one, Round details (type, date, holes), the scorecard's place held ("Your scorecard appears here once you pick a course and tees.") and the dock, whose Start round is off and names why ("Choose a course to start"). Picking tees reads that tee's holes and fills the scorecard; a hole changed for this round is counted and marked ("1 hole edited for this round"), edits never leave this round, and the dock then reads "Course · Tee · N holes · Par P".

110104.name: TRACKING_READY
110104.meaning: The shot screen (inside the round screen at /rounds/new and /rounds/continue/[id]) opens on the hole it is given: the top bar with Exit and Scorecard, the hole strip, the hole hero (hole number, par, yards, "Shot N" and the distance to the pin), the hole map and the shot log, and the shot entry, whose Next shot is off with the one thing missing named above it. Every rule and write is useShotTracking, the hook the Fairway screen runs; the round screen around it owns Exit, the scorecard, Round complete and Submit.

110105.name: UNBUILT_TARGETS_ARE_NOT_DRAWN
110105.meaning: A control whose screen is not rebuilt is not drawn, never a dead button (nav.rebuiltHref). New round, Continue and Submit lead to /rounds/new and /rounds/continue/[id], which are rebuilt for a player (round entry, over the round engine), so they are drawn; a coach's are not, since a coach does not log rounds. /rounds/recover is rebuilt for a player (swap audit F-02) and is reached from a failed submit, so nothing in the Library links there. Every posted round in the book opens its review. A round whose review cannot be opened is still listed, as one named group. /rounds/[id]/review (CoachHelm's) is not rebuilt for either role, and neither is the coach's Rounds library.

110106.name: UNFINISHED_ROUNDS_ARE_LISTED
110106.meaning: The newest unfinished round fills the card; every other one is listed under "N more unfinished rounds" with Discard, Continue or Post. A round whose every hole has a score reads "Ready to post" (the card says "Post round"), unless a completed round already holds that course and day, and never when the hole read failed. The card's strip marks each scored hole against par and rings the next one.

110107.name: NOT_COUNTED_ROUNDS_STILL_LIST
110107.meaning: A posted round that does not count (isScoreCountable: every hole scored, or an 18-hole total posted without its holes, Q-123) is still listed, with a "Not counted" pill, and sets no season figure. A round posted as a total only counts toward the season average, to par and best score, and has no greens or putts to add. A 9-hole round shows its hole count in place of Out and In and sets no season figure either (full 18-hole rounds only, as on Home and Stats).

110108.name: SEARCH_AND_GROUP_THE_BOOK
110108.meaning: The book is searched by course (client side, any part of the name, ignoring case) and grouped by month, newest first, or by course, in the order of each course's newest round; each group shows its round count, its average over its 18-hole rounds and its low. A search with no match says so (CH-11303) and keeps the tools where they are.

110109.name: A_ROUND_STILL_BEING_PLAYED_GOES_TO_BE_CONTINUED
110109.meaning: Opening a round that is still in progress at /rounds/[id] redirects to /rounds/continue/[id], as the legacy page does. A Clubhouse player lands on the rebuilt Continue screen, which draws the round the page loaded over the continue engine.

110110.name: START_HANDS_THE_WHOLE_FORM_TO_THE_ROUND_SCREEN
110110.meaning: Start round hands the round screen's port one form: the course and tee ids (or the course typed by hand), the round type, the date, 9 or 18 holes and which nine, every hole's par and yardage as edited, the qualifier and the round it counts as, and whether to save a typed course. It goes through useAction; the round opens (onStarted) only when the port answers with the new round's id, and that follow-up is inside the action, so a Retry opens it too (111401). The port is the round screen's: the new-round engine's start(form) (setup-reads#toStartForm), which checks the form, the hole rules and, for a qualifier round, the server's answer before it starts, and then runs the round under that form. Each refusal has its own state: the conflict dialog (CH-11514), a qualifier round in progress that opens (CH-11907), a toast with no Retry (CH-11014), with Retry (CH-11007, CH-11015) or with Start anyway (CH-11016).

110111.name: A_NINE_HOLE_ROUND_PLAYS_ONE_NINE
110111.meaning: A 9-hole tee set plays 9 and turns 18 off. On an 18-hole card, choosing 9 holes offers Front 9 or Back 9, and the dock and the scorecard total the chosen nine ("9 holes · Par 36").

110112.name: TRACKING_FOLLOWS_THE_DISTANCE_UNIT
110112.meaning: The shot screen follows the player's distance unit: the hero, the section labels ("Distance remaining (m)") and the quick picks read in meters when the preference is meters. What the engine stores stays yards and feet.

110113.name: THE_OPEN_QUALIFIER_SETS_THE_ROUND
110113.meaning: When the player has an open qualifier, it is offered above Round details. Play sets the type to Qualifier, the course and the tees, and the note says which round it counts as ("This counts as round 3 of 3 in Fall qualifier 2"). Choosing the Qualifier type lists the player's qualifiers; one with no round open is listed but cannot be chosen (110805).

110114.name: ROUND_ENTRY_FOLLOWS_THE_FLAG
110114.meaning: /golf/dashboard/rounds/new and /golf/dashboard/rounds/continue/[id] draw Clubhouse's screens for a player (the dashboard layout's role): Continue's page loads the round once (its owner, that it is still in progress, its holes, shots and yardages, the qualifier round numbers left to choose) and hands it to Clubhouse, and each route's loading is Clubhouse's skeleton inside the shell (CH-11407). A coach on /rounds/new keeps the legacy message. Fairway's round entry was retired (2026-11-14).

110115.name: A_SHOTGUN_START_CHANGES_ONLY_THE_ORDER
110115.meaning: Once the scorecard is in, Round details offers "Starting hole": the holes the round plays, by the card's numbers, the first played by default; the dock adds "· Starts on hole N" when it is not the first. Start hands the engine the start as a position in the holes played (setup-reads#toStartForm `setup.startHole`); every autosave keeps it in draft_data, so Continue resumes in the same order. Holes keep their numbers and places everywhere (strip, scorecard, Out/In, Front · Back, the review); only the walk changes: from 6 the round plays 6 to 18, then 1 to 5, and finishes after the 18th hole played. A 9-hole round wraps inside its nine. The strip lets the player go back to holes played earlier in that order, never ahead past the next one; Round complete's Back names the hole the round ended on; the unfinished card's next hole follows the order (lib/golf/round-session/play-order.ts).

110116.name: YOUR_SAVED_COURSES_ARE_OFFERED
110116.meaning: Round setup's course picker lists the player's own saved courses (golf_player_courses, getPlayerSavedCourses, the source Fairway's setup reads) as "Your courses", after Recently played. A saved course is left out when the library already lists its course (its course_id, or a library course of the same name, spaces and case aside), so a course is offered once. It has one tee set, the one it was saved with (White when none was named, as on Fairway), and its card is the holes it was saved with (a blank card of its length when it has none). Starting from it sends what Fairway's saved-course start sends: the course's name, city, state, rating, slope and tees, its library link if it has one, and no tee; a course with no library course behind it is offered to the library with Fairway's input and the round is linked to the course and tee that offer finds or creates (the engine's opt-in libraryOffer), so later checkpoints and the submit carry them, as Fairway's do; the course is touched once the round starts (Fairway touches it when picked), best-effort. A saved course's card needs a yardage on at least one hole; the rest start at 0. A failed saved-courses read leaves the library as it is.

110201.name: THE_PAGE_IS_ON_ITS_WAY
110201.meaning: The page is on its way

catalogRow.theySee: The header, the round card beside the season card, the tools and four rows, in place
"Saving hole 4…" with a spinner above its shots; the shots can't be changed until it lands
Six blocks in the shape of a course card (a photo and two lines), still, `aria-busy`

Rarely seen: a course's tees are asked for as the hand reaches its card (hover, focus, press), so the tee list usually opens on them. When they are still on the way, a quiet space the height of a tee, with no shimmer, `aria-busy`

110205.name: THE_PICKED_TEES_SCORECARD_IS_LOADING
110205.meaning: The picked tees' scorecard is loading

catalogRow.theySee: Nine hole-row blocks where the scorecard goes; Start waits ("Loading the scorecard")

110206.name: REVIEW_LOADS_UNDER_A_CLUBHOUSE_SKELETON
110206.meaning: A round's review loads under the Clubhouse review skeleton (CH-11406) at /rounds/[id]; the old /rounds/[id]/review address is a next.config redirect there, so it has no loading of its own.

catalogRow.theySee: The back link, the green hero, the figures and the scorecard frame as skeletons, in place; outside Clubhouse, Fairway's

110208.name: ROUND_ENTRY_IS_ON_ITS_WAY_THE
110208.meaning: Round entry is on its way: the address's own loading, and, on /rounds/new, the beat before the device's day and the player's qualifiers are read

catalogRow.theySee: The back link, the course card, the details and scorecard cards and the dock, in place, `aria-busy`. A round being continued loads in the tracking screen's own shape instead (the hole head, the map and the shot log, `RoundRuntimeSkeleton`, GAP-S-18), so the page doesn't jump from a form to the course. Outside Clubhouse, Fairway's
catalogRow.how: `RoundEntrySkeleton` via `ClubhouseSwitch` in `rounds/new/loading.tsx`, `RoundRuntimeSkeleton` in `continue/[id]/loading.tsx`, and `NewRound` while it reads

catalogRow.theySee: Skeleton: the header and two saved rounds, in place. Clubhouse only (the route's `loading.tsx` goes through `ClubhouseSwitch`; Fairway keeps its own)

110210.name: READING_THE_DEVICE_FOR_SAVED_ROUNDS
110210.meaning: Reading the device for saved rounds

catalogRow.theySee: Under the header, two card skeletons in place of the list, announced as "Scanning this device for saved rounds"

110211.name: THE_ROUNDS_LIBRARY_IS_REFRESHING_WITH_THE
110211.meaning: The Rounds library is refreshing (a Try again is running) with the page on screen

catalogRow.theySee: The page stays, `aria-busy`, and "Updating…" appears beside the season line, in a status region; no skeleton and nothing blanks. It goes when the new page lands

110212.name: A_ROUND_TYPE_CHANGE_IS_IN_FLIGHT
110212.meaning: A round-type change is in flight

catalogRow.theySee: Save reads "Saving…" and can't be pressed again; Cancel, the choices and dismissing wait

110213.name: TEAM_ROUNDS_IS_REFRESHING_WITH_THE_PAGE
110213.meaning: Team rounds is refreshing (a Try again is running) with the page on screen

catalogRow.theySee: The page stays, `aria-busy`, and "Updating…" appears beside the season line, in a status region; nothing blanks
A skeleton in the page's own shape (head, four figures, a search row, grouped rows); `aria-busy` with the label "Loading team rounds"
"Your history here didn’t load" + "Nothing you saved is lost. Try again." (offline: "You’re offline. Reconnect, then try again.") + Try again

110280.name: EXPORT_IS_READING_THE_HOLES_OF_THE
110280.meaning: Export is reading the holes of the rounds it holds (F-02)

catalogRow.theySee: The key reads “Exporting…”, `aria-busy`, and can’t be pressed again; on the phone the icon key is unlit and a status region says “Exporting…”

110401.name: NO_ROUND_POSTED_AND_NONE_IN_PROGRESS
110401.meaning: No round posted and none in progress

catalogRow.theySee: "No rounds yet" + "Track your first round shot by shot. Your scores, stats and every round you post show up here." New round, once round entry is rebuilt

110402.name: ROUNDS_POSTED_BUT_NO_COUNTABLE_18_HOLE
110402.meaning: Rounds posted, but no countable 18-hole round since August 1

catalogRow.theySee: "Your season starts with your first 18‑hole round" (a non-breaking hyphen, so it never breaks "18- / hole") + "Scoring average, best round, putts and greens fill in here from 18-hole rounds posted since August 1." The rounds still list below
"No rounds at “Pinehurst”" + "Check the spelling, or search part of the course name."

"No round in progress" · "Ready when you are" + "Start a round and track every shot. It saves as you go, so you can pick it back up here." A ghost 18-hole strip, then "Last round Sep 26 · Finley GC" (or "No rounds posted yet"). Its New round is the page's one primary: the head's New round shows only with a round in progress, or when the check for one failed (CH-11202)

110405.name: A_ROUND_POSTED_AS_A_TOTAL_WITH
110405.meaning: A round posted as a total, with no holes

catalogRow.theySee: "Posted as a total" + "This round was posted with its score only, so there’s no hole-by-hole card or shots to show." The hero and figures still show

110406.name: A_HOLE_WITH_A_SCORE_BUT_NO
110406.meaning: A hole with a score but no shots tracked

catalogRow.theySee: "No shots were tracked on this hole. It was scored as a total."

110407.name: A_ROUND_THAT_DOESNT_EXIST_OR_ONE
110407.meaning: A round that doesn't exist, or one this viewer may not see

catalogRow.theySee: "This round isn’t here" + "It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong. Everything else is where you left it." (the one not-found line, CH-1306, GAP-S-24) + Go to your rounds / Go to Stats. The same page either way, so it never confirms someone else's round exists

110408.name: A_HOLE_WITH_NO_SHOTS_YET
110408.meaning: A hole with no shots yet

catalogRow.theySee: "No shots yet on this hole" in the shot log; for four seconds after the hole before it saved and play moved on, "Hole 4 saved · Birdie" in its place

The scorecard's place holds a faint card: the hole numbers 1 to 9, with no grey bars beside them (they read as loading, wave 10), and "Your scorecard appears here once you pick a course and tees."; the dock says "Choose a course to start"

110410.name: THE_COURSE_SEARCH_MATCHES_NOTHING
110410.meaning: The course search matches nothing (or the library is empty)

catalogRow.theySee: "No courses match “zzz”. Check the spelling, or use Add a course."

110411.name: A_COURSE_HAS_NO_TEES_READY_TO
110411.meaning: A course has no tees ready to play

catalogRow.theySee: "Chapel Ridge GC has no tees ready to play yet. A coach can finish them in the course library; for now, add the course by hand."; draft tees show, not playable

110412.name: QUALIFIER_CHOSEN_BUT_NONE_IS_OPEN
110412.meaning: Qualifier chosen, but none is open

catalogRow.theySee: "No qualifier is open for you right now. Your coach opens one when it’s time; until then, play a practice or tournament round."

110413.name: FIRST_RUN_ONLY_WHEN_EVERY_READ_ANSWERED
110413.meaning: The first-run page ("No rounds yet", CH-11301) shows only when the posted-rounds read and the in-progress read both answered and both were empty: a failed list read shows its own notice (CH-11201) and a failed in-progress check its own (CH-11202), never the first-run page.

110414.name: A_ROUND_WITH_NO_STROKES_GAINED
110414.meaning: A round with no strokes gained (posted without shots)

catalogRow.theySee: One line where the Strokes gained card would be: "No strokes gained for this round. It is worked out from shots tracked hole by hole." The hero, figures and card still show

110415.name: NOTHING_ON_THIS_DEVICE_TO_RECOVER
110415.meaning: Nothing on this device to recover

catalogRow.theySee: Page empty state "Nothing to recover" + "A round saved only on this device after an interruption or a failed submit shows up here. This page finds the rounds the browser and device you are on tracked." + Back to Rounds. It is also what shows after the last saved round is discarded

110416.name: COMPLETED_ROUNDS_WITH_NO_SCORE_AT_ALL
110416.meaning: Completed rounds with no score at all (no total and no nines)

catalogRow.theySee: Under the book: "1 posted round has no score recorded, so it isn’t listed here." (or "N posted rounds have ... aren’t listed here."). Such a round can't be a row and never counted in a figure (no total is never countable), but it is said, not hidden; with nothing else on the page it is not "No rounds yet". A failed list says nothing about it

110417.name: CHANGE_ROUND_TYPE_THE_PLAYER_IS_IN
110417.meaning: Change round type: there is no qualifier to choose

catalogRow.theySee: Under Qualifier, for a player: "You aren’t in any qualifier yet, so this round can’t count toward one. Ask your coach to add you, then change it here." 110507.meaning: A hole's yardage is missing or too long (1 to 999, the legacy editor's bounds)

110508.meaning: Adding a course: a step isn't complete

catalogRow.theySee: "Every round of Fall Qualifier already has one of your rounds in it, so this one can’t be added. Pick another qualifier, or change the round in the wrong slot first." Save waits

"Couldn’t discard the round at Finley GC" + "It is still saved. Try again, or continue it instead." + Retry; the card stays. Done: "Round discarded", and the card goes, whether the discard came from the dialog or from Retry

"Your rounds didn’t load" + "Nothing is lost. Your posted rounds are still saved; try again in a moment." + Try again (asks the server again). The season card, search and the book are not drawn; it never reads as "no rounds"
"Couldn’t check for a round in progress" + "Any round you started is still saved. Try again in a moment." + Try again, in place of the card
"Season scoring couldn’t be shown." (or "Your round in progress", "Your rounds") + "The rest of the page is fine. This has been reported automatically." + Try again; the rest of the page stays

110605.name: A_REVIEWS_HOLE_BY_HOLE_CARD_DOESNT

"The shots for this round didn’t load" + "The scorecard is right; only the shot-by-shot detail is missing." + Try again, in the hole card
"This round didn’t load" + "Nothing is lost; the round is still saved. Try again in a moment." + Try again
Under the undo question: "Couldn’t undo the shot. It’s still on your card; try again." The shot stays
"Hole 4 didn’t save." + "Your shots are kept on this device. Try again to move on." (offline: "Reconnect, then try again.") + Try again; the round doesn't move on until it saves

110610.name: CHANGING_OR_DELETING_A_SHOT_FAILS

"The round didn’t post" + the engine's sentence, or "It’s saved on this device. Try again." + Try again, and Go back (to the finish sheet), so a failure that retrying won't clear isn't a dead end. A closed qualifier is CH-11516 instead
In the discard question: "Couldn’t discard the round." + the reason; the round is kept

110613.name: THE_SHOT_SCREEN_GETS_A_HOLE_THAT

catalogRow.theySee: "This hole didn’t load. Go back to Rounds and continue the round from there."
"Couldn’t start your round at Finley GC" + "Nothing was saved yet. Try again in a moment." + Retry; Retry opens the round when it lands
"The tees at Finley GC didn’t load" + "Try again, or add the course by hand." + Try again
"The course library didn’t load" + "Your round isn’t started yet, so nothing is lost. Try again, or add the course by hand." + Try again

110617.name: THE_PICKED_TEES_SCORECARD_DOESNT_LOAD
110617.meaning: The picked tees' scorecard doesn't load

110618.name: THE_PLAYERS_QUALIFIERS_DONT_LOAD
110618.meaning: The player's qualifiers don't load (Qualifier chosen)

110619.name: A_PARTIAL_READ_STILL_RENDERS_THE_REST
110619.meaning: A read that fails is logged, flagged on its own part and never thrown, so the rest of the page renders. In the library the posted rounds (CH-11201) and the in-progress check (CH-11202) fail apart, and a failed hole read leaves the in-progress card without its strip and never says it is ready to submit. In the review the holes and the shots fail apart (CH-11204, CH-11205) with the hero and the figures still drawn. The round itself failing is CH-11206.

110620.name: RESTORING_THE_ROUND_SAVED_ON_THIS_DEVICE
110620.meaning: Restoring the round saved on this device fails

catalogRow.theySee: Above the options in the dialog: "Couldn’t restore your saved shots." + the reason in words ("That save did not go through. Your shots are still on this device. Please try again.") or, with none, "They are still on this device. Keep this screen open and try again."; Restore is enabled again. Error haptic (CH-11709). The legacy screens set this on the page behind the open dialog, where nobody saw it

110621.name: DISCARDING_THE_ROUND_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS_FAILS
110621.meaning: Discarding the round already in progress fails

catalogRow.theySee: In the discard question: "Couldn’t discard the round." + the reason, or "It is still saved. Try again, or resume it instead."; the question stays. Error haptic (CH-11709). The legacy screen set this on the setup page behind the open dialog

Toast "Couldn’t save your round at Finley GC" + the reason ("Another save for this round is just finishing. Try again in a moment.") or "Your shots are still on this device. Try again." + Retry. Error haptic (CH-11709). It renders inside an open dialog (CH-1812), so it covers the Exit sheet and the closed-qualifier sheet alike; the legacy Exit sheet drew the thrown message, and the submit overlay's Save & exit drew nothing. Raised again, it takes the place of the one on screen (G18: `replace` key, never two stacked); so do CH-11011 and CH-11902

110623.name: DISCARDING_FAILS_WHERE_NO_DISCARD_QUESTION_HOLDS
110623.meaning: Discarding fails where no discard question holds the message

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t discard the round at Finley GC" + the action's own reason when it is readable ("This round can no longer be discarded. It was already finished."), or "It is still saved. Try again, or keep playing." + Retry. Error haptic (CH-11709). The Exit sheet's own question shows CH-11006 instead

110624.name: CHANGING_A_ROUND_TO_PRACTICE_FAILS
110624.meaning: Changing a round to practice fails (qualifier closed)

catalogRow.theySee: On the sheet: "Couldn’t change this round to practice." + the reason, or "Your round is still saved. Try again in a moment."; the choices stay. Error haptic (CH-11709)

110625.name: THE_ROUND_REPORTS_AN_ERROR_WHILE_TRACKING
110625.meaning: The round reports an error while tracking (a failed checkpoint or auto-save, a restore or discard that didn't work)

catalogRow.theySee: The shot screen's red note with an action (as CH-11003) above the shot screen: the round's own sentence and Dismiss (silent: it only hides the message). No Reload. Error haptic (CH-11709). Before the legacy banner (B4) these had no surface outside a submit

110626.name: STARTING_A_QUALIFIER_ROUND_THAT_IS_NO
110626.meaning: Starting a qualifier round that is no longer open to the player (played already, or past the qualifier's rounds)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t start your round at Finley GC" + the engine's sentence ("Round 1 of this qualifier is not open to you now. Your next round is 2."). No Retry: asking again gets the same answer; the setup's qualifier list is the way to pick another

110627.name: THE_QUALIFIERS_NEXT_ROUND_COULDNT_BE_CHECKED
110627.meaning: The qualifier's next round couldn't be checked before starting (offline, signed out, not entered)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t start your round at Finley GC" + the engine's sentence ("We could not verify your next qualifier round. Try again before starting.") + Retry, which checks again. Nothing was started

110628.name: STARTING_A_ROUND_ON_A_COURSE_AND
110628.meaning: Starting a round on a course and day that already has a completed round

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t start your round at Finley GC" + "You already have a completed round for this course on this date. Tap Start round again to start a new one anyway." + Start anyway, which is that second Start (the engine confirms on the second call and starts). Nothing was started yet

Toast "Couldn’t restore the round at Finley GC" + the reason in words ("Another save for this round is just finishing. Try again in a moment."; the round_missing sentence is shown whole, not dropped) or "It is still saved on this device. Try again." + Retry, which restores again and opens the round when it lands. The card and every device copy stay: nothing on the device is cleared until the server confirms. Error haptic (CH-11709)
catalogRow.how: `RoundRecover` (`useAction('rounds.recover.resume')`) → `LIVE_RECOVER_PORTS.resume`, Fairway's recovery ported (`writeRoundRecreatingIfMissing`, `savePartialRound` with `allowReuse` on the first call only, or `submitGolfRoundComprehensive` for a finished round whose submit failed)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t sync your rounds" + the engine's sentence or "They are still saved on this device. Try again in a moment." + Retry. The device is read again whatever the answer. Done: "Synced 2 rounds"; "A sync is already running" (the engine declined, which is not a failure); "Nothing was sent this time. Restore a round to send it now" (every round is inside its retry wait, or out of retries)

Toast "Couldn’t discard the round at Finley GC" + the reason or "It is still saved on this device. Try again." + Retry; the card stays and no device copy and no discard mark is changed. A round that exists only on this device is discarded offline too (nothing is sent); one the server holds is refused offline (CH-1903). Done: "Round discarded", and the card goes
catalogRow.how: `useAction('rounds.recover.discard')` → `LIVE_RECOVER_PORTS.discard` (the Library's discard for a round the server holds, then every device copy)

110632.name: THIS_DEVICES_SAVED_ROUNDS_CANT_BE_READ
110632.meaning: This device's saved rounds can't be read (every store failed and nothing was found)

catalogRow.theySee: "This device’s saved rounds couldn’t be read" + "Nothing is deleted. Use the same browser and device that tracked the round, then try again." + Try again, which reads the device again. It never reads as "Nothing to recover"

110633.name: THE_IN_PROGRESS_CARDS_HOLES_DONT_LOAD
110633.meaning: The in-progress card's holes don't load (the read of the round's scored holes failed)

catalogRow.theySee: Under the strip: "This round’s scores didn’t load" + "The round is saved. Try again to see how far you are." + Try again ("Trying again…" while it runs). The strip draws hole numbers only, faint, with nothing marked scored and no next hole ringed; the score-through line is not drawn, and Continue still goes to the saved current hole. In the "more unfinished" list the round reads "scores didn’t load", never "not started". It never reads "Set up, no holes scored yet"

110634.name: A_FINISHED_IN_PROGRESS_ROUND_WHILE_THE
110634.meaning: A finished in-progress round (every hole scored) while the posted rounds didn't load, so "already posted" can't be ruled out

catalogRow.theySee: Under the strip: "Couldn’t check whether this round was already posted" + "Every hole is scored, but your posted rounds didn’t load, so Post round isn’t offered here yet. Try again." + Try again. The card says In progress and Continue, never Ready to post or Post round; Continue opens the round, whose finish sheet posts it. In the "more unfinished" list such a round reads "through 18 · couldn’t check if posted" and is Continue, never Post

110635.name: A_REVIEWS_SUPPORTING_READS_FAIL_THE_TEE
110635.meaning: A review's supporting reads fail: the tee (its yardage) or, for a coach, the player's name

catalogRow.theySee: Under the hero: "Some details of this round didn’t load" + "The tee’s yardage is missing; the scores are right. Try again in a moment." (or "The player’s name is missing", or "The tee’s yardage and the player’s name are missing") + Try again. A coach never sees the invented name "Player", whether the name's read failed or found no player row: the kicker leaves the name out, Back still goes to that player's rounds on Stats, and the notes are "The player’s notes"

110636.name: A_REVIEWS_TEAM_READ_FAILS_SO_WHICH
110636.meaning: A review's team read fails, so which Tour the strokes gained is measured against is unknown

catalogRow.theySee: In the Strokes gained card: "Which Tour this is measured against didn’t load" + "The strokes gained numbers are the round’s own; only the baseline’s name is missing. Try again in a moment." + Try again. A player with no team at all gets no notice (that claims no baseline, CH-4210); nor does a round with no strokes gained

110637.name: A_REFRESH_OF_THE_ROUNDS_LIBRARY_FAILS
110637.meaning: A refresh of the Rounds library fails while the page already shows rounds (Try again, or any server render of the page, whose read of the posted rounds or of the round in progress failed)

catalogRow.theySee: Above the page: "Your rounds may be out of date" + "We couldn’t refresh them just now. This is what loaded last time." + Try again ("Trying again…" while it runs, a second tap does nothing). The last library that loaded in full stays on screen (the rounds, the season, the card); neither the error (CH-11201, CH-11202) nor an empty copy replaces it. A first load that fails, and another player's, is the error as before: an old library is never kept across players

110638.name: CHANGING_A_LIVE_ROUNDS_TYPE_FAILS
110638.meaning: Changing a round's type fails (Continue round, or a submitted round's review, CH-11522)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t change the round type" + the server's sentence when it is written for a person ("Round 2 of that qualifier is already taken by another round."), or, for a permission refusal, a player reads: "Your account can’t move this round into that qualifier. You need to be entered in it and an active member of the team. Ask your coach, then try again." and a coach reads: "Your account can’t change this round. Only a coach of the team the round was played for can. Reload and try again." Otherwise "Your round and every shot are still saved. Try again in a moment." (the review: "The round and its scores are unchanged. Try again in a moment."). Retry; the sheet stays open. Offline, nothing is sent (CH-1903). Done: "This round now counts as round 3 of Fall Qualifier" (or "as a tournament round"), with " · the player was entered in it" when a coach's save entered them, the sheet closes and the page refreshes

110639.name: CHANGE_ROUND_TYPE_THE_PLAYERS_QUALIFIER_ENTRIES
110639.meaning: Change round type: the player's qualifier entries (or the slots their rounds hold, or, for a coach on a review, the team's qualifiers) didn't load

catalogRow.theySee: Under Qualifier: "Your qualifiers didn’t load, so there’s nothing to choose from yet. Close this and reopen it from the round in a moment." Never "none"; Save waits. The read is logged (`clubhouse.rounds.roundTypeQualifiers` / `roundTypeTakenSlots`; on a review `clubhouse.rounds.review.roundTypeQualifiers` / `roundTypeTeamQualifiers` / `roundTypeTakenSlots`)

110640.name: SAVING_THE_COACHS_NOTE_ON_A_ROUND
110640.meaning: Saving the coach's note on a round fails (the review's Coach note card)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Couldn’t save the note" + "What you wrote is still here. Try again in a moment." + Retry; the editor stays open with the text. A refusal (a note over 2,000 characters, a round not yet posted, a coach of another team) shows the server's sentence in place of the hint. Error haptic (CH-11709)

110641.name: A_REFRESH_OF_TEAM_ROUNDS_FAILS_WHILE
110641.meaning: A refresh of Team rounds fails while the page already shows rounds

catalogRow.theySee: "The team’s rounds may be out of date" + "We couldn’t refresh them just now. This is what loaded last time." + Try again, above the list; the list stays

110642.name: TEAM_ROUNDS_THE_ROSTER_DOESNT_LOAD
110642.meaning: Team rounds: the roster doesn't load

catalogRow.theySee: "Your roster didn’t load" + "Nothing is lost. The team’s rounds are still saved; try again in a moment." + Try again, in place of the list (without the roster the names, and so the list, can't be trusted)

110643.name: TEAM_ROUNDS_THE_POSTED_ROUNDS_DONT_LOAD
110643.meaning: Team rounds: the posted rounds don't load

catalogRow.theySee: "The team’s rounds didn’t load" + "Nothing is lost. Posted rounds are still saved; try again in a moment." + Try again, in place of the figures and list

110644.name: A_ROUNDS_COACH_NOTE_CANT_BE_CHECKED
110644.meaning: A round's coach note can't be checked (the read of `golf_round_reviews.coach_notes` failed)

catalogRow.theySee: In the Coach note card, in place of "No note on this round yet.": an inline notice "We couldn’t check for a coach note" + Try again, which re-reads in place (F-0061). A coach can still add one; a player sees it only when there is nothing else to read

110680.name: EXPORT_ON_ROUNDS_OR_TEAM_ROUNDS_FAILS
110680.meaning: Export on Rounds or Team rounds fails: the holes didn’t load, or the browser refused the file (launch readiness F-02)

catalogRow.theySee: Error toast “Couldn’t export the rounds” + “The scores didn’t load, so nothing was exported. Try again in a moment.” or “Your browser didn’t take the file. Try again, or export from a computer.” Done: “Rounds exported · 42 rounds”, and the file downloads (desktop) or opens the share sheet (phone)

110690.name: A_ROUND_REVIEWS_HISTORY_READ_FAILS_ON
110690.meaning: A round review's history read fails, on the server or as a stream cut off in the browser (GAP-S-27)

catalogRow.theySee: After the details notice (CH-11216): "History didn’t load" + "Records and past rounds are left out. This round’s own figures are unaffected. Try again." + Try again. Before, the records and past rounds were silently left out, so a personal best read as no record

110691.name: A_SECTION_OF_ROUND_TRACKING_OR_OF
110691.meaning: A section of round tracking or of the course page throws while drawing (GAP-S-10)

catalogRow.theySee: In place of that section only: "The hole map couldn’t be shown" / "The shots on this hole couldn’t be shown" (tracking), or "The figures …", "Last time here …", "The hole map …", "How it plays …", "The round here …", "Your rounds here couldn’t be shown" (course page) + the shared body + Try again, which redraws it. Scoring keeps working; on the course page two or more failures are said once above them (CH-1210). Shot entry is never wrapped

110701.name: THE_ROUND_SAVES_IN_THE_BACKGROUND
110701.meaning: The round saves in the background

catalogRow.theySee: A quiet line beside the distance readout (or the holed score) in the hero: "Saving round", "Round saved" (only once the server answered for the shots on screen, and held for as long as those exact shots are on screen: a new shot, edit, undo or hole change drops it), "Saved on this phone" (the save is held: offline, queued, refused until a reload), "Saved on this phone · syncing" (a shot not yet acknowledged whose device copy landed; nothing is said when the device copy failed) or "Not synced yet, retrying" (the engine retries on its own)

110702.name: WRITES_REFUSE_OFFLINE
110702.meaning: Discard (the library) and Start (setup) go through useAction: while the browser is offline nothing is sent, the error haptic fires and the shell's toast names what did not happen, with Retry (10703). On the shot screen, Try again on a hole that did not save, while offline, gives the warning haptic and sends nothing (the card already says "Reconnect, then try again."). Round entry's Start and Save for later are forced offline in round-entry-wiring.test (CH-1903: nothing is sent, and a browser that says offline but reaches the server goes ahead); the library's Discard, setup's Start and the hole's Try again are driven offline (the browser's own flag) in rounds-contracts.test.tsx. Exit's Discard is forced offline in round-entry-wiring.test (nothing is sent and a hole that exists only on the device keeps its device copy). A discard whose request never lands keeps the device copy and the queued entry (rounds.test for the library's write, use-new-round-session.preservation.test for the engine's). The shell's tests cover useAction's refusal.

110703.name: THE_ROUND_CHANGED_ON_ANOTHER_DEVICE_AND
110703.meaning: The round changed on another device and this one stopped saving

catalogRow.theySee: The shot screen's amber note with an action (as CH-11003) above the shot screen: "This round was updated on another device." + "Saving is paused here so this device can’t overwrite the newer round. Reload to continue." + Reload ("Reloading…" once tapped); nothing to dismiss. A Save for later refused for the same reason shows it as a toast with Reload instead of Retry. The two engines word it differently ("Please reload.", "Reload to continue."); both are this state. Error haptic (CH-11709). The legacy screens draw no "restoring" or "back online" state here, so neither does this

110704.name: THE_ENGINE_REPORTS_THAT_AUTO_SAVE_IS
110704.meaning: The engine reports that auto-save is having trouble ("Auto-save is having trouble. …", both engines)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Saving is slow" + "Your shots are safe on this device. The copy on the server may be late." At most once a minute (the engine throttles it)

110705.name: THE_DEVICE_COULDNT_KEEP_ITS_QUICK_LOCAL
110705.meaning: The device couldn't keep its quick local backup

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "This device couldn’t keep a quick backup" + "Your shots are still saving to a slower backup and to the server." Once a session

110706.name: A_SUBMIT_COULDNT_REACH_THE_SERVER_AND
110706.meaning: A submit couldn't reach the server, and the round is saved on the device

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Your round is saved on this device" + "It couldn’t reach the server. Restore it on the next screen to submit it." Then Recover opens (`/rounds/recover?from=submit`, `ENGINE_ROUTES` in `entry/routes.ts`), where the round is restored, synced again or discarded (CH-11911, swap audit F-02)

110707.name: A_CLOSED_QUALIFIER_ROUND_IS_CHANGED_TO
110707.meaning: A closed-qualifier round is changed to practice

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "Saved as a practice round"; the finish sheet is back to submit (the continue engine reloads the page)

110708.name: STARTING_A_QUALIFIER_ROUND_FINDS_THE_PLAYERS
110708.meaning: Starting a qualifier round finds the player's own round in progress for that qualifier

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "You already have a round in progress for this qualifier" + "Opening it." and that round opens to continue. Starting is refused for good; nothing is created

110709.name: ANY_OTHER_NOTE_AN_ENGINE_RAISES
110709.meaning: Any other note an engine raises (an error outside an action, or a wording this screen doesn't know)

catalogRow.theySee: Toast with the engine's own words; an error ticks the error haptic (CH-11709), so nothing the engine says is dropped

110710.name: THE_SUBMIT_HAS_TAKEN_OVER_15_SECONDS
110710.meaning: The submit has taken over 15 seconds

catalogRow.theySee: Under "Posting round": "This is taking longer than usual. Your round is saved on this device, and it is waiting in Rounds." with Rounds as a link

110711.name: EVERY_HOLE_IS_IN_BUT_THE_FINISH
110711.meaning: Every hole is in but the finish sheet was closed

catalogRow.theySee: A note over the shot screen: "All holes are in. Review the round, then post it." + Review and post (secondary), which opens the finish sheet again; the shot review's footer carries the same action as its one primary, in the thumb zone
