110712.name: OPENED_FROM_A_SUBMIT_THAT_COULDNT_REACH
110712.meaning: Opened from a submit that couldn't reach the server (`?from=submit`)

catalogRow.theySee: A note above the list: "Your round is saved on this device. It couldn’t reach the server, so it waits here. Restore it below without entering anything again." Not shown when no saved round is found

110713.name: BACK_FROM_A_ROUND_TO_THE_LIBRARY
110713.meaning: Back from a round to the library

catalogRow.theySee: A review opened from the library goes back in history on Back (the desktop link, a plain click; the phone bar's Back): the library returns with its search and its grouping (the shell's session state, per route and team) and its place in the list (RouteFrame restores the scroll on Back). A review opened any other way (a deep link, a fresh tab, Home's recent round) goes to the library's address as before; a coach's Back still goes to the player's rounds on Stats; a new-tab click is the address's. A blocked store only costs the step back

110714.name: THE_BALL_IS_ON_THE_GREEN_AND
110714.meaning: The ball is on the green and the putt result is not picked yet

catalogRow.theySee: Under the putt result, a quiet "Tap in" (ghost, small) and a caption naming what it writes: "Holed from 2 ft · score 3" within 2 ft, else "Two putts: leaves 1 ft, then holed · score 4" (meters: 0.3 m). One tap records the holed putt (or the putt on screen left at 1 ft and the holed 1 ft putt) through the same path as Hole out: the hole saves (CH-11402, CH-11003) and the round moves on. Not drawn off the green, once a result or a leave is picked, on a holed hole, while an undo or the hole save runs, or past the stroke limit. Undo lifts one stroke. Nothing new is stored: a holed putt (`putt_made`)

110715.name: A_POSTED_ROUND_WITH_ITS_HOLES_HAS
110715.meaning: A posted round with its holes has a scorecard to keep, under the hero

catalogRow.theySee: "Scorecard" with the tees, par and holes (or "Thru 14 of 18 holes" for a round with holes missing) and the total. Phone: Out and In are two tables of nine; desktop: one wide table, Out, In and Total. Rows: Par, Score (circle birdie, double circle eagle or better, square bogey, double square double bogey or worse; red for under par only), Putts, FIR, GIR where tracked, with each nine's counts. A nine that is not whole shows an em dash for its subtotal. The strokes gained strip (Total and four legs) is the round's own; none when the round has none. No card for a round posted as a total or whose holes failed to load. Printing shows only this card, on one page, in ink on white, with the course, date and score at paper size

A sheet: "Share this card" with the picture drawn on this device (1200px wide, Canvas 2D, after the house fonts load), and two switches, Strokes gained and Putts, fairways and greens, that draw it again without them. The picture names the player (the signed-in player on their own round, the player on a coach's view) and has a foot inside the frame: Golfhelm and the team name when known. The button says Share where the browser can share files and Save image where it cannot
Success haptic, the sheet closes, and a toast "Card saved" naming `finley-gc-2026-10-14-74.png` (course, date, score)
catalogRow.test: round-card.test › draws the picture before the tap; share-card.test

110718.name: SHARING_THE_CARD_FAILS
110718.meaning: Sharing the card fails (not closing the share sheet, not a refused share)

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t share the card" + "Try again, or save the image from the preview." Error haptic. Closing the share sheet is not a failure and does nothing; a share the browser refuses (the tap's permission lapsed) saves the image instead

110719.name: THE_REVIEW_IS_OPENED_STRAIGHT_FROM_POST
110719.meaning: The review is opened straight from Post round (`?just=submitted`)

catalogRow.theySee: The card is whole in its first frame (its settle is gone: MOTION-AND-VISUAL 3.5, 3.12; no count-up, no stagger). One quiet line under it from figures the page shows: "Best on hole 5, a birdie. 35 putts, 1.9 a hole." (and the leg that gained most when the hero line does not already say it). No haptic: the submit path fired the success. The parameter is taken out of the address, so a reload or a shared link does not replay it

110760.name: COACHHELMS_PUTT_MISS_ASK_THE_HOLES_FIRST
110760.meaning: CoachHelm's putt-miss ask (chs-22, Slice 8a, `coachhelm_data_gap_prompt_v1`): the hole's first putt missed from a distance band one of the player's open reads is waiting on, and it has no miss tag

catalogRow.theySee: First in the entry card, a section "Which side did it miss?" with Skip, four chips (Short, Long, High side, Low side; a group named for the read) and one line: "First putt, 8 ft · 3 of 6 for your 5–10 ft putt read" (meters for a meters player). A tap tags that putt (`miss_direction`, the field the optional miss chips write) through the hole's own save; the chip stays pressed and the line says "Tagged short · 4 of 6 …" until the read has its tags, when the row goes. Skip hides it for that putt (a skipped miss raises the target, as an untagged one does). Never a modal; Next shot stays the primary. Flag off or no open read: nothing is read or drawn

110761.name: THE_RECOVERY_TAP_THE_LAST_SHOT_RECORDED
110761.meaning: The recovery tap (chs-23, Slice 8b, `coachhelm_data_prompts_v2`): the last shot recorded is a tee shot into the rough or an 'other' lie, not yet answered

catalogRow.theySee: First in the entry card, "Next shot from there?" with Skip, two chips (Clear shot, Blocked or punch out) and "Tee shot, rough" (or "other lie"). A tap stores the answer on the tee shot (`lie_after_recovery`) through the hole's own save and the line says "Saved: a recovery shot" (or "a clear shot") until the next shot. An answer that came with a resumed round is not asked again. Flag off: nothing drawn, payloads unchanged

110762.name: THE_COURSE_NUDGE_THE_ROUND_HAS_NO
110762.meaning: The course nudge (chs-23, Slice 8b, `coachhelm_data_prompts_v2`): the round has no library course (a course typed by hand)

catalogRow.theySee: At the first hole in play order before its first shot, and in the Round complete sheet under the card: "Link this round to a course" with Skip, Pick the course, and "“Finley muni” isn’t linked to the course library. Linked rounds build your hole history and course plans." Pick the course opens the course picker (CH-11510) with the library only (no Add; a saved course with no library course is not offered); a tee pick links the course, which the engine sends with the round's next update. The receipt says "Linked to Pine Hollow" with Change and where it saves ("with your next shot", or "when you post the round"); pars and yardages stay as entered. Skip hides it for the round

110801.name: LIBRARY_IS_FOR_PLAYERS
110801.meaning: /golf/dashboard/rounds is Clubhouse only for a player: a coach session renders nothing from the Clubhouse route and the Fairway page keeps the coach (v2 has no coach Rounds library), and the shell does not list the library as rebuilt for a coach. A player's rounds are theirs with or without a team (the team only sets the time zone that decides today).

110802.name: REVIEW_IS_FOR_THE_PLAYER_AND_THEIR_COACHES
110802.meaning: A round's review opens for the player who played it and for a coach of a team the player is an active member of. Anyone else, a missing round and a test round get the same "This round isn't here" page, so it never confirms that someone else's round exists (CH-11307). A failed access check is not a permission answer: a round or a coach's membership read that fails gives "This round didn't load" with Try again (CH-11206), never "not found".

110803.name: LIBRARY_HOLDS_ONLY_THE_PLAYERS_OWN_ROUNDS
110803.meaning: The library loader reads golf_rounds for the signed-in player only (their player id, no test rounds): completed rounds for the book and in-progress rounds for the card, through the RLS-scoped client, so no teammate's round is drawn. Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx: both reads carry the session player's id and leave test rounds out, whoever the player is, and a coach session reads nothing.

110804.name: DISCARD_IS_CHECKED_AGAIN_BY_ITS_SERVER_ACTION
110804.meaning: Discard is checked again by deleteInProgressRound, whatever the screen shows: it refuses an invalid id, a caller who is not signed in, a caller with no player profile, and a round that is not the caller's or is no longer in progress (it deletes by round, player and in-progress status, and tells a delete that matched nothing from a real one). Run in rounds-actions-contracts.test.ts: an invalid id, a caller who is not signed in, a caller with no player profile, a round that is no longer in progress and another player's round the caller can see are refused and nothing is deleted. In production a player reads every round on their team (golf_rounds_select), so a teammate's round is refused; a round on another team is hidden by RLS, cannot be told from a gone one, and is answered with success (a discard is idempotent). Nothing is deleted either way.

110805.name: A_CLOSED_QUALIFIER_CANT_BE_CHOSEN
110805.meaning: A qualifier with no round the player can still enter is listed but cannot be chosen, and its row says why; only one with a round open is offered above Round details (closed means closed, D-31). Choosing the Qualifier type with none open says "No qualifier is open for you right now" (CH-11312), and a qualifiers read that failed says so (CH-11211).

110901.name: DISCARD_LANDED
110901.meaning: A discard that lands says so in a toast ("Round discarded") with the success haptic, and the card leaves and the idle card ("No round in progress") takes its place, whether the discard came from the question or from the toast's Retry.

110902.name: ROUND_POSTED_SAYS_SO
110902.meaning: A submitted round says "Round posted" with the course, names the coach ("Coach Reyes can see it now.", else "Your coach can see it now.") and links View round review (the round screen ticks the success haptic once and opens it after two and a half seconds). While it submits it names the real shot count, not timed steps, and a failed submit says so with Try again (CH-11005).

110980.name: EXPORT_ROUNDS_LANDED
110980.meaning: An export of rounds that lands says so in a toast ("Rounds exported · 12 rounds") with the success haptic: a download on a computer, the share sheet on a phone. Closing the share sheet is not a failure and says nothing.

catalogRow.theySee: "Discard this round?" + "Every shot from Finley GC on Oct 14 is deleted. This can’t be undone." Keep it · Discard round (danger; "Discarding…" while it runs)
"Undo shot 2?" + the shot + Keep it / Undo, brought into view clear of the action bar as it opens

"Add a penalty stroke": out of bounds, water, unplayable, lost ball, each with what it means; for stroke and distance, which stroke went (the last one entered, or one from here not entered yet). Add waits for a choice; it works before the first shot

111104.name: LEAVING_A_HOLE_WITH_A_RESULT_PICKED
111104.meaning: Leaving a hole with a result picked but not recorded

catalogRow.theySee: "Leave this shot?" + Stay / Leave without it
"Change shot 1": club, lie before, distances, result, miss, putt read; Delete asks "Delete shot 1?" first
The round so far ("Finley GC · thru 3 · +1") + Save for later / Keep playing / Discard round
"Discard this round?" + "It deletes every shot you entered at Finley GC. This can’t be undone." + Keep it / Discard round
"Round complete": score and to par, putts, fairways, greens, front and back, the card (label and Tot columns pinned while the holes scroll on a phone); Back to hole 18 / Post round
Both nines with par, score and putts, totals of what's scored, the current hole marked

"Where are you playing?": Add a course beside Close, search, Recently played, Team courses, Course library (one Results list when searching). On the desktop the courses are photo cards, three to a row (a course's own photo, else a bundled photo of the real course, else a flag tile); on the phone a list with a small photo or the flag tile. A course opens its tees with length, par, rating and slope

Four steps (course, tee, holes, review); the course is the round's own, and "Save this course for next time" (on) saves it and offers it to the library (Q-72h). The desktop shows the course as the picker will list it beside the form, with a photo slot (JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 5 MB); on the phone the card and slot follow the form. The photo goes with the start and is set on the library course only when that course has none, best-effort

111112.name: A_ROUND_SAVED_ON_THIS_DEVICE_IS
111112.meaning: A round saved on this device is found on opening (an interrupted round)

catalogRow.theySee: The exit sheet's shape: "Pick up where you left off" + "Your shots are on this device from when the app closed.", the round card (holes done as a count and a bar, "Finley GC", "Blue tees · Practice · saved 5 min ago", or "Shots on a hole in progress") and two rows: Restore round (the primary, light haptic; "Restoring…" while it writes, both rows wait and the dialog can't close) and Discard saved shots. Closing without choosing keeps the copy

111113.name: DISCARD_ON_THAT_DIALOG
111113.meaning: Discard saved shots on that dialog

catalogRow.theySee: The exit sheet's discard question: "Discard the saved shots?" + "The copy of your round at Finley GC saved on this device is deleted. This can’t be undone." + Keep it / Discard shots. Only the device copy goes; a round already on the server is untouched

111114.name: STARTING_A_ROUND_FINDS_ONE_ALREADY_IN
111114.meaning: Starting a round finds one already in progress for this course and date, with real progress

catalogRow.theySee: The exit sheet's shape: "Round already in progress" + "You already have a round in progress for Finley GC on this date.", the round card in the Library card's voice (scored holes as a count and a bar, "Finley GC", "In progress · updated 2h ago"; no tees or type, which the conflict doesn't carry) and three rows: Resume (the primary, light haptic), New round ("Keeps that round. For a second round on a 36-hole day.") and Discard. Every row waits while an action runs and the dialog can't close; nothing happens on its own

The exit sheet's discard question: "Discard this round?" + "It has 4 scored holes, last updated 2h ago. This can’t be undone." + Keep it / Discard round ("Discarding…" while it runs); once it is gone, this round starts

111116.name: A_SUBMIT_IS_REFUSED_BECAUSE_THE_COACH
111116.meaning: A submit is refused because the coach closed the round's qualifier (the refusal contains "qualifier" and "already been completed")

catalogRow.theySee: The exit sheet's shape: "This qualifier is closed" + the server's sentence ("This qualifier has already been completed. Rounds can no longer be submitted.") + "Your round and every shot are saved." and rows: Save as practice round (the primary, light haptic; "Saving as practice…"; "It won’t count toward the qualifier"), Save for later, Go back, Discard round. No Try again: the same submit is refused every time. Any other submit failure is CH-11005
The exit sheet's discard question: "Discard this round?" + "It deletes every shot you entered. This can’t be undone." + Keep it / Discard round. The legacy overlay discarded on one tap

111118.name: A_SAVED_QUALIFIER_ROUND_WITH_NO_ROUND
111118.meaning: A saved qualifier round with no round number (it predates the durable number) is finished and submitted

catalogRow.theySee: "Which qualifier round is this?" + "This saved scorecard needs its qualifier round number before it can be posted. Your shots and completed holes stay saved." and one row per unused round the server offered ("Qualifier round 3", the chosen one primary); Back returns to the finish sheet; Post round waits for a choice and posts as that round. The legacy continue screen's "Choose qualifier round" dialog

111119.name: THE_SAME_AND_NO_ROUND_IS_LEFT
111119.meaning: The same, and no round is left to choose

catalogRow.theySee: The server's reason in the rows' place ("Every configured qualifier round is already saved for you. …"), or "No unused qualifier round is available right now. Your scorecard remains saved."; only Back remains

"Discard this round?" For a round only on this device: "The copy of your round at Finley GC saved on this device is deleted. It never reached the server, so this can’t be undone." For one the server holds too: "The round at Finley GC and every shot in it are deleted, here and on the server. A round you already submitted is not touched. This can’t be undone." Keep it, or Discard round. A bottom sheet on the phone. The warning haptic fires when it opens (D-70)

111121.name: CHANGE_ROUND_TYPE
111121.meaning: Change round type (Continue round: the Exit sheet's "Change round type" row, "Practice now. Changes what it counts toward."; a submitted round: its review's Change round type, CH-11522)

catalogRow.theySee: "Change round type" + "Changes what this round counts toward. Its shots and scores stay as they are." Practice / Tournament / Qualifier; for Qualifier, which one (the player's entered qualifiers; on a review a coach also gets the round's team's other qualifiers, "Not entered yet. Saving enters the player in it."; one alone is picked) and which round of it, with rounds the player's other rounds hold shown as "Already recorded" and not offered. A finished qualifier says, on a submitted round, "Finished. Adding this round changes its final standings.", and on a live round "Closed. It has to be reopened before this round can be submitted." (the submit refuses a completed qualifier). Save waits for a change; Cancel. On Continue, auto-save is held while it is open and until the refreshed round arrives, so the old type is never saved back

111122.name: CHANGE_ROUND_TYPE_ON_A_SUBMITTED_ROUNDS
111122.meaning: Change round type on a submitted round's review (the player who played it, or a coach of the player's team; the Fairway round page's `RoundTypeEditor`)

catalogRow.theySee: A "Change round type" button under the round's figures opens CH-11521. Options: the player's entered qualifiers (finished ones included), plus, for a coach, the round's team's other qualifiers (test ones left out); taken slots from the player's other rounds. Save sends `updateRoundType` (a coach's save enters the player in a qualifier they aren't in), then the page reads the round again. Not drawn on the dev preview's fixtures

111123.name: THE_COACH_NOTE_CARD_ON_A_ROUNDS
111123.meaning: The Coach note card on a round's review

catalogRow.theySee: The player reads "From your coach" ("Left on this round") with the note, and sees no card at all when there is none. A coach of the player's team sees "Coach note" ("Jonah reads this on the round") with the note or "No note on this round yet." and Add a note / Edit, which opens a plain editor in the card: a 2,000-character field with a count, Cancel and Save note (waits for text; "Saving…"). Saving writes the round's review row, tells the player their coach left feedback (CH-11023 when it fails), refreshes the page and shows the saved text. A player who is also the viewing coach (their own round) sees the player's card

111124.name: COMPARE_TWO_ROUNDS_AT_A_COURSE
111124.meaning: Compare two rounds at a course (P-7)

catalogRow.theySee: Compare on Your rounds here: a checkbox per round ("Compare Oct 3, 76"; a nine or a round without hole scores can't be picked and says why), a bar with "Choose two rounds" until two are picked, then "Compare Oct 3 and Mar 14", which opens a sheet: both arcs on one stage, an 18-cell strip tinted by which round was better on each hole, and "Oct 3 was 6 shots worse · most on 13 to 15 (+4)"

111201.name: SETUP_KEPT_WHEN_START_FAILS
111201.meaning: A Start that fails leaves the setup as it was: the course and tees, the type, the date, the holes as edited and the qualifier all stay, and Start can be pressed again or retried from the toast (CH-11007); nothing is cleared until the round opens. Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx: after a failed Start the course and tees, the nine, the date, the edited holes and a qualifier all stay, and pressing Start again or Retry sends the same setup. use-new-round-session.preservation.test makes the engine's create throw and checks nothing is adopted and the next start goes ahead with the same payload.

111202.name: SHOTS_STAY_WHEN_A_HOLE_DOESNT_SAVE
111202.meaning: When a holed-out hole does not save, the shot review stays with every shot listed and Try again (CH-11003); the round does not move on until the save lands, and the card says the shots are kept on this device (the engine's own copy). Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx: after a failed save every shot is still listed, the card says they are kept on this device, the round stays on the hole, and Try again sends the same hole. use-new-round-session.preservation.test drops the connection on the hole's checkpoint and checks the device copy holds the hole's score and shots, that Try again sends that hole, and that the copy is cleared only once the save lands.

111301.name: DISCARD_WAITS_FOR_THE_SERVER
111301.meaning: Nothing on the library is optimistic: Discard keeps the card until the server has deleted the round, and the card leaves only on success, from the question or from Retry. The device's emergency copy is cleared only when the delete worked.

111401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
111401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything the button would have done follows, because the follow-up lives inside the action: a Discard's Retry removes the card and closes the question, and a Start's Retry opens the round.

111402.name: TRY_AGAIN_READS_AGAIN
111402.meaning: Try again on a failed-read notice asks again. The library's and the review's ask the server to read the page again (router.refresh); setup's read the course library, a course's tees or a tee's scorecard again through the port, and Start stays off while the scorecard is missing. The tees' Try again is drawn but no test presses it.

111403.name: HOLE_SAVE_AND_SUBMIT_TRY_AGAIN_RUN_AGAIN
111403.meaning: On the shot screen, Try again on a hole that did not save runs the hole's checkpoint again (the round moves on only when it lands), and Try again on a failed submit runs the submit again (the round screen runs the engine's hole checkpoint and submit). Offline, the first only warns (110702).

111404.name: A_RETRY_RUNS_THE_ROUND_AS_IT_IS_NOW
111404.meaning: A toast's Retry (Save for later CH-11010, a closed-qualifier Discard CH-11011, Start CH-11007) runs the action again against the round as it is now, not as it was when the toast was made: the setup's Start and every action of the round call the latest engine through a ref, so a Retry saves with the current round id and a second Start after the duplicate warning is the confirming one. An action that is already running is never started twice, by a Retry that meets a tap or by two quick taps (Save for later, Discard, Change to practice, Restore). Each holds its own in-flight ref, because the toast's closure carries the state of the render it was made in. useAction's own gate is a ref for the same reason: a Retry or a quick second call reaches a `run` from an earlier render, whose `pending` is stale.

111501.name: TOTALS_AND_SEASON_MATCH_HOME_AND_STATS
111501.meaning: A round's total is the canonical one (round-scope `roundTotals`, F-0003: its holes when every one is in hand and scored, else front plus back, else the stored total; withCanonicalRoundTotal), in the library, the review and the course glance in round setup. The season figures and the ribbon come from countable 18-hole rounds since August 1, the rule Home and Stats use, so the numbers agree across screens; the window and the sample are stated in the words ("Since August 1", "18-hole", "Not counted").

111502.name: REVIEW_SHOWS_ONLY_WHAT_WAS_RECORDED
111502.meaning: The review never invents a figure: a nine with a hole not scored has no total ("—") rather than a short one, a par 3 never counts a fairway whatever was stored, a hole scored without shots says so (CH-11306), a round posted as a total says so (CH-11305), and the recap and the notes are drawn only when they were written.

111503.name: A_STALE_TEE_READ_IS_IGNORED
111503.meaning: A slow read for a course the player has left never replaces the next course's tees: the picker keeps only the latest answer of each read.

111504.name: A_COMPLETED_ROUND_WITHOUT_A_RECAP_GETS_ONE
111504.meaning: A completed round whose review opens with no stored recap asks generateRoundRecap once (useRoundRecap; the loader marks it recapPending), as the Fairway round page does, and draws the recap it gets back through the figure check (111502, D13). A stored recap, a round that is not completed, and a fixture ask for nothing; a failure is quiet and the next visit asks again.

111601.name: HOVERING_A_ROUND_THAT_OPENS_ITS_REVIEW
111601.meaning: Hovering a round that opens its review

catalogRow.theySee: On desktop the row takes the Ledger row tint (quick) and a deeper one on press (press), with no lift and no scale
Its chevron turns (base); the rows show at once. No turn with reduced motion

A spinner (still with reduced motion) and what is really happening: "Saving 71 shots, updating your stats and writing the round recap." No timed fake steps (Q-72d). Posted: a tick (the success haptic, once), "Round posted", "Your 74 (+2) at Finley GC is posted.", View round review, which opens on its own after two and a half seconds
The hole's shots slide 12px in the direction of travel (base in, quick out) while the hole's head and the arrows stay put. Instant with reduced motion
Warning, before the question
Selection

111703.name: CONTINUE_SUBMIT_OR_START_A_ROUND_IS
111703.meaning: Continue, Submit or New round is tapped

catalogRow.theySee: Light (press)

111704.name: A_HOLE_IS_PICKED_ON_THE_REVIEWS
111704.meaning: A hole is picked on the review's card, or stepped with the arrows

catalogRow.theySee: Selection

111705.name: A_SHOT_IS_RECORDED
111705.meaning: A shot is recorded (Next shot or Hole out)

catalogRow.theySee: Medium, once (the Button's own tap is replaced); every choice in the panel is a selection tick
Selection (the engine's navigation port)

111707.name: UNDO_DELETE_SHOT_DISCARD_ROUND_LEAVE_WITHOUT
111707.meaning: Undo, Delete shot, Discard round, Leave without it

catalogRow.theySee: Warning

111708.name: THE_SECOND_TAP_OF_A_DISCARD_IN
111708.meaning: The second tap of a discard in round entry: the saved shots, the round already in progress, or the closed-qualifier round

catalogRow.theySee: Warning, before the discard runs

111709.name: A_FAILURE_APPEARS_IN_ROUND_ENTRY_AN
111709.meaning: A failure appears in round entry: an inline line, a toast or a banner (CH-11008 to CH-11013, CH-11902)

catalogRow.theySee: Error, once per message
Medium on the tap (a shot recorded, as CH-11705), then success once the hole's save lands; nothing more when it fails (the hole's own Try again, CH-11003, says so)

111760.name: A_CHIP_IN_A_DATA_PROMPT_IS
111760.meaning: A chip in a data prompt is tapped: a putt miss side (CH-11960), Clear shot or Blocked or punch out (CH-11961)

catalogRow.theySee: Selection; Skip is silent; the course picker opened from the nudge (CH-11962) keeps its own ticks

111801.name: A_SCREEN_READER_MOVES_THROUGH_THE_BOOK
111801.meaning: A screen reader moves through the book

catalogRow.theySee: Each round is one link (or one group before Review is rebuilt) named "Sep 26, Finley GC, 72 (E)"; each month or course is a labelled region; the page is labelled by "Your rounds"
The strip is hidden from screen readers; the card says the same in words: "+1 through 3", "Continue at hole 4"
One labelled image: "Strokes over par for your last 8 rounds, oldest to newest; average +1.9"; each bar has a title with its date, score and type

Two tables, captioned "Front nine" and "Back nine", with a button per hole number (pressed on the one shown); fairways and greens read "Hit", "Missed" or "Not applicable"; the hole card is a polite live region, so stepping holes is announced

Holes you can go to are buttons, the rest are named marks; each is named by hole, score, to par and whether it is the one you're on ("Hole 2, 6, 2 over", "Hole 3, 2, 1 under", "Hole 4, current", "Hole 6"). On the phone each is one compact chip in a 44 x 44 hit area: the score once played (red only under par), the hole number until then, the current hole lit ivory; the strip scrolls the current hole into view

111806.name: CHOICES_IN_THE_ENTRY_AND_THE_SHEETS
111806.meaning: Choices in the entry and the sheets

catalogRow.theySee: Radio groups named for what they choose ("Shot result", "Where it missed the green"); putt tags are toggle buttons
Labelled by its section ("Distance remaining (yds)"), `aria-invalid` with its message when it isn't a number
One image named in words ("Hole 4, par 4: 2 shots so far"); on the shot screen it is the button that opens the course view ("Course view of hole 4")

111809.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_THE_SCANNED_PREVIEW_PAGES
111809.meaning: No axe violations on the 12 Rounds preview pages in clubhouse:a11y (the library: default, empty, failed; the review: default, coach, no shots; setup: default and failed courses; tracking: default, putt, holed and card) at 1280px and 390px, 24 scans, clean on 2026-09-30 after the fixes. It is a script (scripts/clubhouse/a11y.mjs), not a vitest test, so this stays reserved; the other preview states, the open sheets and the untouched tracking states are not scanned.

111810.name: THE_SCORECARD_SCROLLS_IN_A_FOCUSABLE_REGION
111810.meaning: The scorecard on the shot screen's sheets (Scorecard and Round complete) scrolls sideways inside a labelled, focusable region (role region, tabIndex 0, "Scorecard"), so the keyboard can scroll it (axe scrollable-region-focusable). Found and fixed on 2026-09-30 by clubhouse:a11y; rounds-contracts.test.tsx asserts the region on both sheets.

111811.name: FIGURES_ARE_DEFINITION_LISTS
111811.meaning: The season and review figures are description lists in which a term is followed by its value and then its sub-line as a second description (label, figure, then "avg · +1.9 to par" or "+1"), never a bare span inside the list (axe definition-list).

111901.name: LIBRARY_AND_REVIEW_PHONE_LAYOUT
111901.meaning: At phone width the library and the review are the phone build (useChPhone), not a shrunken desktop. The library's top bar is the tab root's "Rounds" with no back link and it keeps its own header; below 860px the round card and the season card stack, and at 640px and below the book drops Out · In · Tot and the meters to a date tile, the course and tee, and the to-par box (a group's header drops its average and low). The review's top bar is "Round" with "‹ Rounds" (or "‹ Stats" for a coach), its hero stacks and its card scrolls sideways inside its own frame. Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx with the shell's top-bar slot (the top bars) and against the stylesheet's container rules (the stacking and the dropped columns); seen headless at 390 on 2026-09-30, not on an iPhone.

111902.name: PHONE_RIBBON_DRAWS_THE_LAST_TEN
111902.meaning: On the phone the season ribbon draws the last ten rounds on a narrower canvas, so its labels stay readable; the desktop draws the last twenty.

111903.name: SETUP_AND_TRACKING_ARE_FULL_SCREEN_ON_THE_PHONE
111903.meaning: A new round and the shot screen are full-screen flows on the phone: the tab bar hides while either is open (usePhoneTabsHidden). Setup keeps Start round in a dock above the home indicator and Back in its band; the shot screen keeps Exit and Scorecard in its own top bar. Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx (the tab bar hides while either is open and returns when it closes; Start round is in the dock, Exit and Scorecard in the shot screen's top bar); setup and tracking were also driven in real Chromium at 390 on 2026-09-30 (a shot recorded; the dock read "Finley GC · Blue · 18 holes · Par 72"), not on an iPhone.

112001.name: SHEETS_CLOSE_ON_ESC_AND_FOCUS_RETURNS
112001.meaning: Every sheet and question on the page (Discard, the course picker, Add a course, Penalty, Change a shot, Leave this shot, Exit, Scorecard, Round complete) is the shell's Modal on the native dialog: Esc closes it and focus goes back to the button that opened it. Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx: Esc (the dialog's cancel event) closes each of the nine and focus returns to the opener, except Add a course, which returns to the course picker it was opened from. In the app the keyboard keeps its Done key for the whole round, setup and sheets included: round entry holds the native accessory bar up (`useRoundDoneKey`; Mobile Safari draws it itself). Not built: arrow keys inside the radio groups (each choice is its own Tab stop).

112101.name: LOADERS_READ_IN_ROUNDS
112101.meaning: The library loader reads on the server before first paint, never one request per round: the team's time zone (when there is a team), then the posted rounds (paged), then the in-progress rounds, then their holes together (paged, at most 20 rounds at once). The review reads the round, then a coach's membership check, then the holes, the shots (paged), the tee's yards and the player's name together. A read that fails is flagged on its own part and logged, never thrown (110619). Tested in rounds-contracts.test.tsx. The library's reads run as the loader does now: the team's time zone, the posted rounds and the in-progress rounds start together, then the holes of every in-progress round are one read (the order above predates that); the review's order is as written.

112301.name: FAILURES_ARE_LOGGED_BY_NAME
112301.meaning: A read that fails in a loader is logged through chLogServer under its surface and read (rounds with list, unfinished or unfinished-holes; rounds.review with round, membership, holes, shots, tee or player) and named on the page. A write that fails goes through useAction, which reports it under its action (rounds.discard, rounds.start), at low severity when the server refused it. A section that crashes is contained and reported under its own surface (rounds.unfinished, rounds.season, rounds.book, rounds.review.card, rounds.review.hole). Setup's course and tee reads run in the browser and report nothing themselves: the round screen's ports must.

112401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
112401.meaning: The page's test files (rounds.test, round-review.test, round-setup.test, round-tracking.test and round-entry.test, and, through the real engines, round-entry-wiring.test, round-entry-continue.test and round-entry-routes.test) name in a test title every P011 catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 that is not marked preview (clubhouse:check enforces it), and every hand contract they prove by its Bridge ID.

112402.name: ROUND_LIFECYCLE_MATCHES_PRODUCTION
112402.meaning: Driven through the real new-round engine to the same round (course, tees, nine, start hole, type, date), Clubhouse's setup (its read ports and toStartForm) and Fairway's (the library tee pick and the setup form's submit) make the same start, the same checkpoint for every hole and the same submit, field for field; the one kept difference is the back nine's start hole configs (card numbers on Fairway, 1 to 9 on Clubhouse). The course's city and state are saved as the library has them, and a round from one of the player's saved courses (110116) sends what Fairway's saved-course start sends. Yardages follow Fairway's rule for the course (yardageRule): a library tee starts on its pars with a blank yardage at 0, a saved course needs one yardage, a course typed in by hand needs every one.

120101.name: CLASSES_READY
120101.meaning: Classes opens for a player with everything the server read before first paint, so nothing is fetched in the browser to draw it: the header (the term and its dates, the title, Import schedule and Add class), the term overview, every class as a card in the order the week unfolds with the Add tile at the end, this week's overlaps with the team's events, and a note on what the coach can see.

120102.name: A_CLASS_IS_DRAWN_AS_WHAT_IT_IS
120102.meaning: A class card is drawn from the class's own data: a class in another term is named for that term and left out of this term's credits and overlaps, a class saved with no term counts as the current term, and the week strip has five days, or seven when the class meets on a weekend day. A screen reader gets one button per class, named for its code, name and when it meets (CH-12801), and the strip is hidden (CH-12802).

120103.name: A_CLASS_SHEET_SHOWS_WHEN_AND_WHERE
120103.meaning: Opening a class shows when and where it meets, its instructor, term and notes, and its next four meetings, each marked when it overlaps a team event. The meetings run from the later of today and the first day of the class's own term to the end of that term, so a class in next term lists next term's first meetings. A class with no time lists none. Nothing the table has no column for (a grade, a deadline, a share switch) is drawn.

120201.name: THE_PAGE_IS_ON_ITS_WAY
120201.meaning: The page is on its way

catalogRow.theySee: The header, the term overview, four class cards and the two side cards, in place
catalogRow.how: `ClassesSkeleton` via `classes/loading.tsx`, for a player in the Clubhouse shell (`useClubhouseRole`); a coach there, who has the current Fairway page, and anyone outside the shell get the Fairway skeleton

catalogRow.theySee: "Reading your schedule…" + "Finding course codes, days, times and rooms" over a page with a scan line. It says what it is doing; the board's timed "Image received, Finding classes, Matching times" steps aren't drawn because they aren't progress

120203.name: CLASSES_ARE_BEING_PUT_ON_THE_CALENDAR
120203.meaning: Classes are being put on the calendar

catalogRow.theySee: In the header: "Adding to your calendar…" (`role="status"`) until they land

"Add your class schedule" + "Import a screenshot of your schedule and we’ll add every class. Your coach can see when you’re busy, so practice and travel get planned around class." + Import schedule / Add a class. The term bar, the header actions and Delete all classes are not drawn

120402.name: NO_CLASS_MEETS_A_TEAM_EVENT_THIS
120402.meaning: (retired 2026-11-07, the overlaps card has no empty line in the redesign) No class meets a team event this week

catalogRow.theySee: Retired: the overlaps card has no empty line in the redesign

120403.name: A_CLASS_WITH_NO_FIXED_MEETING
120403.meaning: A class with no fixed meeting (online or arranged)

catalogRow.theySee: On its card: "Online or arranged. No fixed meeting." The week strip isn't drawn. A class with days but no start and end time is not this one: its card says "Add the time this class meets." and flags "No meeting time, not on your calendar", its sheet says "No time set" and "Not on your calendar: no time set", and it is taken off the calendar rather than synced (the server would put it there from 08:00 to 09:00)

120404.name: A_CLASS_WITH_TIMES_BUT_NO_DAYS
120404.meaning: A class with times but no days

catalogRow.theySee: "Add the days this class meets." and a flag "No meeting days, not on your calendar" (a class with no days has no meetings to put on the calendar)
"You aren’t on a team yet" + "Your classes go on your team’s calendar so your coach can plan around them. Join a team, then add your classes." + Open team settings

120406.name: AN_IMPORT_WHERE_EVERY_CLASS_IS_ALREADY
120406.meaning: An import where every class is already on the schedule

catalogRow.theySee: "Nothing new to import" · "Already on your schedule" + "That class is already on your schedule, so nothing was imported. Remove the existing entry first to import again." Nothing is synced. A skipped class the page has never seen (an earlier attempt saved it and its answer was lost) is not a repeat: it joins the page and is synced like a new one

120407.name: FIRST_RUN_ONLY_WHEN_THE_READ_ANSWERED
120407.meaning: The first-run page (CH-12301) shows only when the classes read answered and the list is empty. A read that failed shows CH-12201 in its place, and the header keeps Import schedule and Add class (a failed read keeps the head and its primary action, owner decision 2026-10-08). Removing the last class returns to the first-run page.

catalogRow.theySee: Above the deck: "No classes today · next Tuesday, Oct 6" and that day's classes (time, name, room · code), each opening its class; with none in the next week, "No classes this week"
"Add the course code, for example STAT 201." beside the box (`role="alert"`, `aria-invalid`); focus goes to the first field that needs it
"Add the course name."
"Choose the term this class is in."

120504.name: THE_END_IS_NOT_AFTER_THE_START
120504.meaning: The end is not after the start

catalogRow.theySee: "Ends must be after it starts."

120505.name: A_START_WITH_NO_END_OR_AN
120505.meaning: A start with no end, or an end with no start

catalogRow.theySee: "Add both a start and an end time, or leave both empty."

120506.name: CREDITS_THAT_ARE_NOT_A_WHOLE_NUMBER
120506.meaning: Credits that are not a whole number from 0 to 12

catalogRow.theySee: "Credits is a whole number from 0 to 12."

120507.name: A_CLASS_AT_EXACTLY_ANOTHER_CLASSS_DAYS
120507.meaning: A class at exactly another class's days and times

catalogRow.theySee: "STAT 201 already meets at exactly this time. Change the days or times, or edit that class." under Days; nothing is sent. Editing a class never counts against itself, and only a class in the term the form is set to counts (a class with no term is in the current term)

120508.name: A_CLASS_THAT_OVERLAPS_ANOTHER_CLASS_WITHOUT
120508.meaning: A class that overlaps another class without being the same

catalogRow.theySee: A note in the sheet, "Overlaps another class: STAT 201 on Tue, Thu." It doesn't block the save (amber, never red). Only classes in the term the form is set to count

120509.name: A_CLASS_OVERLAPS_A_TEAM_EVENT_THIS
120509.meaning: A class overlaps a team event this week (in the form, or among the imported classes)

catalogRow.theySee: "Overlaps the team: Practice on Mon, …. This week. Your coach can see your classes." Imported: "3 overlaps with the team this week." and the first two. It doesn't block. The events are this week's, so only a class in this term can overlap them: a form set to another term, or an imported class in next term, shows none
catalogRow.how: `conflictsOf` over the team's events for Monday to Sunday

catalogRow.theySee: "Paste your schedule text first." under the box
"That file is too large" + "Use a file under 12 MB. A screenshot of the schedule page is usually under 2 MB." + Choose another file / Paste text instead. Refused before anything is sent

120512.name: A_FILE_THAT_IS_NOT_AN_IMAGE
120512.meaning: A file that is not an image, PDF or TXT

catalogRow.theySee: "We can’t read that file type" + "Use a PNG, JPG or WebP screenshot, a PDF or a TXT file, or paste the text."

120513.name: THE_READER_SAYS_THE_IMAGE_IS_NOT
120513.meaning: The reader says the image is not a class schedule

catalogRow.theySee: "This doesn’t look like a class schedule" + the reader's sentence + Choose another file
"No classes found" + "We read it but couldn’t find course codes or times. Try pasting your schedule text." + Paste text

120515.name: IMPORT_SKIPS_WHAT_IS_ALREADY_ON_THE_SCHEDULE
120515.meaning: An import reads the classes the player already has before it writes, and skips any with the same stored name and term, so importing a schedule twice never doubles the calendar. A class saved with no term, or a blank one, is in the current term, so it is the same class; the same class in another term is another class and is imported. A read that fails stops the import with nothing saved. When every class is already there nothing is inserted and nothing is synced (CH-12307).

120516.name: ONLY_CLASSES_IN_THE_SAME_TERM_COUNT
120516.meaning: Every check that compares classes counts only the classes of the term in question. The exact-same-time refusal (CH-12107) and the overlap note (CH-12108) count only classes in the term the form is set to. This week's overlaps with the team (CH-12109), on the overview, the cards, the side card, the form and the import result, count only classes in the current term, because the week's events are this term's. The week's team events are the ones the player's Calendar shows: a meeting that invites no one is the coach's own (D2-8) and is left out, decided by `golf_event_attendance_counts` or, until migration 20261017102000 is applied, the attendance rows; a read that fails leaves every event in. A class with no term is in the current term. The same days and times in another term never refuse a save.

120517.name: AN_EXAM_ENDS_AT_OR_BEFORE_IT
120517.meaning: An exam ends at or before it starts

catalogRow.theySee: "The exam must end after it starts." under the form

120518.name: AN_EXAM_IS_LONGER_THAN_4_HOURS
120518.meaning: An exam is longer than 4 hours

catalogRow.theySee: "Exams can be up to 4 hours."

120519.name: AN_EXAMS_DATE_IS_OUTSIDE_THE_CONFIRMED
120519.meaning: An exam's date is outside the confirmed term (classes start to exams end)

catalogRow.theySee: "Pick a date in Fall 2026."

120601.name: ADDING_OR_UPDATING_A_CLASS_FAILS
120601.meaning: Adding or updating a class fails

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t add GEOG 110" (or "Couldn’t update …") + the server's reason if it is a sentence, else "Nothing was changed. Try again." + Retry. The sheet stays open with what was typed; nothing is sent to the calendar. Done: "Class added" or "Class updated"

120602.name: A_CLASS_SAVED_BUT_DID_NOT_REACH
120602.meaning: A class saved but did not reach the calendar (the sync failed, threw, wrote no meetings for a class that has them, was refused offline, or was skipped because another sync was still running, as when a class is saved while an import is being put on the calendar)

catalogRow.theySee: When the sync ran and failed, threw, or wrote no meetings for a class that has them: an error toast, "GEOG 110 is saved, but not on your calendar" + "GEOG 110: <reason>. Try again." (for an import: "1 of 4 classes are saved, but not on your calendar" and the names) + Retry, which syncs again from the same start and does not save again. Offline, the shell's CH-1903 toast says the same with "you’re offline" and its Retry syncs. While another sync is still running (a class saved while an import is being put on the calendar) there is no toast, because nothing has failed yet: the class is flagged and the header's Retry sync puts it there. In every case the class stays in the list with "Not on your calendar", the header says "1 class is not on your calendar" with Retry sync, and the class's sheet has the same notice and button, so a saved class is never off the calendar without the flag. The class is saved first ("Class added" shows at once) and the calendar is told in the background: the sheet is free meanwhile (CH-12403)
catalogRow.how: `useAction('classes.sync')` → `writes.sync` (`syncClassToCalendar`), started by the save and the import without waiting on them; the failed ids and the start each class was synced from are held for the visit (no column records them), so a Retry repeats what failed

120603.name: REMOVING_A_CLASS_FAILS
120603.meaning: Removing a class fails (the calendar removal or the delete)

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t remove STAT 201" + "Couldn’t take this class off your calendar: <reason>. The class was kept so you can try again." + Retry; the question stays open and the class stays. When the calendar part landed and only the delete failed: "It is off your calendar but still on your schedule. Try again to finish removing it." and the class is flagged "Not on your calendar". Done: "STAT 201 removed"
catalogRow.how: `useAction('classes.remove')` → `writes.remove`: the calendar first, then the row, so a retry finds it

120604.name: IMPORTING_THE_REVIEWED_ROWS_FAILS_TO_SAVE
120604.meaning: Importing the reviewed rows fails to save

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t import your schedule" + "Nothing was saved. Try again." + Retry; the review stays as it was. Done: the "Schedule imported" view (no toast): how many classes are on the calendar and until when (each class's own term end), and which are not and why ("no meeting days", "no time set"). It does not wait for the calendar

"Your classes didn’t load" + "Nothing is lost. Your classes are still saved; try again in a moment." + Try again (asks the server again). It never reads as "no classes"; the head keeps Import schedule and Add class (a failed read keeps the head and its primary action, owner decision 2026-10-08), and Delete all classes is not offered beside a schedule the page can't show

In the side column: "The team’s events didn’t load" + "Overlaps with practice and travel can’t be checked right now. Nothing has changed. Try again in a moment." + Try again. The classes still show; the overview draws no overlap count, no card is flagged, and the sheets claim no overlap
"The term overview couldn’t be shown." (or "Your classes", "This week’s overlaps") + "The rest of the page is fine. Try again." + Try again
"Reading the schedule didn’t finish" + "Your schedule can still be added with Paste text." + Paste text instead

120609.name: AN_UPDATE_A_POLICY_HIDES_IS_A_FAILURE
120609.meaning: An edit whose update a row-level-security policy hides comes back from the database with no error and no row. The page treats that as a failure ("Nothing was saved. This class was not found, or you can't change it.") and never as "Class updated". An edit is limited to the class's id and the player's own id.

120610.name: A_SYNC_THAT_WROTE_NOTHING_IS_A_FAILURE
120610.meaning: A calendar sync that returns no error but wrote no meetings for a class that has days and a time is a failure, so the class is flagged and CH-12002 says why, instead of a quietly empty calendar. A class with no days has nothing to write and is not a failure. A sync that throws is reported (surface classes.sync, low severity) and its reason reads "The calendar sync did not finish".

120611.name: DELETE_ALL_CLASSES_CHANGED_NOTHING_NO_CLASS
120611.meaning: Delete all classes changed nothing: no class could be taken off the calendar (every removal failed or threw), the connection dropped, or the write threw

catalogRow.theySee: "Couldn’t delete your classes" + "None of them could be taken off your calendar, so all 5 were kept: <reason>. Try again." (one class: "It couldn’t be taken off your calendar, so the class was kept: <reason>.") or, with no answer, "Nothing was deleted. Try again." + Retry. Every class stays, the question stays open, and no row was deleted (the calendar is done first, and a row is deleted only for a class that came off it). Retry repeats the same classes. Offline, the shell's CH-1903 toast says the same with "you’re offline". Done: "All 5 classes deleted" (one class: "Class deleted"), the page returns to CH-12301

120612.name: DELETE_ALL_CLASSES_STOPPED_HALF_WAY_SOME
120612.meaning: Delete all classes stopped half-way: some classes are gone and some are not

catalogRow.theySee: "3 of 5 classes deleted" + "ENGL 105 couldn’t be taken off your calendar, so it was kept. EXSS 188 is off your calendar but still on your schedule. Try again to finish." (names up to three, then "and more"); when every calendar part landed and no row could be deleted: "Couldn’t finish deleting your classes". What the answer says is gone leaves the list at once; a class that is off the calendar but still saved is flagged "Not on your calendar" (the header's Retry sync puts it back); the question stays open and counts what is left. Retry repeats the first attempt's classes: one already gone counts as removed, so it finishes the job and never deletes twice. A row is reported deleted only when it is shown to be gone: a delete that failed, a row a policy hid and a check that can't be read are not
catalogRow.how: `useAction('classes.removeAll')` → `writes.removeAll` (the delete returns its rows; a read-back says which are left)

120613.name: THE_SHARING_SWITCHS_WRITE_IS_REFUSED
120613.meaning: The sharing switch's write is refused (class status, P-10)

catalogRow.theySee: A toast "Couldn’t share your class status" (or "Couldn’t stop sharing your class status") + "Nothing was changed. Try again."; the switch goes back to where it was
A toast "Couldn’t mark no class" + "Nothing was changed. Try again."; the sheet stays open

120615.name: UNDO_ON_NO_CLASS_TODAY_IS_REFUSED
120615.meaning: Undo on "No class today" is refused

catalogRow.theySee: A toast "Couldn’t undo" + "You are still marked as having no class. Try again."

120616.name: TAGGING_UNTAGGED_CLASSES_WITH_THE_TERM_IS
120616.meaning: Tagging untagged classes with the term is refused

catalogRow.theySee: A toast "Couldn’t tag your classes" + "Nothing was changed. Try again."

120617.name: A_CLASSS_USE_FOR_CLASS_STATUS_SWITCH
120617.meaning: A class's "Use for class status" switch is refused

catalogRow.theySee: A toast "Couldn’t change class status for this class" + "Nothing was changed. Try again."; the switch goes back
A toast "Couldn’t add the exam" + "Nothing was changed. Try again."; the sheet stays open with what was typed
A toast "Couldn’t remove the exam" + "It is still on your list. Try again."

120620.name: DELIVER_NOW_IS_REFUSED
120620.meaning: Deliver now is refused (the panel's Pushes during class row)

catalogRow.theySee: A toast "Couldn’t deliver them" + "They will arrive when class ends. Try again."; the button stays

120621.name: THE_PLAYERS_CLASS_DAY_DIDNT_LOAD
120621.meaning: The player's class day didn't load

catalogRow.theySee: In the Class status panel: "Class status didn’t load." + Try again. The rest of Classes is untouched

120622.name: THE_PLAYERS_PUSHES_DURING_CLASS_ROW
120622.meaning: The player's Pushes during class row

catalogRow.theySee: "Pushes during class" with "Held · Change" (or "Not held", "Off while sharing is off"); Change opens Settings > Notifications. With pushes waiting it counts them ("3 updates waiting") and offers Deliver now (44 px, the dark-safe green), which sends them, ticks, and reads "Delivered" for 2 seconds

120701.name: A_SCREENSHOT_IS_CHOSEN_WHILE_OFFLINE
120701.meaning: A screenshot is chosen while offline

catalogRow.theySee: "You’re offline" + "Reading a screenshot needs a connection. Reconnect and try again, or paste the text, which works offline." + Try again (reads it once back) / Paste text instead. Pasted text and a TXT file are read on the device and don't need a connection
After 5 seconds, once: "This is taking longer than usual. Keep this open." Closing the sheet while it runs drops the answer

120703.name: WRITES_REFUSE_OFFLINE
120703.meaning: Every write on the page (saving a class, removing one, importing a schedule and putting classes on the calendar) is refused while the browser is offline, before anything is sent, with the shell's toast naming what did not happen (CH-1903) and the error haptic; an edit keeps the form as typed, and the toast's Retry sends it once back online. A class saved just as the connection went stays in the list, flagged as not on the calendar (CH-12002). Reading a screenshot offline is CH-12901; pasted text and a TXT file are read on the device.

120801.name: THE_PAGE_IS_THE_PLAYERS
120801.meaning: Clubhouse Classes is the player's page. A session that is a player with a player profile, with the Clubhouse on for the player role, gets it; a coach (including a coach who also has a player profile), a signed-out session and everyone else get the current Fairway page, unchanged. The route itself renders nothing for a session with no player profile, and a team where the member's role is not player gets the no-team page (CH-12305).

120802.name: A_PLAYER_CHANGES_ONLY_THEIR_OWN_CLASSES
120802.meaning: Every read and write the page makes is limited to the player's own rows: the classes are read with the session's player id, an edit updates and a remove deletes by the class's id and that player id, and a new class carries the player's id and team id. Row-level security is the gate that counts: the baseline policies let only the owning player insert, update or delete a class and let its player and an active coach of the team read it, and teammates cannot (read in the baseline migration; the policies were not run for this page).

120803.name: SERVER_ACTIONS_ARE_THE_GATE
120803.meaning: The calendar actions check the caller again, whatever the screen shows. syncClassToCalendar refuses a caller who is not signed in, whose player profile is not the player named, who is not a member of the team, or whose class row is not theirs. removeClassFromCalendar refuses a caller with no player profile, a team they are not on and a class that another player owns (looked up with the admin client on purpose, so a row the policies hide is not mistaken for an absent one), and cleans up an orphaned class's events only on the caller's own teams. Read in this pass, not run: the tests replace both actions, so no test here forces a refusal.

120901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
120901.meaning: A change that lands names itself in a toast with the success haptic: Class added, Class updated, STAT 201 removed. The calendar sync's landing shows no toast (the header's "Adding to your calendar…" goes away, and a class's flag clears), and an import that lands shows the Schedule imported view instead of a toast.

120902.name: THE_IMPORT_RESULT_SAYS_WHAT_REACHED_THE_CALENDAR
120902.meaning: The Schedule imported view says how many classes were imported and counts as on the calendar only those that can be: "3 of 4 are on your calendar and repeat weekly until Dec 15" (until each class's own term end, or "until the end of their terms, Dec 15 and May 15" when they differ), then "Not on your calendar: PHIL 150 (no meeting days) and HIST 210 (no time set). Open the class to add what's missing." It says "Adding them to your calendar…" while the sync runs, and "Some didn't reach your calendar. Use Retry sync on the Classes page." when one failed. An import where no class can be on the calendar never says they are.

catalogRow.theySee: "Remove this class?" + "STAT 201 comes off your schedule and your calendar. This can’t be undone." Keep it · Remove class (danger; "Removing…" while it runs)

121102.name: CANCEL_OR_CLOSE_A_FORM_THAT_HAS
121102.meaning: Cancel or close a form that has changes

catalogRow.theySee: "Discard your changes?" + "What you typed here isn’t saved." Keep editing · Discard. The form comes back with what was typed if the answer is to keep editing. An untouched form closes without asking

121103.name: DELETE_ALL_CLASSES_NOT_DRAWN_WITH_NO
121103.meaning: Delete all classes (the destructive row, with a bin icon, in the More menu on the Your classes heading, on the phone and on desktop). Not drawn with no classes (CH-12301) or when they didn't load (CH-12201); the More key is off while a save, an import, a remove, a calendar sync or a delete-all is running, because a write beside it would put back what was just taken off

catalogRow.theySee: "Delete all classes?" + "All 5 classes come off your schedule and your calendar, including 1 from another term. This can’t be undone." (one class: "STAT 201 comes off your schedule and your calendar. This can’t be undone."). Keep them · Delete all classes (danger; "Deleting…" while it runs, when it can't be pressed again, and Esc and Close leave it open so a delete that is still going isn't hidden). The count is what is on the page now, so after a half-way delete (CH-12006) it says what is left. It closes when everything is gone

121104.name: START_OVER_IN_THE_IMPORT_REVIEW_ONCE
121104.meaning: Start over in the import review, once it holds three or more classes or one came off (an emptied review, or one or two classes as read, starts over at once)

catalogRow.theySee: "Start over?" + "The 4 classes you reviewed are let go, and nothing is imported." Keep reviewing · Start over (danger). The review steps aside while it is asked and comes back as it was
"Remove this exam?" + "Remove STAT 201 exam on Dec 14?" Cancel / Remove

121201.name: FORM_KEPT_ON_FAILURE
121201.meaning: A class that fails to save leaves its sheet open with every field as typed; nothing is cleared until the save lands, and the failure toast is inside the open sheet so its Retry is where the person is looking. An import that fails to save leaves the review as it was. A remove that fails leaves the question open and the class in the list. Cancel or close on a form with changes asks first (CH-12502), and each time the sheet opens it starts from the class being edited, or blank.

121401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
121401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything the button would have done follows, because the follow-ups live inside the action: a save's Retry adds the class to the list, closes the sheet and starts the calendar sync; a remove's Retry takes the class out of the list and closes the question; an import's Retry shows the imported view and starts the sync; a sync's Retry puts the failed classes on the calendar. A failed sync's Retry never saves the class a second time.

121402.name: RETRY_REPLAYS_THE_STORED_START
121402.meaning: Every calendar sync starts each class from the day its last attempt did. The toast's Retry replays the same arguments; the header's Retry sync and a class sheet's Retry sync pass no start, so each class takes the start held for it this visit. A Retry therefore never moves a class to a start its own term would refuse, and a class saved from its whole term is re-synced from its whole term, so a re-sync never removes the meetings already held.

121403.name: TRY_AGAIN_REREADS_THE_PAGE
121403.meaning: Try again on the classes' failed-load notice (CH-12201) and on the team events' notice (CH-12202) has the server read the whole page again (router.refresh); classes the server sends afresh replace what the page holds.

121404.name: A_SAVE_RETRIED_AFTER_A_LOST_ANSWER_REACHES_THE_SAME_ROW
121404.meaning: A new class's row id is made in the browser once per sheet, when the sheet opens, and travels with every attempt to save it: the toast's Retry, a second tap on Add class and an attempt after a lost answer all carry the same id. A duplicate-key answer on that id (the table's only unique column) means an earlier attempt stored the row, so the save updates that row with what was sent this time and keeps the color it has, and there is no second copy. Any other failure is still a failure, a colliding row that is not the player's is "Nothing was saved", and the next sheet gets a new id.

121501.name: SAVE_DOES_NOT_WAIT_FOR_THE_CALENDAR
121501.meaning: Saving a class and putting it on the calendar are two actions. The save is done, and "Class added" shows, as soon as the row is stored: the sheet is free (Add class is enabled again) while the header says "Adding to your calendar…" (CH-12403) until the sync lands. An import works the same way: its result shows at once. A class saved while another sync is still running is not dropped: it is flagged "Not on your calendar" with no error toast, and the header's Retry sync puts it there.

121502.name: SYNC_STARTS_FROM_THE_CLASS_OWN_TERM
121502.meaning: An import puts a class on the calendar from next Monday, so a schedule read mid-term does not fill the calendar with meetings already held, but only where that Monday is inside the class's own term and leaves the term standing, which is the window the sync will derive. A class in next term, one imported before its term begins and one in the last weeks of a term (under 21 days left) is put on its term's whole window, with no start given. A class with no term is in the current term. A save syncs the whole term.

121503.name: A_CLASS_WITH_NO_TIME_IS_TAKEN_OFF_THE_CALENDAR
121503.meaning: A class with days but no start or no end time is never put on the calendar: the server would place it from 08:00 to 09:00, a block the coach could plan around that is not real. The sync takes it off the calendar instead (a no-op if it was never on it, and it clears a block an earlier save put there), and the class says so: its card reads "No meeting time, not on your calendar" and "Add the time this class meets.", its sheet reads "No time set" and "Not on your calendar: no time set" with no meetings listed, there is no week strip, and the import result names it. A class with times and no days is flagged "No meeting days, not on your calendar" (CH-12304).

121504.name: A_FAILED_SYNC_IS_REMEMBERED_FOR_THE_VISIT
121504.meaning: No column records a calendar sync, so the classes whose last sync failed, and the start each was synced from, are held by the page for the visit only: a reload starts clean, and the page never says "synced 2 minutes ago". A class that is not on the calendar is flagged on its card, in the header ("1 class is not on your calendar", with Retry sync) and in its own sheet (with Retry sync), and a Retry that lands clears all three.

catalogRow.theySee: On desktop the class takes the Ledger row tint (quick) and a deeper one on press (press), with no lift and no scale
The page is drawn still while it is read; the sweep is gone (MOTION-AND-VISUAL 3.12)
Selection

121702.name: REMOVE_CLASS_IS_TAPPED_IN_A_CLASSS
121702.meaning: Remove class is tapped in a class's sheet

catalogRow.theySee: Warning, before the question

121703.name: A_DAY_IS_CHOSEN_OR_CLEARED_IN
121703.meaning: A day is chosen or cleared in the form

catalogRow.theySee: Selection

121704.name: THE_IMPORT_SWITCHES_BETWEEN_A_FILE_AND
121704.meaning: The import switches between a file and pasted text

catalogRow.theySee: Selection
Warning, before the question; the question's own confirm is silent, and the success haptic follows the delete (the error haptic when it fails)

121801.name: A_SCREEN_READER_MOVES_THROUGH_THE_DECK
121801.meaning: A screen reader moves through the deck

catalogRow.theySee: The page is labelled "Classes"; each class is one button named "STAT 201, Probability and Statistics, Tue, Thu 9:00–10:15 AM" (or "…, no fixed meeting")
Hidden from screen readers; the button's name says the same in words
One labelled region: "Fall 2026, week 8 of 17, 13 credits · 5 classes, ends Dec 15"; the bars and the line are drawing and hidden
Each message is next to its field with `role="alert"` and the field is `aria-invalid` and described by it; focus moves to the first one
A real button, so the keyboard opens the file picker too; a file dropped on it is read

121806.name: NO_AXE_VIOLATIONS_IN_ANY_PREVIEW_STATE
121806.meaning: No axe violations on the six preview states (the board's Fall 2026, empty, failed, partial, no team and loading) at 1280px and 390px, run by npm run clubhouse:a11y from the entries in scripts/clubhouse/a11y.mjs. Reserved: it ran clean on 2026-09-30 (12 of 12), but it is a dev-server run, not a test, so no test names it.

catalogRow.theySee: A region named by its heading; "Coaches see" is one group read as "Coaches see Jonah Okafor: In class until 11:25 AM"; the sharing switch is a switch named "Share class status with coaches"; the book glyph is decoration

121901.name: PHONE_LAYOUT
121901.meaning: At 820px and below Classes is the phone build, never a shrunken desktop: the shell's top bar reads "Classes" with "‹ More" going back to More, the page keeps its own header, and the same classes and actions are there; the sheets are bottom sheets. Below a 1000px container the side column goes under the deck, and below 640px the deck is one column, the overview stacks and the two header buttons share the row.

122001.name: ENTER_SAVES_AND_ESC_CLOSES
122001.meaning: Enter in a field of the Add or Edit form saves it (the form has a hidden submit button and the same refusals as the Save button), and Esc closes any sheet through the same path as Cancel or Close, so a form with changes asks first (CH-12502), with focus returning to what opened it. The day picker's days are native buttons with a pressed state, and the import's drop zone is a native button (CH-12805). Not tested here: no test presses Enter or Esc.

122101.name: LOADER_READS_IN_ONE_PASS
122101.meaning: The server loader reads the page before first paint in one pass: the team's time zone, then the player's classes and the team's events for the week together (each limited to 500 rows). Each failed read is flagged on its own (classes.error, week.error) and logged, never thrown, so the other still shows. "Today" is the team's day in the team's zone (in the evening in New York it is already tomorrow in UTC), and the week runs Monday to Sunday around it.

122301.name: FAILURES_REPORTED
122301.meaning: A read that fails in the loader is logged through chLogServer("classes", "classes" or "events") and named on the page. A write that fails is reported through chReport under the classes surface with its action (classes.save, classes.remove, classes.import, classes.sync), at low severity when the server refused it, after a chTrail breadcrumb for the intent. A calendar removal or sync that throws is reported under classes.remove or classes.sync. A section that crashes reports under its own surface (classes.term, classes.deck, classes.side).

122401.name: TESTS_NAME_CONTRACTS
122401.meaning: src/clubhouse/__tests__/classes.test.tsx names every Classes catalog code of kinds 0 to 5 it forces (clubhouse:check fails a row that no test names), and every hand contract it proves by its Bridge ID in a test title. Reserved: no test title carries a Bridge ID yet, and no test asserts this.

130101.name: COACHHELM_OPENS_FOR_THE_ROLE
130101.meaning: One address gives a coach their CoachHelm (the Team page, the drawn golf hole, with Ask beside it) and a player theirs (Your week, with Standing and the Deep dive beside it), from the session: a coach who also has a player profile is a coach here, and a player's page needs no team. The older boards that once opened here (the coach's signal list, the player's focus board) were retired on 2026-11-11.

130102.name: THE_FOCUS_IS_THE_TOP_INSIGHT_THAT_IS_NOT_WORKING
130102.meaning: The player's focus card is the insight the person picked or, without a pick, the top-ranked finding that is current (a read older than the newest round, and a card that states no finding, do not lead), in the delivery feed's own order. The picked insight leaves both lists and the one it replaced joins them; the board holds at most three findings (the focus counted when it is one, so Also worth knowing has at most two) and one strength (a picked strength is that one), in the feed's own order, never re-ranked (NEEDS_MAX, WORKING_MAX). A measured zero (a strokes-gained baseline whose strokes_impact prints as 0.0, coachhelm-strokes.ts) is not one of the board's open reads; any other zero is no estimate and the read stays. Every read the board does not show (past the caps, or a measured zero) is counted in the line that opens the Deep dive, which lists them all, so the count and the lists add up to the Deep dive's reads (a note is in neither). No strokes-a-round figure is drawn from strokes_impact unless it is a real estimate (sg_baseline or peer_delta, non-zero at one decimal: strokesAtStake), and the miner's own "Projected impact: ~0.00 strokes per round." sentence is not drawn when its figure is zero or the row has no estimate (withoutZeroImpact; the stored text is untouched). With only strengths there is no focus and CH-13303 says nothing needs work, and names What's working only when it is drawn. On the coach's board the focus is the chosen player's top insight.

130103.name: PLAYERS_ARE_ORDERED_MOST_PRESSING_FIRST
130103.meaning: The coach's By player list is ordered by how pressing each player's top insight is (Priority, then Worth closing, then Minor; a strength last, whatever its own priority), then by how many open signals the player has, then by name. A strength, and a top read that is out of date, come after the findings, and a card that states no finding comes last. The first player's focus is open when the page opens, and picking a player (a toggle, aria-pressed) shows that player's focus.

130104.name: FAIRWAY_DRILL_LINKS_SAY_NOT_REBUILT
130104.meaning: The Fairway drills' addresses (where /my-development, /my-game-profile, /my-standing and the focus-area cards send people) land on a screen that exists: ?view=development redirects to Stats' Development tab (/golf/dashboard/stats?tab=dev), and ?view=profile, ?view=standing and ?view=deep-dive are the player's own Game profile, Standing and Deep dive, built for the signed-in player alone (the loader takes the session's player id and nothing from the address). None of them says "not rebuilt yet" any more (the name is the contract's original, kept because Bridge IDs are append-only). ?view=insights, no view and any other value draw the board. A coach's ?view=profile, standing or deep-dive with no ?player= is their own board; with ?player=<golf_players.id> it is the coach's view of that player (spec A, 2026-10-21, which supersedes Q-76's "a coach's equivalents are not asked for"), read only once the id is checked against the coach's team (130807). A player's ?player= means nothing: their views read the session's id.

130106.name: INSIGHTS_ARE_GENERATOR_OUTPUT_ONLY
130106.meaning: Every insight is a delivery-action row (EvidenceInsight) re-shaped by toChInsight; nothing is generated, ranked or computed here beyond a gauge's display scale. The value is the generator's own display; the downhill-penalty finding is two bars and no gauge, any other insight with a comparison is a gauge (you, the cohort, and the Tour when it differs) and one with no comparison draws no gauge; the sample names what it counts and the window is days or All rounds; the read is a word; the drill is the attached drill (its text read from golf_drills.description) and the generator's placeholder action is not shown as a drill. An insight is working when it is resolved, or better than the comparison the card draws (the Tour's value where the generator carried a college comparison, never a stored college one the page does not show) at low priority or with an encouraging tone (isNegativePolarityMetric decides which way a number is good; a missing comparison is none, never zero). The read says Solid, Early or Thin from the one table every surface uses. The text is the player's own on the player's board (a coach's "have the player" instruction is dropped) and about the player by their first name on the coach's board (the gauge says "Jonah ·", not "You ·").

130107.name: COACH_A_PLAYERS_TOP_CARD_STATES_NO
130107.meaning: Coach: a player's top card states no finding (a note)

catalogRow.theySee: The card draws its claim and no number, gauge or read, the pill reads Note, and there is no Assign and no Dismiss: "This card states no finding, so there is nothing to assign." The player is listed with 0 open signals and sorts last. The generators' "nothing to fix" rows (tee strategy sharp or inconclusive, putt break balanced) and every `feed_exempt` row (Scoring by par type, the hole 1 warm-up) are notes; the player's own board does not draw them

130201.name: THE_PLAYERS_PAGE_IS_ON_ITS_WAY
130201.meaning: The player's page is on its way

catalogRow.theySee: The header, the focus card beside a short list of rows, in place; `aria-busy`, "Loading CoachHelm"

130202.name: THE_COACHS_PAGE_IS_ON_ITS_WAY

Another player's card, opened meanwhile, shows its own button as it is (disabled, not labelled): one write is in flight at a time, and it is never drawn as that player's

130204.name: THE_ROUTE_SKELETON_TAKES_THE_ROLES_SHAPE
130204.meaning: The route's loading.tsx draws the Clubhouse skeleton only inside the Clubhouse shell (Fairway's skeleton everywhere else), in the shape of the signed-in role's page: the coach's program pulse, then the players beside the focus card; the player's focus card beside a short list. The player's shape is used until the role is known.

130205.name: A_PLAYERS_ACCEPT_OR_DECLINE_IS_BEING

A skeleton (aria-busy) that draws the sub-tab strip, the chats and the greeting in place, with no script
Send becomes Stop; Stop is silent

The button shows its spinner and `aria-busy` (its name "Re-checking 5 players…"), and a second tap sends nothing; the line says "Re-checking 5 players… This can take a minute; the board stays as it is until it’s done." (the roster's count; "your players" when it did not load)

130404.name: PLAYER_COACHHELM_IS_OFF_FOR_THEM
130404.meaning: Player: CoachHelm is off for them (the board, and Standing and Deep dive, which say the same, answered at once and with no sub-navigation)

catalogRow.theySee: "CoachHelm is off for your team" + "Your coach turned it off: “…”. Ask your coach if you want it back on." (the coach's own words when there are some; otherwise "CoachHelm is turned off, so no insights are being shown.")

Ask is CoachHelm's, so `?view=ask` is this same page, no chat is read, and the Board and Ask strip is not drawn; a gate lookup that failed there is Ask's own "did not load" notice, never a chat
"You aren’t on a team yet" + "Once your team is set up, CoachHelm reads the rounds your players post and shows their signals here." Not an error, not a redirect

130411.name: A_FAILED_READ_IS_NEVER_DRAWN_AS_EMPTY
130411.meaning: The delivery actions answer an empty list or map when a read fails, so the loaders tell a failed read from a first run. An empty feed, or empty top insights, while a drawable visible insight is on file (for a player, one they have not dismissed themselves: the newest feedback row per insight decides) is a failed read (CH-13201, CH-13202), and so is a failed visible-insights, feedback or roster read; only when that check finds nothing is it a first run (CH-13301, CH-13302, CH-13306). A player who dismissed every insight themselves is a first run, not a failure, and a failed roster read is never an empty team (CH-13307).

The first-run page with the team name, Invite players (Roster's invite sheet) and the sub-tab strip, and no composer

130422.name: STANDING_AN_EARLY_READ

Projections start at 5 rounds, and a comparison with your team needs 5 teammates with the stat." above the page; every comparison that can be made is drawn, Where strokes go included, with no projection. Five is the Fairway loader's own floor for a scoring average (`loadPlayerScoringBaseline`)

130423.name: STANDING_A_STAT_THE_TEAM_IS_TOO
130423.meaning: Standing: a stat the team is too small to compare on (under five teammates have it)

catalogRow.theySee: In the row: "Team comparison needs 5 teammates with this stat (3 so far)."; the team figure is a dash and no team rank is worded (the SQL refresh and the StandingBar use the same floor of five). The Tour comparison is unaffected

130424.name: STANDING_A_STAT_WHOSE_TOUR_VALUE_IS

130725.name: COACH_PLAYER_WHY_DO_YOU_THINK_SO

130726.name: COACH_PLAYER_READS_THE_RECHECK_CLEARED

Drawn only with `coachhelm_recheck_v1` on On the Deep dive each cleared read is a line in its own area of the ledger ("Cleared Oct 12", the read, the recheck's numbers), not a section; the newest three show, then "N more cleared" shows the rest

130727.name: DEEP_DIVE_THE_READS_WHY_LINE_FROM

130780.name: COACH_THE_BRIEF_BEHIND_INTELLIGENCE
