catalogRow.theySee: This week, Team patterns, What players are working on, How the reads have held, Goals and standing, in that order, each only when it has something in it. On the phone a pushed bar (back to CoachHelm, "Brief"); on desktop a back link. `&section=` opens on a section. With the flag off the address is the board

130789.meaning: Retired 2026-11-07 (Dashboard cuts). Brief: CoachHelm is off for the team

catalogRow.theySee: The off page with the team's reason when it gave one; nothing is read

130790.name: ASK_NEW_CHAT_WHILE_THE_OPEN_CHAT

catalogRow.theySee: Toast "New chat started" with Undo, held 5 s; Undo brings the last chat back (its messages, conversation, title, stopped turn and address). 130801.name: CONTROLS_FOLLOW_THE_ROLE
130801.meaning: The coach's controls (Assign as focus, Dismiss, Undo) exist only on the coach's pages. A player's CoachHelm (Your week) is never drawn Assign, Dismiss, Undo or Share: the one thing a player writes is their answer to a proposal, Accept or Decline. No page has a Share button: no action sits behind it.

130802.name: A_COACH_READS_ONLY_THE_TEAMS_ACTIVE_PLAYERS
130802.meaning: A coach's board reads only the active members of the team the shell resolved (golf_team_members, team_id and status active), whichever other teams the coach staffs; only those ids reach the visible-insights read, the top-insight read (one per player) and the focus-area read. A coach session with no resolved team, or one that is not a coach team, gets the no-team page (CH-13308) and no player is read. The program pulse is the coach's own (getCoachProgramPulse, which resolves its team through the coach chat context), not a read of this page's team id.

130803.name: A_PLAYER_READS_ONLY_THEIR_OWN_INSIGHTS
130803.meaning: A player's board is built from the session's own player id and nothing else: the gate, the feed (up to 30), the dismissal read and the rounds count are that player's, with or without a team, and no team read or teammate's insight reaches it.

130804.name: SERVER_ACTIONS_ARE_THE_GATE
130804.meaning: Every write is checked again by its server action, whatever the board shows: dismissInsight and reactivateInsight refuse a caller who is not a coach of the insight's team (verifyInsightAccess; an insight with no team is refused) and update only that team's row; createFocusAreaFromInsightV2 refuses a caller who fails verifyPlayerAccess for the player (a coach of the player's team, or the player themself, whose own use would make an active focus with no proposal and is not reachable from this board) and refuses a second active focus on the same metric with ACTIVE_FOCUS_DUPLICATE_ERROR. Run in coachhelm-actions-contracts.test.ts against the real actions.

130805.name: THE_PAGE_GIVES_CLUBHOUSE_ONLY_BEHIND_THE_FLAG
130805.meaning: A signed-in coach or player gets the Clubhouse route, drawn in place with no redirect, and ?view= is handed to it; no session goes to sign in. (Fairway's CoachHelm page was retired, 2026-11-14.)

130806.name: ASSIGN_IS_OFFERED_ONLY_FOR_AN_INSIGHT_NOT_YET_MADE
130806.meaning: Assign as focus is offered when no focus has been made from the read. One that is working (a strength) is offered too, as a keep-doing focus (Q-80); it can also be dismissed. One with a proposed, active, in-progress or paused focus already made from it opens as the Assigned chip (CH-13601): the loader reads only those statuses, so a declined or completed focus leaves the read assignable again.

130807.name: A_COACH_READS_ONE_PLAYER_ONLY_THROUGH_THE_SCOPE
130807.meaning: A coach's view of one player (?view=deep-dive|standing|profile&player=) reads nothing about the player until loadCoachPlayerScope has found the id an active member of the team the shell resolved (golf_team_members, team_id, player_id and status active, through the session's client): an id that is not a uuid is answered with no query, and any id not on this team, on another team the coach staffs, or no longer active is the one "That player isn't on your team" page (CH-13311), so the page never says whether a player exists. The three loaders take only the branded scope that check makes, never an id (a raw id does not compile), because Standing's standing map and the goals read through the service client. A read the check needs that fails is CH-13209, never CH-13311. The Deep dive reads the coach feed (getInsightsForCoach with player_id), never the player's, and every row of anyone else's is dropped.

130901.name: CHANGE_LANDED
130901.meaning: A change that lands confirms itself in place with the success haptic and no toast: Assign becomes the chip Assigned as Jonah’s focus, Dismiss becomes the dismissed notice, Undo brings the action row back. The one toast is the existing-focus outcome (130903).

130902.name: ASSIGN_MAKES_A_PROPOSAL_THE_PLAYER_ACCEPTS
130902.meaning: Assign as focus sends the insight's own title, first sentence, area type and metric to createFocusAreaFromInsightV2, which makes a proposal (a coach's use is a prescription), not an active focus. The chip says Assigned and the line under it says the player sees it as a proposal and accepts it to start. The player answers it on their own pages (Q-77); the coach's action row has no Accept or Decline.

130903.name: AN_EXISTING_ACTIVE_FOCUS_IS_THE_OUTCOME_WANTED
130903.meaning: When the write answers ACTIVE_FOCUS_DUPLICATE_ERROR (the player already has an active focus on that metric), Assign is done, not failed: the chip shows and a toast says the player already has a focus on this, with no failure toast and no error haptic. The proposal line is left out, because it is not known whether they have started it.

131101.name: PRACTICE_ANOTHER_COACH_SAVED_FIRST_OR_STARTED
131101.meaning: Practice: another coach saved first, or started this practice's plan

catalogRow.theySee: "Another coach changed this plan." Load latest; nothing is overwritten
"Deleted Warm-up" with Undo; it goes back at its place
How many groups; replacing groups says so

131201.name: THIS_VISITS_CHANGES_STAY_WHILE_THE_PAGE_IS_OPEN
131201.meaning: The Assigned chip and the dismissed notice are held in the page's own state (useFocusActions), per read: opening another read and coming back finds the chip or the notice still there. A reload reads the server again (the chip then comes from the focus-area read). Nothing of it is kept in the address.

131401.name: RETRY_FINISHES_THE_JOB
131401.meaning: The error toast's Retry runs the same write again with the same arguments, and when it lands everything the button would have done follows, because the follow-ups live inside the action: Assign shows the chip, Dismiss the notice, Undo the returned action row. catalogRow.theySee: The stage's ring lifts 1px on hover and takes a second ring while it is the filter (quick). On the phone a press lays the row press tint over the stage's coin for the press beat; the coin never scales. With reduced motion it changes without moving. A stage at 0 draws the quiet ivory coin whatever its stage, so an empty Committed is never the loudest (W41, `.is-zero`)

141602.name: A_PROSPECT_OPENS_ON_THE_PHONE
141602.meaning: A prospect opens on the phone

catalogRow.theySee: The screen slides in from the right over the list and back out on pop (base); with reduced motion it settles at once

141603.name: PICKING_A_STAGE_IN_THE_PIPELINE_OR
141603.meaning: Picking a stage in the pipeline, or letting it go

catalogRow.theySee: The list settles in with a 6px rise (260ms) while the old one fades out (180ms), hidden from assistive tech. Typing a search doesn't animate, and nor does the kept stage coming back as the page opens. Instant with reduced motion

141604.name: PRESSING_A_ROW_OR_A_KEY_ON
141604.meaning: Pressing a row or a key on the phone

catalogRow.theySee: A prospect row, the sort, the Stage, Email and Call keys, the Stage row, a document, its remove key and an empty part's action take the row press tint over the press beat (110ms); the committed stage key darkens under a shade instead. Nothing scales (the shell's CH-1606). Instant with reduced motion

141701.name: A_STAGE_IS_PICKED_AS_THE_FILTER
141701.meaning: A stage is picked, as the filter or as a prospect's stage; a row is opened; a sort is chosen

catalogRow.theySee: Selection
Warning, before the question

141703.name: STORAGE_TURNS_A_FILE_DOWN
141703.meaning: Storage turns a file down (CH-14107, CH-14108)

catalogRow.theySee: Error, once, with no toast: the dialog is the message

141801.name: A_SCREEN_READER_REACHES_THE_PIPELINE
141801.meaning: A screen reader reaches the pipeline

catalogRow.theySee: One group named "Filter by stage"; each stage is a toggle button named "Offered, 1 prospect" with its pressed state, and is off while the list is empty

141802.name: A_SCREEN_READER_MOVES_THROUGH_THE_PROSPECTS
141802.meaning: A screen reader moves through the prospects

catalogRow.theySee: Desktop: a real table with a caption and column headers, each name one button, the open one `aria-current`. Phone: a list of buttons named with the prospect, class and stage. A row's next-step plate (a step due within two weeks, or every step while sorted by Next step due, a step with no day after the dated ones) is read "Next step: …", or "Overdue: …" in warning ink once its day has passed; on desktop the Next step column does the same, and a list too narrow for the column shows the plate under the name while so sorted
The stage control is a radio group that arrow keys move; the new stage is announced politely ("Mason Reilly is now Committed") once it has saved
Each message is beside its field with `role="alert"`, the field is `aria-invalid` and described by it, and focus moves to the first

Real links (`mailto:`, `tel:` with only digits and a plus) named by what they do, so the phone dials and the mail app opens; nothing is sent from GolfHelm. The phone's Email and Call keys show the address or number under their name, cut with an ellipsis

141806.name: A_PROSPECT_IS_MOVED_TO_COMMITTED_AND
141806.meaning: A prospect is moved to Committed and the save lands

catalogRow.theySee: Once per commit: a 1px gilt rule under the stage is there at once (no draw: content never moves on its own, MOTION-AND-VISUAL 3.1, 3.12) and `haptic('success')` lands with it once the save has, not on the tap; the coin takes a gilt rim. On the phone it waits while the stage sheet is open and plays as it closes. Reopening a committed prospect shows the rule at rest. No other stage, and no failed save, plays it

141807.name: EMAIL_AND_CALL_FOR_A_DIVISION_I
141807.meaning: Email and Call for a Division I prospect before June 15 of their sophomore year

catalogRow.theySee: A quiet note under the actions: "Division I: no calls or email before June 15, 2027, the end of sophomore year" (NCAA Bylaws 13.1.3.1, 13.4.1, from the class year). Never blocks; no other division or period restricts phone or email, so nothing else is said

Under the subtitle (under the large title on the phone): the period today from the 2026-27 rule books, for example "Division I · Contact period through Nov 8 · in-person contact for prospects from Aug 1 before their junior year" (a contact period's end sits beside its name, so the age rule's start never reads as the period's), or "No recruiting calendar in Division III". The division comes from the team's organization; when it names none the coach picks one (kept on this device). Nothing sourced for the day: no line

At 820px and below Recruiting is the phone build from the owner's boards, never a shrunken desktop: the top bar reads Recruiting with "‹ More", a prospect is a pushed screen, and the edit form, the stage picker and delete are bottom sheets
Enter in a field of the form saves it through the same checks as the button; Esc closes a dialog or clears the search; arrow keys move the stage

150201.name: THE_WELCOME_IS_READING_WHO_YOU_ARE
150201.meaning: The welcome is reading who you are and what is new

catalogRow.theySee: The frame and the course already up and moving, with no text yet: the step from sign in is never an empty page, and the course does not restart when the greeting streams in
catalogRow.how: `WelcomeStage`, with the greeting in a Suspense boundary

150203.name: THE_RESET_LINK_IS_BEING_CHECKED
150203.meaning: The reset link is being checked

catalogRow.theySee: "Reset your password", "Checking your link…" with the form's shape held (two empty boxes), so nothing jumps when the fields arrive. The token is verified once
The key reads "Saving…" with its spinner in the same cell (CH-15607), lit, `aria-busy` and off; a second press saves nothing
The key reads "Joining…", lit and off

150206.name: A_STAFF_INVITATION_IS_READING_THE_SESSION

catalogRow.theySee: "Checking your session…" under the heading; then the key reads "Joining…" or "Creating your account…"

150208.name: A_TEAM_CODE_IS_BEING_TAKEN_TO
150208.meaning: A team code is being taken to its team

catalogRow.theySee: The key reads "Opening…", lit and off; Enter adds nothing

150301.name: A_SIGN_IN_IS_IN_FLIGHT

catalogRow.theySee: The button reads "Signing in…" with a spinner, `aria-busy`, and is off. It stays the lit green: off-because-empty is the unlit key (CH-15607), in flight is the key working

150302.name: RESET_PASSWORD_A_LINK_IS_BEING_ASKED
150302.meaning: Reset password: a link is being asked for

catalogRow.theySee: The key reads "Sending reset link…" with its spinner in the same cell (CH-15607), lit, `aria-busy` and off; a second Send sends nothing. Up for owner review (no board)

150401.name: THERE_IS_AN_EARLIER_VISIT_AND_NOTHING

The header reads "Your first time in" with no time; "Your team’s updates will show up here" + "Messages, posted rounds and RSVPs land here each time you sign in."

150403.name: THE_NAME_COULD_NOT_BE_READ_OR
150403.meaning: The name could not be read, or sanitises to nothing

catalogRow.theySee: "Enter your email and password to sign in." in a danger notice, the empty field marked and focused. Nothing is sent: an empty pair would record a failed attempt against a blank identity. Felt: warning (CH-15703)

catalogRow.theySee: "Enter your email address." in a danger notice; the field marked, focused and shaken once (CH-15609); nothing is sent. Editing the address clears it (today's page). Felt: warning (CH-15703). Up for owner review (no board)

150505.name: RESET_PASSWORD_SAVE_WITH_NO_NEW_PASSWORD

150506.name: RESET_PASSWORD_A_RULE_IS_MISSING

catalogRow.theySee: The first rule that is not met, in sign up's words ("Use at least 8 characters.", "Add a number.", "That password is too common. Choose another."). The four rules and the bars above it show the rest

150507.name: RESET_PASSWORD_THE_CONFIRMATION_IS_EMPTY
150507.meaning: Reset password: the confirmation is empty

150508.name: RESET_PASSWORD_THE_TWO_BOXES_DIFFER
150508.meaning: Reset password: the two boxes differ

150509.name: JOIN_A_TEAM_CONTINUE_WITH_NO_CODE

catalogRow.theySee: "Enter your team code." in a danger notice; the boxes ringed and shaken once. Nothing is sent: the code is only ever resolved by the server. Felt: warning

150510.meaning: Join a team: fewer than four characters

catalogRow.theySee: "A team code is at least 4 characters." the same way (today's page's own limit)

catalogRow.theySee: Demo: "Name is required.", "Email is required.", "Enter a valid email address.", "School / Program is required." (today's words). New coach: "Enter your school or organization.", "Add the state.", "Add your first name to continue." The box is marked and focused. Felt: warning

150601.name: THE_SERVER_REFUSES_THE_CREDENTIALS
150601.meaning: The server refuses the credentials ("Invalid login credentials")

catalogRow.theySee: "Incorrect email or password. Please check your credentials and try again." in a danger notice (`role="alert"`). Both fields are marked invalid and focus goes to Email. Felt: error (CH-15704)
"Please verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for the confirmation link." in a warning notice. No field is marked. Felt: warning (CH-15703)
"Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a moment and try again." in a warning notice. Felt: warning (CH-15703)

150604.name: THE_APP_UPDATED_IN_THE_BACKGROUND_AND

catalogRow.theySee: "The app updated in the background. Please try signing in once more." in an info notice (`role="status"`: nothing is wrong with the account). Felt: error
"An unexpected error occurred. Please try again." in a danger notice, reported with `logError` (high). Felt: error

150606.name: THE_SERVER_ANSWERS_WITH_ANY_OTHER_SENTENCE
150606.meaning: The server answers with any other sentence of its own, such as a lockout ("Too many login attempts. Please try again in 14 minutes.")

catalogRow.theySee: Those words, in a danger notice. No field is marked. Felt: error. The sign-in action's own wrong-password text ("Invalid email or password (2 attempts remaining)") is not this: it reads as CH-15001, with the attempts left kept as a second line (`failureForServer`, Q-98); today's form still shows it raw

150607.name: SIGN_UP_THE_TEAM_CODE_CANNOT_BE

catalogRow.theySee: "We couldn't check your code" under the slots, and a warning notice "Unable to reach the server. Please check your internet connection and try again." with Try again, which checks the same code. Felt: error

150608.name: SIGN_UP_THE_EMAIL_ALREADY_HAS_AN

catalogRow.theySee: The server's sentence, or "Couldn’t finish setting up your program. Give it another go.", in a danger notice under the questions; every answer is kept and Create program is on again. A photo that did not upload says so the same way. Felt: error

"Unable to reach the server. Please check your internet connection and try again." in a danger notice. Felt: error (CH-15704)

"Password updated", "You’re signed in as <address>", and that other devices were signed out; Continue hands over to the dashboard. Felt: success

151201.name: THE_PERSON_CAME_FROM_AN_INVITE_LINK

That page sends a signed-out visitor to `/golf/login?view=forgot` (a server redirect in its layout); a signed-in one gets the same form in the same room, their address filled in and Settings as the way back (`SignedInReset`, 2026-11-18; the Fairway page is gone). catalogRow.theySee: The form is in the server HTML and the course is not (a neutral gradient stands in, and nothing hydrates differently). The course loads after first paint from the viewer's clock. When a sign-in lands the form slides away, the course takes the whole frame and the veil and tagline fade (720ms), then the welcome route draws itself over the same frame

From mount: the scrim fades (1.4s at 0.2s), the mark (0.7s at 0.3s), the date rises (0.5s), "Good morning," focuses in out of a blur (1s at 0.64s), the name rises out of its clipped line (1.1s at 1.05s), the card arrives (0.9s at 2.25s) and each item rises 140ms after the one before from 2.55s. The word follows the viewer's hour on the app's one set of buckets, `src/lib/utils/time-of-day.ts` (morning 5 to 12, afternoon 12 to 17, evening otherwise); after dark the type flips to ivory

The camera pushes toward the pin (scale 1.34, 5.2s; 1.2 on a short window; the phone slides 180 units and scales 1.06 to centre the clubhouse). The foreground pine and bough move out of frame. A ball flies in on a curve (1.65s), hops once and rolls to the cup. The camera is a CSS transform on one wrapper and the ball is a motion value written to two attributes: nothing re-renders

The text slides left and fades (420ms), the course clips to the app canvas (240px from the left, 880ms), the ivory paper fades in over it and the camera pushes to 1.5, then the destination is asked for (1s). Only when the destination is a dashboard page and Clubhouse; otherwise the welcome just leaves (520ms). On the phone the screen fades to ivory. Idempotent: a second tap, or Return on the focused button, starts nothing

151605.name: REDUCED_MOTION_OR_SETTINGS_PREFERENCES_ANIMATIONS_OFF
151605.meaning: Reduced motion, or Settings > Preferences > Animations off

catalogRow.theySee: Every transition is 1ms, every loop is paused (the flag holds still, the clouds stop), the camera stops short (1.2), the ball is already on the green, the welcome lands at once and the hand-off is a quick fade (240ms)

Every loop holds still (CSS animations and the flag's SMIL) and starts again when it is back. The waving flags carry their resting shape, so a scene that mounts (the welcome's taking over from sign in's) never draws a bare pole before the wave starts

151607.name: THE_SIGN_IN_KEY_CHANGES_STATE_OFF
151607.meaning: The Sign in key changes state: off (a field is empty), ready, in flight

catalogRow.theySee: Off, it is an unlit key pressed into the paper (the soft well, its word engraved in quiet ink), not a faded, desaturated green. Filling both fields lifts that face away and the word takes the green's ink (quick, 180ms). Tapped, "Sign in" leaves upward and "Signing in…" with its spinner rises into the same cell (quick fade, base travel), so the key never reflows; in flight it stays the lit green, `aria-busy` and off, and only the showing label is read. Reduced motion and Animations off: at once

151608.name: A_REFUSAL_APPEARS_OR_THE_NEXT_ONE
151608.meaning: A refusal appears, or the next one replaces it

catalogRow.theySee: The notice fades in under the fields (220ms) and what it moves glides there instead of jumping: the button and the phone's forgot link slide down, and on the desktop the centred form rises half as far (a transform-only FLIP over the base beat, 260ms; height is never animated). While the next attempt is in flight the last refusal stays, at half strength, so the button never jumps up under the pointer; the answer replaces it in place and is announced again. Reduced motion and Animations off: the new layout at once

151609.name: A_REFUSAL_IS_ABOUT_THE_FIELDS
151609.meaning: A refusal is about the fields (the credentials, an empty field, or the reset form's address)

catalogRow.theySee: The fields shake once, 5px either way over 380ms, as a wrong team code does on sign up; a second refusal shakes them again. A refusal that marks no field (an unverified email, a rate limit, the network) does not. Reduced motion and Animations off: still (`--ch-au-t-shake` is 1ms)
The eye and the slashed eye share one cell and crossfade (quick), the leaving one shrinking and turning away (base); the field itself flips between dots and text at once

151611.name: THE_HOME_LINK_IS_HOVERED_OR_PRESSED
151611.meaning: The Home link is hovered or pressed

catalogRow.theySee: Where a pointer can hover, the paper behind it tints and the chevron leans 2px back, the way the link goes (quick); pressed, a deeper tint. Links do not scale (CH-1606)

151612.name: THE_PANEL_MOVES_BETWEEN_SIGN_IN_THE
151612.meaning: The panel moves between sign in, the reset form and check your email

catalogRow.theySee: The course, the lockup and the panel's chrome stay put. The view slides 12px the way the person is going (on to the reset form and the email; back to sign in) and crossfades, the incoming over base (260ms) and the outgoing over quick (180ms); on the desktop the centred stage glides to its new centre on transform. The leaving view is hidden from assistive technology at once. Reduced motion and Animations off: at once. Up for owner review (no board)

151613.name: SIGN_UP_ONE_QUESTION_GIVES_WAY_TO
151613.meaning: Sign up: one question gives way to the next (Continue, a choice, Back)

catalogRow.theySee: The question leaving goes the way the flow goes, 10px up when moving on and 10px down on Back, fading over the app's quick beat (180ms), held where it stood so nothing beside it moves. The next rises 16px into place from below (from above on Back) on the design's step curve (720ms), starting 60ms after, so the two hand over in sequence rather than printing over each other; text never blurs. The leaving question leaves the accessibility tree and the tab order at once, and the new one takes focus at its heading. A move is asked by the question on screen, so a second tap on a choice, or a choice's timer after Back, moves nothing (a double tap used to skip the account), and Back waits while the account, the profile or a request is being written, so what it makes lands where it belongs. A long form scrolled down hands over at the top. Reduced motion and Animations off: replaced at once

151614.name: SIGN_UP_THE_MEMBER_CARD_FILLS_IN
151614.meaning: Sign up: the member card fills in as answers arrive

catalogRow.theySee: A value's first appearance is the design's flash: it rises into place in brass and dries to green ink (900ms). Each change after that, a letter typed or a step of the handicap, wets it again in brass where it stands, and it dries once the answer rests (1.1s): typing never flickers it out, nothing moves under the reader's eye and nothing counts. The coin settles in (420ms) as it goes from the silhouette to the monogram, green ink on the card's stock, to the photo. A long value ends in an ellipsis. Reduced motion and Animations off: ink at once

Desktop: one felt-green thumb slides along the rail to the current section and takes its width (520ms on the step curve); the labels turn ivory exactly under it (a clipped layer, so nothing is laid out again), and a section passed keeps its tick. Phone: "2 of 5" over a hairline that fills to the same point. The thumb and the hairline are decorative; the current section is `aria-current="step"`. Reduced motion and Animations off: at once

151616.name: SIGN_UP_THE_MEMBER_CARD_IS_ISSUED
151616.meaning: Sign up: the member card is issued (done, staff done)

catalogRow.theySee: One deliberate reveal, no confetti. Desktop: the card the answers built is already on the tray; it lifts 14px with a slight turn and is laid back down (900ms), then the seal presses in at 1.1s. Phone: the card arrives here, rising 40px with 4 degrees of turn (the design's issue, 1.1s), then the seal. Only an issued card plays it: the intro, a request received ("Received today") and a join that failed do not; on the phone their card rises in with its sheet. Reduced motion and Animations off: issued and sealed at once

151617.name: SIGN_UP_AN_ANSWER_IS_TOUCHED_OR
151617.meaning: Sign up: an answer is touched or refused

catalogRow.theySee: Where a pointer can hover, the green choices lift 2px onto the primary hover's depth, a field's edge darkens, and a next step tints with its chevron leaning 2px on; pressed, a choice sets down 1px and a year tile sinks into its well (none of them scale). A refused field keeps its red edge with a red halo and takes the cursor once its error is drawn; the error line fades in (220ms), and a password rule met ticks in (260ms). Reduced motion and Animations off: at once
Light (`press`)
Success
